title: RW: WhatsApp Bat-Phone Transition
description:
Complete the RiseWise WhatsApp bat-phone transition by notifying all clients who have not yet received an update that WhatsApp will no longer be the primary coaching communication channel.

Clients should be directed to contact the coaching team through coaching@risewise.com.au moving forward. Introduce Ivan as their new point of contact and explain that he has taken over from Elise.
Before Starting
Confirm successful access to:
WhatsApp
Stripe
GHL

Coordinate with BossD if a WhatsApp QR code scan or login verification is required.
Training Recording
https://fathom.video/share/UjGz1JwCdFdzuMdsSX5dmPaZvxHdy4Ro
Expected Outcome
All active clients have been informed about the WhatsApp transition and know that Ivan and coaching@risewise.com.au are now their main points of contact.

SOP: RiseWise BatPhone Transition
1. Purpose
RiseWise is moving client support away from individual WhatsApp BatPhone groups.
Moving forward, active clients should send their questions and support requests to:
coaching@risewise.com.au
Ivan is the current Client Success Manager and will be the main client-facing point of contact.
The purpose of this task is to:
Inform all active RiseWise clients about the new support process.
Introduce Ivan as the new Client Success Manager.
Direct future client communication to coaching@risewise.com.au.
Check whether each active client has a BatPhone conversation.
Monitor any new messages received during the transition.
Route client concerns to the correct team member.
Track which active clients have already been notified.
Apply a completion tag to handled WhatsApp conversations.


2. Scope of Cy’s Responsibility
Cy will:
Use the ClickUp Active Client List as the source of truth.
Search WhatsApp for each active client.
Confirm that the WhatsApp conversation has the “Batphone” tag before sending anything.
Review the previous conversation before sending the transition message.
Send the approved transition message to clients who have not yet been notified.
Adjust the message when a client is still asking for Elise.
Monitor new messages received through the BatPhones.
Route client questions to Ivan, Jerold or Divine where appropriate.
Add the completion tag after confirming that the client has been notified.
Tag older conversations where the message was already sent but the completion tag is missing.
Update the BatPhone Transition Tracker after reviewing each client.
Cy will not:
Send the message to internal GIM contacts, leads or potential clients.
Give coaching or business advice.
Promise refunds, payment extensions, free program extensions or cancellations.
Approve a Joel 1:1 call.
Give clients Ivan’s personal phone number.
Delete WhatsApp messages.
Delete or leave WhatsApp groups.
Add the completion tag before confirming that the transition message was sent.
Contact someone who is not listed as active unless Jerold confirms it first.


3. Required Access
Before beginning, Cy will need access to:
RiseWise WhatsApp BatPhones
RiseWise Slack
ClickUp
BatPhone Transition Tracker
System instructions and login information can be found in:
ClickUp → Knowledge Hub → Assets and Login Details
Do not copy passwords or private login information into Slack, ClickUp comments or client messages.


4. Source of Truth
All current active RiseWise clients can be found in:
ClickUp → Joel Perna Workspace → RiseWise Space → Client Database (Delivery) → Active List
The Active List determines which clients should be reviewed.
Review all clients under the highlighted active categories:
New
Kickstarter
Momentum (Scale)
Launch
Scale
Coast
Accelerate
Do not include clients under:
Flagged
Program Paused
Program Ended
Work through every client in the highlighted categories and check whether they have a BatPhone conversation and whether the transition message has already been sent.

Do not rely only on the WhatsApp “Batphone” tag because WhatsApp may also contain:
Internal GIM conversations
Potential clients
Leads the team is still trying to win
Previous clients
Other unrelated conversations
A client must first be confirmed as active in ClickUp before Cy sends the transition message.


5. BatPhone Transition Tracker Setup
Before starting, Cy should create or open the BatPhone Transition Tracker.
Add every client currently listed in the ClickUp Active List.
The tracker is only for monitoring progress on this task. ClickUp remains the official source for confirming whether the client is active.
Tracker columns

Client Name Active in ClickUp BatPhone Chat Found BatPhone Tag Confirmed Message Already Sent Action Taken Date Reviewed Status Notes
Client name Yes Yes/No Yes/No Yes/No Sent / No action required Date Select status Add details if needed
Status options
Use one of the following:
Message Sent
Previously Informed
No BatPhone Found
BatPhone Tag Missing
Needs Clarification
Client Concern Escalated


6. Process for Each Active Client
For each client listed in the ClickUp Active List:
Confirm the client’s name in ClickUp.
Copy or note the correct spelling of their name.
Search for the client in the RiseWise WhatsApp account.
Open their BatPhone chat or group, if one is available.
Confirm that the conversation has the “Batphone” tag.
Read the most recent part of the conversation.
Check whether the client has already received a message about:
moving support to coaching@risewise.com.au;
Ivan becoming the new Client Success Manager; or
the BatPhone being phased out.
Complete the appropriate action below.
Update the BatPhone Transition Tracker.
Apply the completion tag where appropriate.


7. If the Message Was Already Sent
Do not send the same message again.
Instead:
Confirm that the previous transition message was clearly sent.
Add the completion tag if it is missing.
Update the tracker status to Previously Informed.
Add the date reviewed.
Continue to the next active client.


8. If the Message Has Not Been Sent
Send the appropriate approved transition message.
Confirm that the message was successfully delivered.
Add the completion tag to the WhatsApp conversation.
Update the tracker status to Message Sent.
Add the date.
Continue to the next active client.


9. If No BatPhone Conversation Can Be Found
Do not worry. A BatPhone group may not have been created for that client, or they may have communicated through another channel.
Search the client’s full name and any partner name listed in ClickUp.
Check whether another email or business name is listed in their ClickUp record.
If no conversation is found, update the tracker status to No BatPhone Found.
Add a short note.
Continue to the next active client.
Example note:
No WhatsApp BatPhone conversation found after searching the client and partner names.
Cy does not need to create a new BatPhone group.


10. If a BatPhone Chat Is Found but the Tag Is Missing
Do not send the message immediately.
Confirm that the person is the same active client listed in ClickUp.
Review the conversation carefully.
Update the tracker status to BatPhone Tag Missing.
Ask Jerold to confirm whether the message should be sent.
This protects internal GIM contacts, leads and unrelated conversations from receiving the wrong message.


11. WhatsApp Completion Tag
After sending or confirming the transition message:
Confirm that the correct client received the message.
Add the agreed completion tag to the WhatsApp chat.
Keep the original “Batphone” tag.
Do not delete the chat.
Do not leave the group.
Update the tracker.
A clear completion tag could be:
BatPhone – Transitioned
Jerold should confirm the exact tag name before Cy starts so the same label is used across all conversations.


12. Quality Check Before Marking a Client Complete
Confirm all of the following:
The client is listed in the ClickUp Active List.
The correct WhatsApp conversation was opened.
The conversation has the “Batphone” tag.
The person is not an internal GIM contact or potential client.
The previous conversation was reviewed.
The same transition message was not sent twice.
The client’s name was spelled correctly.
coaching@risewise.com.au was written correctly.
Ivan was introduced as the Client Success Manager.
No unsupported promise or advice was given.
Any active concern was routed correctly.
The WhatsApp completion tag was added.
The tracker was updated.


13. Task Completion
A client is complete when:
Their active status has been confirmed in ClickUp.
Their WhatsApp conversation has been searched.
The BatPhone conversation and tag have been verified.
The transition message has either been sent or confirmed as previously sent.
The completion tag has been applied.
The tracker has been updated.
Any active concern has been escalated appropriately.
The overall task is complete once every client in the ClickUp Active List has been reviewed and recorded in the BatPhone Transition Tracker.


14. Daily Update Format
BatPhone Transition Update
Clients reviewed: [number]
 Transition messages sent: [number]
 Previously informed and tagged: [number]
 No BatPhone conversations found: [number]
 BatPhone tags missing: [number]
 Client concerns sent to Ivan: [number]
 Payment or access concerns sent to Jerold/Divine: [number]
 Clients still to review: [number]
Notes/blockers:
 [Add unclear cases, missing access or clients requiring confirmation.]


(Optional) Tracker Cy Can Copy Into Google Sheets
Client Name | Active in ClickUp | BatPhone Chat Found | BatPhone Tag Confirmed | Message Already Sent | Action Taken | Date Reviewed | Status | Notes
Cy should first copy all names from the ClickUp Active List into the first column, then work through them one by one.

description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough
📹 [Insert Loom or walkthrough link here]
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates

 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment
 📂 Keep all databases updated immediately after payment completion

🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo

🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.

 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance

💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments

 4 days before the next invoice due date

 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice

 Divine

description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough
📹 [Insert Loom or walkthrough link here]
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates
 💳 Verify payoff amount carefully before creating payment links
 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment
 📂 Keep all databases updated immediately after payment completion

This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.

 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.

 ✅ Have successful recurring payments

📊 SOP: Updating the Scale Calculator
🎯 Purpose
Ensure the Scale Calculator is updated daily with accurate data across sales, leads, ads, and bookings.
📍 Location
Open the Scale Calculator under RiseWise Bookmark in the Info Email.

⏰ Daily Rule
This must be completed daily to avoid backlog and ensure data accuracy.
📅 Step 1: Open Correct Month Tab
Go to the specific month tab you are updating.

🔵 Step 2: Update All Blue Cells (Manual Input Required)
All blue-highlighted cells require manual tracking. Below are the sections you need to complete:
💰 Total Cash Collected
 Source: Stripe
 Pull total collected amount

📈 Playbook Sales
Formula:
Total Stripe Payments - Row 6
Ensure playbook purchases are separated correctly.

💳 Stripe Payments
 Adjust date range
 Verify transactions
 Less any playbook purchases

⚠️ Note:
 Stripe follows PH time, so input yesterday’s data to ensure all transactions are captured.
Also, since PB normally in USD Stripe total automatically convert it to AUD hence formula is much easier.

Go to Ads Manager (Divine’s profile)
🎯 Tailored Leads

Leads go directly to Fit Check Calendar
If turned off, leave it blank
📥 Download Free Tools

📘 Playbook Leads
 Include all campaigns related to Playbook


💸 Advertising Spend
 Go to Ads Manager
 Scroll to bottom

⚠️ Note: If theres sale, identify source of lead in GHL and add client's name in comment. Once completed, put  in their EOD.

Do this daily to keep reporting clean and avoid backlog.

📋 SOP – Check Database: Update Scale & Coaching Tracker
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Update Scale & Coaching Tracker
🎯 Overview
Divine is responsible for maintaining and updating the Scale & Coaching Calls Tracker to ensure accurate attendance records for all coaching and scale sessions.
This process helps the team:
 ✅ Monitor client participation
 ✅ Track coaching engagement
 ✅ Maintain organized attendance records
 ✅ Ensure coaching data is updated weekly
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open the Tracker
📂 Go to:
 Scale & Coaching Calls Tracker 
2️⃣ Get and Update Attendance Report
📂 Open the attendance records from:
 Attend Onboarding & Coaching Sessions 
Use the meeting screenshots and attendance tracking to verify client participation.
🗓️ Update attendance based on the session date only.
⚠️ Important Notes:
 The tracker does not require specific session names 
 There may be multiple coaching sessions in one day 
 Once a client attends at least one session on that date, mark them as: 
 ✅ Attended 
Only one attendance tag is needed per client per date.

➕ If no more attendance columns are available:

 🗓️ Label each column with the correct weekly session dates 
4️⃣ Double Check Entries
🔍 Ensure:
 Correct spelling of client names 
 Attendance is marked under the correct date 
 No attendees are missed 
 Duplicate entries are avoided 
📆 Weekly Tasks
5️⃣ Identify Inactive Coaching Clients
🔍 Review the tracker weekly to identify clients who have:
 Missed coaching calls for 2 or more consecutive weeks 
 Update status to Inactive (formerly Endorsed) 
📧 Trigger email check-ins for inactive clients to:
 Re-engage them 
 Check their progress 
 Encourage them to attend upcoming coaching sessions 
 Book a 1:1 with the coaches 

⚠️ Important Notes
⏳ Update the tracker immediately after each coaching session
 📂 Keep attendance screenshots organized for future reference
 📝 Maintain consistent formatting across all new columns added
 ✅ Accuracy is important as this tracker is used for monitoring client engagement and coaching participation

title: Check Database: Roll Out Promo
description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough
📹 [Insert Loom or walkthrough link here]
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates
 💳 Verify payoff amount carefully before creating payment links
 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment
 📂 Keep all databases updated immediately after payment completion

description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough

✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates
 💳 Verify payoff amount carefully before creating payment links
 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment

description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough
📹 [Insert Loom or walkthrough link here]
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates
 💳 Verify payoff amount carefully before creating payment links
 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment
 📂 Keep all databases updated immediately after payment completion

description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice

📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine

Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly

6️⃣ Confirm Payment

 Verify successful payment in Stripe

Ensure:

title: Won Client Onboarding + Send Tax Invoice
description:
📋 SOP – Won Client Onboarding + Send Tax Invoice
🏷️ Task Name
Won Client Onboarding + Send Tax Invoice
🎯 Overview
This SOP outlines the onboarding process for all newly signed Risewise clients after payment confirmation.
The goal is to ensure every client is:
 ✅ Properly onboarded
 ✅ Added to all required systems
 ✅ Invited to coaching resources and communication channels
 ✅ Given access to support and onboarding materials
 ✅ Set up for a smooth onboarding experience
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Confirm Payment
💳 Check Stripe for successful payment confirmation.
Ensure:
 Payment is successful 
 Client name matches sales records 
 Payment type is identified: 
 Payment Plan 
 Paid in Full (PIF) 
2️⃣ Review Client Information
📂 Check GHL (Go High Level) for:
 Additional contact details 
 Email address 
 Sales notes 
 Offer/package details 
3️⃣ Update Client Notes
📝 Add the sales notes to:
 Client Description 
 Slack Won Client Thread 
Include:
 📌 Brand background
 📌 Goals
 📌 Concerns/challenges
 📌 Package details
 📌 Important context from the sales call
4️⃣ Check Low-Funnel Status
🔍 Verify if the client came from a Low-Funnel ticket using:
 GHL 
 Stripe (Playbooks)
⚠️ If NO:
 Proceed with standard onboarding process 
5️⃣ Upload Contract
📄 Upload the signed contract to the appropriate client storage/database.
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct client name
 ✅ Correct program
6️⃣ Create and Send Batphone Link
📱 Create the client’s Batphone access link.
Include the Batphone invite to the welcome email to send. 
7️⃣ Send Welcome Email
📧 Send the onboarding welcome email via Divine.
Include:
 📌 Batphone access link
 📌 Milestone Tracker
 📌 Relevant onboarding instructions
 📌 Kick-off session information
8️⃣ Invite to Group Kick-off Session
🚀 Add the client to the next available Group Kick-off Session.
Ensure:
 ✅ Calendar invite is sent
 ✅ Correct timezone is used
 ✅ Zoom details are included
9️⃣ Arrange 1:1 Session (If Applicable)
📅 If the client package includes a 1:1 session: 
Kickstarter/Momentum and PIF clients
Email the client to arrange scheduling 
🔟 Invite Client to Skool
🎓 Send the Skool community invitation.
Ensure the client receives:
 ✅ Correct access link
 ✅ Instructions for joining
1️⃣1️⃣ Add Client to All Databases
📂 Add the client to all required internal trackers and databases.
Examples may include:
 📌 Active Client List
 📌 Coaching Tracker
 📌 Payment Tracker
 📌 Client CRM
 📌 Milestone Tracker
 📌 Slack/Internal systems
1️⃣2️⃣ Send Tax Invoice / Payment Receipt (PIF Clients)
💰 For Paid in Full clients only:
 Send Tax Invoice and/or Payment Receipt via email 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct amount
 ✅ Correct client details
 ✅ Proper attachment included
💬 Batphone Welcome Message
Hi [Name], this is your direct line to Joel and Elise, our Founder Success Coach, where you can ask questions, get feedback, and stay on track throughout your journey with launching your brand!
If you need quick advice, clarification, or just want to share your wins, we’re here to help! 🚀
📚 SOP References

📌

Checked GHL for additional contact, email, & sales note
Added sales notes in Client description & Slack Won Client thread
Checked if client is from Low-Funnel ticket in GHL & Stripe. NO
Contract uploaded
Created & sent Batphone link
Sent welcome email via Divine (Batphone & Milestone Tracker)
Invited to Group Kick-off session
Invited to Skool

description:
📅 SOP: Scheduling Joel’s Coaching Calls & Kick-Off Sessions
🔁 Frequency: Daily
👤 Owner: Divine / Operations
📩 Primary Channel: Divine’s RiseWise email (for clear communication footprint)
🎯 Purpose
Ensure all Joel coaching calls, 1:1 sessions, and kick-off sessions are:
Scheduled correctly
Communicated clearly
Tracked consistently
📌 Call Types

🧩 Call Type ⏱ Duration 👤 Who It's For 📍 When to Use
🧠 30-Min Coaching 30 mins Clients requesting extra support Only when specifically requested and after referral to Alana or Rodney
📈 1:1 Strategy Session 30–45 mins Launch PIF / contract-based clients If included in contract
🚀 1:1 Onboarding 45 mins PIF clients At start of program
🔥 Kickstarter Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Kickstarter clients After Group Kick-Off
📊 Momentum Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Momentum clients After Group Kick-Off
👥 Group Kick-Off Sessions
Weekly Schedule (Melbourne Time):
🗓 Wednesday – 5:00 PM
🔁 Standard Client Flow (Launch)
Group Kick-Off → Group Glo Up
⚠️ If Client Misses Kick-Off
➡️ Schedule 1:1 Kick-Off with Rodney
➡️ Send email template with Rodney’s booking link
➡️ Follow up with Rodney to confirm once the 1:1 Kick-Off has been completed
⚙️ Scheduling Rules
🎥 For ALL 1:1 Sessions with Joel
Must be created via Zoom
Generate a unique meeting link
🔁 For Kick-Off Sessions
Duplicate existing Google Calendar event
Reuse same Zoom link
❌ Exception: 1:1 PIF Onboarding (create new)
🧩 Process Flow
1️⃣ Identify client program + entitlement
2️⃣ Confirm correct session type
3️⃣ Reach out via Divine’s RiseWise email
4️⃣ Offer / confirm schedule
5️⃣ Set up session:
     ➡️ 1:1 → Zoom + Calendar
     ➡️ Kick-Off → Duplicate Calendar event
6️⃣ Send calendar invite
7️⃣ Log session in ClickUp
8️⃣ Update status after session
📊 Tracking Requirement
📍 After each session:
➡️ Simply update the task (client name) status in ClickUp
🧠 Key Reminders
📩 Always use Divine’s email for comms (centralised trail) | CC closers and Elise 
🎯 Double check program before scheduling
⚡ Book sessions ASAP after request
🧼 Clean tracking = smoother ops and reporting

title: Check Database: Roll Out Promo
description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough
📹 [Insert Loom or walkthrough link here]
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates
 💳 Verify payoff amount carefully before creating payment links
 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment
 📂 Keep all databases updated immediately after payment completion

title: Check and respond to Risewise Skool messages
description:
📋 SOP – Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🏷️ Task Name
Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🎯 Overview
Divine is responsible for checking Skool notifications and messages related to Risewise, identifying any required actions, responding when needed, and keeping messages organized.
⚠️ Note: Divine’s Skool account is not limited to Risewise, so some notifications or messages may be unrelated. Only action Risewise-related items.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Skool
🌐 Go to Skool, bookmarked under the Divine Risewise profile.
2️⃣ Log In
🔐 Use the login details saved in the assigned credentials location.
3️⃣ Check Notifications
🔔 Click the notifications icon on the upper right side of the page.
4️⃣ Review Each Notification
🔍 Identify if the notification is related to Risewise and if action is needed.
✅ If Risewise-related and action is required:
 Respond or complete the required action 
📖 If Risewise-related but no action is needed:
 Mark as read 
🚫 If not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread and do not action 
5️⃣ Go to Messages
💬 Open the Messages section.
6️⃣ Respond and Complete Action Items
✍️ Review Risewise-related messages and respond accordingly.
✅ Ensure any required action items are completed, such as:
 📌 Answering client questions
 📌 Following up on requests
 📌 Updating trackers if needed
 📌 Escalating concerns to the appropriate team member
🚫 If the message is not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread 
7️⃣ Add Comments for Flagged Cases
🚩 Add a comment for any cases that may need attention or escalation.
Examples may include:
 ⚠️ Unhappy clients
 ⚠️ Refund concerns
 ⚠️ Missed coaching/onboarding concerns
 ⚠️ Technical issues
 ⚠️ Urgent follow-ups required
 ⚠️ Clients requesting direct support from Joel/Rodney/Elise
📌 Ensure comments are clear and include enough context for the team to review quickly.
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Only respond to Risewise-related notifications and messages
 📖 Mark Risewise-related completed items as read
 🚫 Leave non-Risewise notifications/messages unread
 🔍 Double-check if action is needed before marking anything as read
 📌 Complete all related action items before moving to the next message

title: Update Scale Calculator
description:
📊 SOP: Updating the Scale Calculator
🎯 Purpose
Ensure the Scale Calculator is updated daily with accurate data across sales, leads, ads, and bookings.
📍 Location
Open the Scale Calculator under RiseWise Bookmark in the Info Email.

⏰ Daily Rule
This must be completed daily to avoid backlog and ensure data accuracy.
📅 Step 1: Open Correct Month Tab
Go to the specific month tab you are updating.

🔵 Step 2: Update All Blue Cells (Manual Input Required)
All blue-highlighted cells require manual tracking. Below are the sections you need to complete:
💰 Total Cash Collected
 Source: Stripe
 Pull total collected amount

📈 Playbook Sales
Formula:
Total Stripe Payments - Row 6
Ensure playbook purchases are separated correctly.

💳 Stripe Payments
 Adjust date range
 Verify transactions
 Less any playbook purchases

⚠️ Note:
 Stripe follows PH time, so input yesterday’s data to ensure all transactions are captured.
Also, since PB normally in USD Stripe total automatically convert it to AUD hence formula is much easier. 
📧 Email Leads
 Input only if you handled Joel’s email that day
 Leave blank if none
📣 Meta Ads Campaign Leads
Go to Ads Manager (Divine’s profile)
🎯 Tailored Leads
 Campaign: TAILORED LEADS FOR TRIAGE BOOK
Leads go directly to Fit Check Calendar
If turned off, leave it blank
📥 Download Free Tools
 Campaign: Download Free Tools - FB Form
 Leads go to GHL Slack Notification
📘 Playbook Leads
 Include all campaigns related to Playbook


💸 Advertising Spend
 Go to Ads Manager
 Scroll to bottom
 Input total Facebook ad spend


🤝 Sales Team Data
 Source: Sales Team EOD Report
⚠️ Note: If theres sale, identify source of lead in GHL and add client's name in comment. Once completed, put  in their EOD. 


📞 Alana 1:1 Tracker
 Source: Alana’s Calendly
 Adjust based on no-show/cancelled updates via WhatsApp

💬 DM Setters
 Source: Kim’s EOD Report
⚠️ Note: Once completed, put  in their EOD. 

✅ Final Check
Before closing:
✔ All blue cells updated
 ✔ Dates are correct
 ✔ Playbook sales excluded properly
 ✔ Data is from latest sources
🔁 Reminder
Do this daily to keep reporting clean and avoid backlog.

title: Schedule Joel's Coaching Calls & Kickoffs
description:
📅 SOP: Scheduling Joel’s Coaching Calls & Kick-Off Sessions
🔁 Frequency: Daily
👤 Owner: Divine / Operations
📩 Primary Channel: Divine’s RiseWise email (for clear communication footprint)
🎯 Purpose
Ensure all Joel coaching calls, 1:1 sessions, and kick-off sessions are:
Scheduled correctly
Communicated clearly
Tracked consistently
📌 Call Types

🧩 Call Type ⏱ Duration 👤 Who It's For 📍 When to Use
🧠 30-Min Coaching 30 mins Clients requesting extra support Only when specifically requested and after referral to Alana or Rodney
📈 1:1 Strategy Session 30–45 mins Launch PIF / contract-based clients If included in contract
🚀 1:1 Onboarding 45 mins PIF clients At start of program
🔥 Kickstarter Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Kickstarter clients After Group Kick-Off
📊 Momentum Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Momentum clients After Group Kick-Off
👥 Group Kick-Off Sessions
Weekly Schedule (Melbourne Time):
🗓 Wednesday – 5:00 PM
🔁 Standard Client Flow (Launch)
Group Kick-Off → Group Glo Up
⚠️ If Client Misses Kick-Off
➡️ Schedule 1:1 Kick-Off with Rodney
➡️ Send email template with Rodney’s booking link
➡️ Follow up with Rodney to confirm once the 1:1 Kick-Off has been completed
⚙️ Scheduling Rules
🎥 For ALL 1:1 Sessions with Joel
Must be created via Zoom
Generate a unique meeting link
🔁 For Kick-Off Sessions
Duplicate existing Google Calendar event
Reuse same Zoom link
❌ Exception: 1:1 PIF Onboarding (create new)
🧩 Process Flow
1️⃣ Identify client program + entitlement
2️⃣ Confirm correct session type
3️⃣ Reach out via Divine’s RiseWise email
4️⃣ Offer / confirm schedule
5️⃣ Set up session:
     ➡️ 1:1 → Zoom + Calendar
     ➡️ Kick-Off → Duplicate Calendar event
6️⃣ Send calendar invite
7️⃣ Log session in ClickUp
8️⃣ Update status after session
📊 Tracking Requirement
📍 After each session:
➡️ Simply update the task (client name) status in ClickUp
🧠 Key Reminders
📩 Always use Divine’s email for comms (centralised trail) | CC closers and Elise 
🎯 Double check program before scheduling
⚡ Book sessions ASAP after request
🧼 Clean tracking = smoother ops and reporting

description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine

Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe

❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:

🎯 Purpose
Ensure the Scale Calculator is updated daily with accurate data across sales, leads, ads, and bookings.

Open the Scale Calculator under RiseWise Bookmark in the Info Email.

This must be completed daily to avoid backlog and ensure data accuracy.

🔵 Step 2: Update All Blue Cells (Manual Input Required)

 Source: Stripe
 Pull total collected amount

📈 Playbook Sales
Formula:
Total Stripe Payments - Row 6
Ensure playbook purchases are separated correctly.

💳 Stripe Payments
 Adjust date range
 Verify transactions
 Less any playbook purchases

⚠️ Note:
 Stripe follows PH time, so input yesterday’s data to ensure all transactions are captured.

Go to Ads Manager (Divine’s profile)
🎯 Tailored Leads

Leads go directly to Fit Check Calendar
If turned off, leave it blank
📥 Download Free Tools
 Campaign: Download Free Tools - FB Form
 Leads go to GHL Slack Notification
📘 Playbook Leads
 Include all campaigns related to Playbook


💸 Advertising Spend
 Go to Ads Manager
 Scroll to bottom
 Input total Facebook ad spend

 Source: Sales Team EOD Report
⚠️ Note: If theres sale, identify source of lead in GHL and add client's name in comment. Once completed, put  in their EOD.

 Source: Alana’s Calendly
 Adjust based on no-show/cancelled updates via WhatsApp

💬 DM Setters
 Source: Kim’s EOD Report
⚠️ Note: Once completed, put  in their EOD. 

✅ Final Check
Before closing:
✔ All blue cells updated

🔁 Reminder
Do this daily to keep reporting clean and avoid backlog.

🔔 Click the notifications icon on the upper right side of the page.

✅ If Risewise-related and action is required:

📖 If Risewise-related but no action is needed:
 Mark as read 
🚫 If not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread and do not action

💬 Open the Messages section.

title: Check Database: Roll Out Promo
description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough
📹 [Insert Loom or walkthrough link here]
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates
 💳 Verify payoff amount carefully before creating payment links
 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment
 📂 Keep all databases updated immediately after payment completion

 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards

⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.

💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards

 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice

🔁 Frequency: Daily
👤 Owner: Divine / Operations
📩 Primary Channel: Divine’s RiseWise email (for clear communication footprint)
🎯 Purpose
Ensure all Joel coaching calls, 1:1 sessions, and kick-off sessions are:
Scheduled correctly
Communicated clearly
Tracked consistently
📌 Call Types

🧩 Call Type ⏱ Duration 👤 Who It's For 📍 When to Use
🧠 30-Min Coaching 30 mins Clients requesting extra support Only when specifically requested and after referral to Alana or Rodney
📈 1:1 Strategy Session 30–45 mins Launch PIF / contract-based clients If included in contract
🚀 1:1 Onboarding 45 mins PIF clients At start of program
🔥 Kickstarter Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Kickstarter clients After Group Kick-Off
📊 Momentum Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Momentum clients After Group Kick-Off
👥 Group Kick-Off Sessions
Weekly Schedule (Melbourne Time):
🗓 Tuesday – 9:30 AM
🗓 Wednesday – 5:00 PM
🔁 Standard Client Flow (Launch)
Group Kick-Off → Group Glo Up
⚠️ If Client Misses Kick-Off
➡️ Schedule 1:1 Kick-Off with Rodney
➡️ Send email template with Rodney’s booking link
➡️ Follow up with Rodney to confirm once the 1:1 Kick-Off has been completed
⚙️ Scheduling Rules
🎥 For ALL 1:1 Sessions with Joel
Must be created via Zoom
Generate a unique meeting link
🔁 For Kick-Off Sessions
Duplicate existing Google Calendar event
Reuse same Zoom link
❌ Exception: 1:1 PIF Onboarding (create new)
🧩 Process Flow
1️⃣ Identify client program + entitlement
2️⃣ Confirm correct session type
3️⃣ Reach out via Divine’s RiseWise email
4️⃣ Offer / confirm schedule
5️⃣ Set up session:
     ➡️ 1:1 → Zoom + Calendar
     ➡️ Kick-Off → Duplicate Calendar event
6️⃣ Send calendar invite
7️⃣ Log session in ClickUp
8️⃣ Update status after session
📊 Tracking Requirement
📍 After each session:
➡️ Simply update the task (client name) status in ClickUp
🧠 Key Reminders
📩 Always use Divine’s email for comms (centralised trail) | CC closers and Elise 
🎯 Double check program before scheduling
⚡ Book sessions ASAP after request
🧼 Clean tracking = smoother ops and reporting

Check Database: Roll Out Promo

This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.

 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.

 Roll Out Promo

 ✅ Invoice history

 ✅ Remaining balance

💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments

 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice

 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template

 Divine

🔔 Click the notifications icon on the upper right side of the page.

🔍 Identify if the notification is related to Risewise and if action is needed.

 Leave unread

 ⚠️ Unhappy clients

 ⚠️ Clients requesting direct support from Joel/Rodney/Elise

🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices

⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.

Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments

Divine is responsible for maintaining and updating the Scale & Coaching Calls Tracker to ensure accurate attendance records for all coaching and scale sessions.

 ✅ Monitor client participation

 Attend Onboarding & Coaching Sessions 
Use the meeting screenshots and attendance tracking to verify client participation.
🗓️ Update attendance based on the session date only.
⚠️ Important Notes:
 The tracker does not require specific session names 
 There may be multiple coaching sessions in one day 
 Once a client attends at least one session on that date, mark them as: 
 ✅ Attended 
Only one attendance tag is needed per client per date.

🏆 Win of the Week w/ Rodney

🔍 Ensure:
 Correct spelling of client names 
 Attendance is marked under the correct date 
 No attendees are missed 
 Duplicate entries are avoided 
📆 Weekly Tasks
5️⃣ Identify Inactive Coaching Clients
🔍 Review the tracker weekly to identify clients who have:
 Missed coaching calls for 2 or more consecutive weeks 
 Update status to Inactive (formerly Endorsed) 
📧 Trigger email check-ins for inactive clients to:
 Re-engage them 
 Check their progress 
 Encourage them to attend upcoming coaching sessions 
 Book a 1:1 with the coaches

📋 SOP – Check Database: Update Scale & Coaching Tracker
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Update Scale & Coaching Tracker
🎯 Overview
Divine is responsible for maintaining and updating the Scale & Coaching Calls Tracker to ensure accurate attendance records for all coaching and scale sessions.
This process helps the team:
 ✅ Monitor client participation
 ✅ Track coaching engagement
 ✅ Maintain organized attendance records
 ✅ Ensure coaching data is updated weekly
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open the Tracker
📂 Go to:
 Scale & Coaching Calls Tracker 
2️⃣ Get and Update Attendance Report
📂 Open the attendance records from:
 Attend Onboarding & Coaching Sessions 
Use the meeting screenshots and attendance tracking to verify client participation.
🗓️ Update attendance based on the session date only.
⚠️ Important Notes:
 The tracker does not require specific session names 
 There may be multiple coaching sessions in one day 
 Once a client attends at least one session on that date, mark them as: 
 ✅ Attended 
Only one attendance tag is needed per client per date.
🎯 Coaching Sessions Included
🏆 Win of the Week w/ Rodney
 ❓ Q&A w/ Joel
 📚 Coaching & Scale Sessions w/ Joel
 🎨 Fashion Design w/ Alana
 📖 Brandbook Review w/ Rodney
3️⃣ Add New Weekly Columns if Needed
➕ If no more attendance columns are available:
 Add 4 new columns manually 
 🗓️ Label each column with the correct weekly session dates 
4️⃣ Double Check Entries
🔍 Ensure:
 Correct spelling of client names 
 Attendance is marked under the correct date 
 No attendees are missed 
 Duplicate entries are avoided 
📆 Weekly Tasks
5️⃣ Identify Inactive Coaching Clients
🔍 Review the tracker weekly to identify clients who have:
 Missed coaching calls for 2 or more consecutive weeks 
 Update status to Inactive (formerly Endorsed) 
📧 Trigger email check-ins for inactive clients to:
 Re-engage them 
 Check their progress 
 Encourage them to attend upcoming coaching sessions 
 Book a 1:1 with the coaches 

⚠️ Important Notes
⏳ Update the tracker immediately after each coaching session
 📂 Keep attendance screenshots organized for future reference

title: Check Database: Roll Out Promo
description:
📋 SOP – Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Roll Out Promo
🎯 Overview
This task is for monitoring eligible monthly subscription clients who may qualify for the 10% Full Contract Payoff Offer.
The goal is to:
 ✅ Reward good-paying subscription members
 ✅ Encourage early contract payoff
 ✅ Reduce long-term subscription management
 ✅ Keep Stripe subscriptions updated accurately
✅ Eligibility Criteria
A client is eligible if:
 ✅ They are on a monthly subscription
 ✅ They have NO failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
 ✅ They are approaching the 3rd invoice or later invoices
 ✅ They are NOT yet on the second-to-the-last invoice
⚠️ Clients with failed payments are NOT eligible.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Roll Out Promo Database
📂 Go to:
 Roll Out Promo 
2️⃣ Check New Status Entries
🔍 Ensure all required client information is added under the New status.
Verify:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Email address
 ✅ Current payment plan status
 ✅ Invoice history
 ✅ Next invoice due date
 ✅ Remaining balance
3️⃣ Identify Eligible Clients
💳 Review the client’s Stripe payment history.
Eligible clients must:
 ✅ Have successful recurring payments
 ✅ Have no failed payments from the 2nd invoice onwards
📅 Initial or follow-up outreach date should be:
 4 days before the next invoice due date 
 Starting from the 3rd invoice onwards 
 Until before the second-to-the-last invoice 
4️⃣ Send Full Payoff Offer
📧 Use the:
 Risewise Full Contract Payoff Offer email template 
✍️ Edit necessary information including:
 ✅ Client name
 ✅ Remaining balance
 ✅ Discounted payoff amount
 ✅ Payment instructions
📤 Send the email as:
 Divine 
5️⃣ Create Payment Link (If Availed)
💰 If the client accepts the offer:
Create a Stripe payment link for:
 The discounted remaining balance 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct balance amount
 ✅ Discount applied correctly
 ✅ Payment link is active before sending
6️⃣ Confirm Payment
🔍 Once payment is completed:
 Verify successful payment in Stripe 
7️⃣ Cancel Subscription
❌ Cancel the client’s active Stripe subscription to prevent future charges.
Ensure:
 ✅ Subscription is fully canceled
 ✅ No future invoices remain active
8️⃣ Remove Client from Stripe Database
📂 Update internal records and remove the client from:
 Active Stripe Subscription Database 
Ensure all trackers reflect:
 ✅ Paid Out / Completed Status
🎥 Demo / Walkthrough
📹 [Insert Loom or walkthrough link here]
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Double-check payment history before offering the promo
 🚫 Do not offer promo to clients with failed recurring payments
 📅 Follow-up dates should always align with invoice due dates
 💳 Verify payoff amount carefully before creating payment links
 ❌ Always cancel Stripe subscription after successful payoff payment
 📂 Keep all databases updated immediately after payment completion

title: Won Client Onboarding + Send Tax Invoice
description:
📋 SOP – Won Client Onboarding + Send Tax Invoice
🏷️ Task Name
Won Client Onboarding + Send Tax Invoice
🎯 Overview
This SOP outlines the onboarding process for all newly signed Risewise clients after payment confirmation.
The goal is to ensure every client is:
 ✅ Properly onboarded
 ✅ Added to all required systems
 ✅ Invited to coaching resources and communication channels
 ✅ Given access to support and onboarding materials
 ✅ Set up for a smooth onboarding experience
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Confirm Payment
💳 Check Stripe for successful payment confirmation.
Ensure:
 Payment is successful 
 Client name matches sales records 
 Payment type is identified: 
 Payment Plan 
 Paid in Full (PIF) 
2️⃣ Review Client Information
📂 Check GHL (Go High Level) for:
 Additional contact details 
 Email address 
 Sales notes 
 Offer/package details 
3️⃣ Update Client Notes
📝 Add the sales notes to:
 Client Description 
 Slack Won Client Thread 
Include:
 📌 Brand background
 📌 Goals
 📌 Concerns/challenges
 📌 Package details
 📌 Important context from the sales call
4️⃣ Check Low-Funnel Status
🔍 Verify if the client came from a Low-Funnel ticket using:
 GHL 
 Stripe (Playbooks)
⚠️ If NO:
 Proceed with standard onboarding process 
5️⃣ Upload Contract
📄 Upload the signed contract to the appropriate client storage/database.
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct client name
 ✅ Correct program
6️⃣ Create and Send Batphone Link
📱 Create the client’s Batphone access link.
Include the Batphone invite to the welcome email to send. 
7️⃣ Send Welcome Email
📧 Send the onboarding welcome email via Divine.
Include:
 📌 Batphone access link
 📌 Milestone Tracker
 📌 Relevant onboarding instructions
 📌 Kick-off session information
8️⃣ Invite to Group Kick-off Session
🚀 Add the client to the next available Group Kick-off Session.
Ensure:
 ✅ Calendar invite is sent
 ✅ Correct timezone is used
 ✅ Zoom details are included
9️⃣ Arrange 1:1 Session (If Applicable)
📅 If the client package includes a 1:1 session: 
Kickstarter/Momentum and PIF clients
Email the client to arrange scheduling 
🔟 Invite Client to Skool
🎓 Send the Skool community invitation.
Ensure the client receives:
 ✅ Correct access link
 ✅ Instructions for joining
1️⃣1️⃣ Add Client to All Databases
📂 Add the client to all required internal trackers and databases.
Examples may include:
 📌 Active Client List
 📌 Coaching Tracker
 📌 Payment Tracker
 📌 Client CRM
 📌 Milestone Tracker
 📌 Slack/Internal systems
1️⃣2️⃣ Send Tax Invoice / Payment Receipt (PIF Clients)

 Send Tax Invoice and/or Payment Receipt via email 
Ensure:
 ✅ Correct amount

If you need quick advice, clarification, or just want to share your wins, we’re here to help! 🚀

title: Check and respond to Risewise Skool messages
description:
📋 SOP – Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🏷️ Task Name
Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🎯 Overview
Divine is responsible for checking Skool notifications and messages related to Risewise, identifying any required actions, responding when needed, and keeping messages organized.
⚠️ Note: Divine’s Skool account is not limited to Risewise, so some notifications or messages may be unrelated. Only action Risewise-related items.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Skool
🌐 Go to Skool, bookmarked under the Divine Risewise profile.
2️⃣ Log In
🔐 Use the login details saved in the assigned credentials location.
3️⃣ Check Notifications
🔔 Click the notifications icon on the upper right side of the page.
4️⃣ Review Each Notification
🔍 Identify if the notification is related to Risewise and if action is needed.
✅ If Risewise-related and action is required:
 Respond or complete the required action 
📖 If Risewise-related but no action is needed:
 Mark as read 
🚫 If not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread and do not action 
5️⃣ Go to Messages
💬 Open the Messages section.
6️⃣ Respond and Complete Action Items
✍️ Review Risewise-related messages and respond accordingly.
✅ Ensure any required action items are completed, such as:
 📌 Answering client questions
 📌 Following up on requests
 📌 Updating trackers if needed
 📌 Escalating concerns to the appropriate team member
🚫 If the message is not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread 
7️⃣ Add Comments for Flagged Cases
🚩 Add a comment for any cases that may need attention or escalation.
Examples may include:
 ⚠️ Unhappy clients
 ⚠️ Refund concerns
 ⚠️ Missed coaching/onboarding concerns
 ⚠️ Technical issues
 ⚠️ Urgent follow-ups required
 ⚠️ Clients requesting direct support from Joel/Rodney/Elise
📌 Ensure comments are clear and include enough context for the team to review quickly.
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Only respond to Risewise-related notifications and messages
 📖 Mark Risewise-related completed items as read
 🚫 Leave non-Risewise notifications/messages unread
 🔍 Double-check if action is needed before marking anything as read
 📌 Complete all related action items before moving to the next message

Total Stripe Payments - Row 6

✅ Final Check
Before closing:
✔ All blue cells updated

 ✔ Playbook sales excluded properly
 ✔ Data is from latest sources
🔁 Reminder
Do this daily to keep reporting clean and avoid backlog.

description:
📋 SOP – Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🏷️ Task Name
Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🎯 Overview
Divine is responsible for checking Skool notifications and messages related to Risewise, identifying any required actions, responding when needed, and keeping messages organized.
⚠️ Note: Divine’s Skool account is not limited to Risewise, so some notifications or messages may be unrelated. Only action Risewise-related items.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Skool
🌐 Go to Skool, bookmarked under the Divine Risewise profile.
2️⃣ Log In
🔐 Use the login details saved in the assigned credentials location.
3️⃣ Check Notifications
🔔 Click the notifications icon on the upper right side of the page.
4️⃣ Review Each Notification
🔍 Identify if the notification is related to Risewise and if action is needed.
✅ If Risewise-related and action is required:
 Respond or complete the required action 
📖 If Risewise-related but no action is needed:
 Mark as read 
🚫 If not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread and do not action 
5️⃣ Go to Messages
💬 Open the Messages section.
6️⃣ Respond and Complete Action Items
✍️ Review Risewise-related messages and respond accordingly.
✅ Ensure any required action items are completed, such as:
 📌 Answering client questions
 📌 Following up on requests
 📌 Updating trackers if needed
 📌 Escalating concerns to the appropriate team member
🚫 If the message is not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread 
7️⃣ Add Comments for Flagged Cases
🚩 Add a comment for any cases that may need attention or escalation.
Examples may include:
 ⚠️ Unhappy clients
 ⚠️ Refund concerns
 ⚠️ Missed coaching/onboarding concerns
 ⚠️ Technical issues
 ⚠️ Urgent follow-ups required
 ⚠️ Clients requesting direct support from Joel/Rodney/Elise
📌 Ensure comments are clear and include enough context for the team to review quickly.
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Only respond to Risewise-related notifications and messages
 📖 Mark Risewise-related completed items as read
 🚫 Leave non-Risewise notifications/messages unread
 🔍 Double-check if action is needed before marking anything as read
 📌 Complete all related action items before moving to the next message

📋 SOP – Check Database: Update Scale & Coaching Tracker
🏷️ Task Name
Check Database: Update Scale & Coaching Tracker
🎯 Overview
Divine is responsible for maintaining and updating the Scale & Coaching Calls Tracker to ensure accurate attendance records for all coaching and scale sessions.
This process helps the team:
 ✅ Monitor client participation
 ✅ Track coaching engagement
 ✅ Maintain organized attendance records
 ✅ Ensure coaching data is updated weekly
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open the Tracker
📂 Go to:
 Scale & Coaching Calls Tracker 
2️⃣ Get and Update Attendance Report
📂 Open the attendance records from:
 Attend Onboarding & Coaching Sessions 
Use the meeting screenshots and attendance tracking to verify client participation.
🗓️ Update attendance based on the session date only.
⚠️ Important Notes:
 The tracker does not require specific session names 
 There may be multiple coaching sessions in one day 
 Once a client attends at least one session on that date, mark them as: 
 ✅ Attended 
Only one attendance tag is needed per client per date.
🎯 Coaching Sessions Included
🏆 Win of the Week w/ Rodney
 ❓ Q&A w/ Joel
 📚 Coaching & Scale Sessions w/ Joel
 🎨 Fashion Design w/ Alana
 📖 Brandbook Review w/ Rodney
3️⃣ Add New Weekly Columns if Needed
➕ If no more attendance columns are available:
 Add 4 new columns manually 
 🗓️ Label each column with the correct weekly session dates 
4️⃣ Double Check Entries
🔍 Ensure:
 Correct spelling of client names 
 Attendance is marked under the correct date 
 No attendees are missed 
 Duplicate entries are avoided 
📆 Weekly Tasks
5️⃣ Identify Inactive Coaching Clients
🔍 Review the tracker weekly to identify clients who have:
 Missed coaching calls for 2 or more consecutive weeks 
 Update status to Inactive (formerly Endorsed) 
📧 Trigger email check-ins for inactive clients to:
 Re-engage them 
 Check their progress 
 Encourage them to attend upcoming coaching sessions 
 Book a 1:1 with the coaches 

⚠️ Important Notes
⏳ Update the tracker immediately after each coaching session
 📂 Keep attendance screenshots organized for future reference
 📝 Maintain consistent formatting across all new columns added
 ✅ Accuracy is important as this tracker is used for monitoring client engagement and coaching participation

title: Update Scale Calculator
description:
📊 SOP: Updating the Scale Calculator
🎯 Purpose
Ensure the Scale Calculator is updated daily with accurate data across sales, leads, ads, and bookings.
📍 Location
Open the Scale Calculator under RiseWise Bookmark in the Info Email.

⏰ Daily Rule
This must be completed daily to avoid backlog and ensure data accuracy.
📅 Step 1: Open Correct Month Tab
Go to the specific month tab you are updating.

🔵 Step 2: Update All Blue Cells (Manual Input Required)
All blue-highlighted cells require manual tracking. Below are the sections you need to complete:
💰 Total Cash Collected
 Source: Stripe
 Pull total collected amount

📈 Playbook Sales
Formula:
Total Stripe Payments - Row 6
Ensure playbook purchases are separated correctly.

💳 Stripe Payments
 Adjust date range
 Verify transactions
 Less any playbook purchases

⚠️ Note:
 Stripe follows PH time, so input yesterday’s data to ensure all transactions are captured.
Also, since PB normally in USD Stripe total automatically convert it to AUD hence formula is much easier. 
📧 Email Leads
 Input only if you handled Joel’s email that day
 Leave blank if none
📣 Meta Ads Campaign Leads
Go to Ads Manager (Divine’s profile)
🎯 Tailored Leads
 Campaign: TAILORED LEADS FOR TRIAGE BOOK
Leads go directly to Fit Check Calendar
If turned off, leave it blank
📥 Download Free Tools
 Campaign: Download Free Tools - FB Form
 Leads go to GHL Slack Notification
📘 Playbook Leads
 Include all campaigns related to Playbook


💸 Advertising Spend
 Go to Ads Manager
 Scroll to bottom
 Input total Facebook ad spend


🤝 Sales Team Data
 Source: Sales Team EOD Report
⚠️ Note: If theres sale, identify source of lead in GHL and add client's name in comment. Once completed, put  in their EOD. 


📞 Alana 1:1 Tracker
 Source: Alana’s Calendly
 Adjust based on no-show/cancelled updates via WhatsApp

💬 DM Setters
 Source: Kim’s EOD Report
⚠️ Note: Once completed, put  in their EOD. 

✅ Final Check
Before closing:
✔ All blue cells updated
 ✔ Dates are correct
 ✔ Playbook sales excluded properly
 ✔ Data is from latest sources
🔁 Reminder
Do this daily to keep reporting clean and avoid backlog.

title: Schedule Joel's Coaching Calls & Kickoffs
description:
📅 SOP: Scheduling Joel’s Coaching Calls & Kick-Off Sessions
🔁 Frequency: Daily
👤 Owner: Divine / Operations
📩 Primary Channel: Divine’s RiseWise email (for clear communication footprint)
🎯 Purpose
Ensure all Joel coaching calls, 1:1 sessions, and kick-off sessions are:
Scheduled correctly
Communicated clearly
Tracked consistently
📌 Call Types

🧩 Call Type ⏱ Duration 👤 Who It's For 📍 When to Use
🧠 30-Min Coaching 30 mins Clients requesting extra support Only when specifically requested and after referral to Alana or Rodney
📈 1:1 Strategy Session 30–45 mins Launch PIF / contract-based clients If included in contract
🚀 1:1 Onboarding 45 mins PIF clients At start of program
🔥 Kickstarter Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Kickstarter clients After Group Kick-Off
📊 Momentum Custom Intensive 45–60 mins Momentum clients After Group Kick-Off
👥 Group Kick-Off Sessions
Weekly Schedule (Melbourne Time):
🗓 Tuesday – 9:30 AM
🗓 Wednesday – 5:00 PM
🔁 Standard Client Flow (Launch)
Group Kick-Off → Group Glo Up
⚠️ If Client Misses Kick-Off
➡️ Schedule 1:1 Kick-Off with Rodney
➡️ Send email template with Rodney’s booking link
➡️ Follow up with Rodney to confirm once the 1:1 Kick-Off has been completed
⚙️ Scheduling Rules
🎥 For ALL 1:1 Sessions with Joel
Must be created via Zoom
Generate a unique meeting link
🔁 For Kick-Off Sessions
Duplicate existing Google Calendar event
Reuse same Zoom link
❌ Exception: 1:1 PIF Onboarding (create new)
🧩 Process Flow
1️⃣ Identify client program + entitlement
2️⃣ Confirm correct session type
3️⃣ Reach out via Divine’s RiseWise email
4️⃣ Offer / confirm schedule
5️⃣ Set up session:
     ➡️ 1:1 → Zoom + Calendar
     ➡️ Kick-Off → Duplicate Calendar event
6️⃣ Send calendar invite
7️⃣ Log session in ClickUp
8️⃣ Update status after session
📊 Tracking Requirement
📍 After each session:
➡️ Simply update the task (client name) status in ClickUp
🧠 Key Reminders
📩 Always use Divine’s email for comms (centralised trail) | CC closers and Elise 
🎯 Double check program before scheduling
⚡ Book sessions ASAP after request
🧼 Clean tracking = smoother ops and reporting

title: Check and respond to Risewise Skool messages
description:
📋 SOP – Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🏷️ Task Name
Check and Respond to Risewise Skool Messages
🎯 Overview
Divine is responsible for checking Skool notifications and messages related to Risewise, identifying any required actions, responding when needed, and keeping messages organized.
⚠️ Note: Divine’s Skool account is not limited to Risewise, so some notifications or messages may be unrelated. Only action Risewise-related items.
✅ Procedure
1️⃣ Open Skool
🌐 Go to Skool, bookmarked under the Divine Risewise profile.
2️⃣ Log In
🔐 Use the login details saved in the assigned credentials location.
3️⃣ Check Notifications
🔔 Click the notifications icon on the upper right side of the page.
4️⃣ Review Each Notification
🔍 Identify if the notification is related to Risewise and if action is needed.
✅ If Risewise-related and action is required:
 Respond or complete the required action 
📖 If Risewise-related but no action is needed:
 Mark as read 
🚫 If not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread and do not action 
5️⃣ Go to Messages
💬 Open the Messages section.
6️⃣ Respond and Complete Action Items
✍️ Review Risewise-related messages and respond accordingly.
✅ Ensure any required action items are completed, such as:
 📌 Answering client questions
 📌 Following up on requests
 📌 Updating trackers if needed
 📌 Escalating concerns to the appropriate team member
🚫 If the message is not related to Risewise:
 Leave unread 
7️⃣ Add Comments for Flagged Cases
🚩 Add a comment for any cases that may need attention or escalation.
Examples may include:
 ⚠️ Unhappy clients
 ⚠️ Refund concerns
 ⚠️ Missed coaching/onboarding concerns
 ⚠️ Technical issues
 ⚠️ Urgent follow-ups required
 ⚠️ Clients requesting direct support from Joel/Rodney/Elise
📌 Ensure comments are clear and include enough context for the team to review quickly.
⚠️ Important Notes
✅ Only respond to Risewise-related notifications and messages
 📖 Mark Risewise-related completed items as read
 🚫 Leave non-Risewise notifications/messages unread
 🔍 Double-check if action is needed before marking anything as read
 📌 Complete all related action items before moving to the next message

👤 Owner: Divine / Operations

Ensure all Joel coaching calls, 1:1 sessions, and kick-off sessions are:
Scheduled correctly
Communicated clearly
Tracked consistently
