title: Payroll Computation
description:
✅ Overview
This SOP explains the step-by-step process for computing payroll for YUM chatters. The goal is to make sure each chatter’s pay is calculated accurately based on verified hours, approved hourly rate, and qualified bonuses.
Payroll must always be based on checked and confirmed data from the official trackers. Do not guess or manually estimate any hours, rates, or bonuses.

✅ Task
Compute each chatter’s payroll by checking their verified working hours, calculating base pay, adding approved bonuses, and confirming the final total pay before submission or review.

✅ Tools Required
☐ ClickUp
☐ Chatters - Yum Hours Google Sheet
☐ VIP Top Chatters / Bonus Tracker
☐ Model’s Info Sheet
☐ Resub / Transfer Tracker
☐ KPI / Bonus Structure Tracker
☐ Calculator, if needed
☐ Slack, for confirmation or reporting

✅ Payroll Computation Checklist
1. Confirm the payroll period
Before starting the computation, make sure you are working on the correct payroll date or pay period.
☐ Check the payroll coverage date
☐ Confirm the correct week or cutoff period
☐ Make sure the ClickUp payroll table matches the same payroll period
☐ Do not start computation if the date or week is unclear

2. Open the payroll table in ClickUp
Go to ClickUp and open the correct payroll task, page, or table.
Check that the table includes the following columns:
☐ Name
☐ Rate
☐ Hours
☐ Base Pay
☐ Top Chatter Bonus
☐ Resub / Transfer Bonus
☐ KPI Bonus
☐ Total Pay
Make sure all active chatters for the payroll period are included in the table.

3. Check each chatter’s hourly rate
Review the Rate column for each chatter.
☐ Confirm that the hourly rate is already listed
☐ Do not change the rate unless there is an approved update
☐ If the rate is missing, ask for confirmation before computing
☐ If the rate looks incorrect, flag it before proceeding
Important: Never update a chatter’s rate based on memory. Always wait for confirmation from the manager or approved tracker.

4. Get verified working hours
Open the Chatters - Yum Hours Google Sheet.
Go to the correct weekly hours tab or checked hours section.
For each chatter:
☐ Locate the chatter’s name
☐ Check the correct payroll week
☐ Use the checked or verified total hours only
☐ Include approved overtime only if clearly noted
☐ Do not include unapproved or unclear hours
Copy the verified total hours into the Hours column in ClickUp.
Important: Use verified hours only. Do not use scheduled hours if they are not confirmed.

5. Calculate base pay
Compute each chatter’s base pay using this formula:
Base Pay = Hourly Rate x Verified Hours
Example:
Rate: $5.00
Verified Hours: 41
Base Pay: $205.00
Enter the result in the Base Pay column.
Checklist:
☐ Rate is correct
☐ Hours are verified
☐ Base pay calculation is accurate
☐ Amount is entered in the correct row

6. Check Top Chatter Bonus
Open the VIP Top Chatters or Bonus Tracker.
Go to the correct payweek or bonus section.
Check if the chatter qualified for a top chatter bonus.
Current bonus structure:
☐ Top 1 = $75
☐ Top 2 = $50
Enter the correct amount in the Top Chatter Bonus column.
If the chatter did not qualify, enter a dash or leave it blank based on the current payroll format.
Important: Only add this bonus if the chatter is clearly listed as qualified in the tracker.

7. Check Resub / Transfer Bonus
Open the Model’s Info Sheet or Resub / Transfer Tracker.
Review the entries within the payroll period.
For each chatter:
☐ Check if they have valid resub or transfer entries
☐ Confirm that the entries are within the correct date range
☐ Include only approved or validated entries
☐ Exclude pending, duplicate, unclear, or unapproved entries
Enter the approved amount in the Resub / Transfer Bonus column.
If there is no qualified bonus, enter a dash.

8. Check KPI Bonus
Open the KPI or Bonus Structure Tracker.
Check if each chatter qualified for a KPI bonus during the payroll period.
☐ Confirm the chatter’s KPI result
☐ Check if the bonus is approved
☐ Enter the correct KPI bonus amount
☐ Enter a dash if they did not qualify
Important: Do not add a KPI bonus unless it is confirmed in the tracker or approved by management.

9. Calculate total pay
Compute the final total pay using this formula:
Total Pay = Base Pay + Top Chatter Bonus + Resub / Transfer Bonus + KPI Bonus
Treat blank cells or dashes as zero.
Example:
Base Pay: $205.00
Top Chatter Bonus: $75.00
Resub / Transfer Bonus: $40.00
KPI Bonus: $0.00
Total Pay: $320.00
Enter the final amount in the Total Pay column.
Checklist:
☐ Base pay is added
☐ Top chatter bonus is added, if applicable
☐ Resub / transfer bonus is added, if applicable
☐ KPI bonus is added, if applicable
☐ Final total is correct

10. Compute team subtotal, if applicable
If the payroll table has a subtotal or team total row, compute the total for the full team.
☐ Add all chatter hours
☐ Add all base pay amounts
☐ Add all bonuses
☐ Add all final total pay amounts
☐ Make sure the subtotal matches the individual rows
Do not submit the payroll if the team total does not match the row-by-row computation.

11. Final payroll review
Before submitting or marking the payroll as ready, review everything one more time.
Final review checklist:
☐ Payroll period is correct
☐ All active chatters are included
☐ Removed or inactive chatters are not included unless they worked during the period
☐ Hourly rates are correct
☐ Hours match the verified Yum Hours sheet
☐ Base pay is calculated correctly
☐ Bonuses are added only when approved
☐ Dashes or blanks are treated as zero
☐ Total pay is accurate
☐ Team subtotal is accurate
☐ Any unclear item is flagged before submission

12. Submit for review
Once all payroll details are complete and checked:
☐ Update the ClickUp payroll table
☐ Mark the payroll task as ready for review, if applicable
☐ Notify the manager or payroll reviewer in Slack
☐ Mention any flagged items that need confirmation
Sample update:
Payroll computation is complete and ready for review. I also flagged the rows that need confirmation before final approval.

⚠️ Important Notes / Tips / Warnings
☐ Always use checked or verified hours only.
☐ Do not use scheduled hours unless they are confirmed.
☐ Do not guess missing hours, bonuses, or rates.
☐ Do not edit hourly rates unless there is an approved update.
☐ Only include overtime if it is clearly approved.
☐ Only include bonuses that are confirmed in the trackers.
☐ Always check the correct payroll period before computing.
☐ Review all totals before submitting.
☐ If anything is unclear, flag it first instead of assuming.
☐ Payroll errors can affect payout accuracy, so double-check every row carefully.

title: Timesheet & Resub/Transfer
description:
TIMESHEEET OVERVIEW
This SOP outlines the weekly process of validating individual chatter timesheets, cross-referencing them with Slack reports, and consolidating verified work hours into the master YUM Hours sheet. This ensures accurate and timely payroll tracking for Emily’s OnlyFans team.
TASK
Verify and update each chatter’s weekly working hours and meeting attendance by cross-checking individual logs with Slack activity and compiling results in the YUM Hours sheet. Final submission is due every Thursday by 7:00 AM PST.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Individual Chatter Timesheets 
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Chatters - Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Hours Master Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Slack – For verifying login/logout times
Fathom / Meeting Notes – For verifying meeting attendance
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Access Chatter Timesheets
Open each chatter’s individual Google Sheet
Review login/out times, shift durations, and coverage notes (if any)
 
STEP 2: Cross-Reference with Slack Logs (Reports Channel) 
Use Slack reports (via Dali’s view or direct access)
Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PHT)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PHT
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PHT
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
Check attendance for Monday meetings 
 Verify via recording or Slack updates 
Pay Computation
 Adjust hours first 
 Multiply hours × rate = base pay 
Incentives
Top Chatter:
 Top 1 → $75 
 Top 2 → $50 
Resub & Transfer Bonus:
 $10–$19 → $40 
 $20+ → $100 
Top Chatter Computation
 Based on audit report (Monday–Sunday data) 
Adjustment:
 6-day worker (Xaviera) → divide earnings by 6 
 Others → divide by 5 
 Rank based on adjusted values 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"
If any of the above criteria is missed, mark as Invalid. 

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

Resub Cases
 Fan explicitly resubscribed 
 Previous VIP → stopped → re-engaged via message/MM 
 Check Billing info to verify if the fan actually resubscribed 
MM Checking
 Use MM Tracker to identify sender 
 Since MM has no chatter name, always cross-check 
Interaction Rule
 Any chatter can interact 
 Credit goes to: 
 Last MM sender 
 Source of resub/transfer 
Invalid Cases
 Username not found / inactive 
 No interaction (buried or no reply) 
 No clear MM or chat basis 
STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 5: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

title: Vault Maintenance
description:
Vault Maintenance SOP
Recurring Frequency
 Weekly or as needed when new content is uploaded
Deadline
 No fixed deadline unless assigned as part of a time-sensitive content update
🎯 Overview
This task ensures the OF vault is properly maintained so all content is organized, searchable, correctly priced, and placed in the right folders. Vault maintenance includes sorting new content, updating old content, checking price folders, applying descriptive categories, and cleaning up unnecessary or duplicate folders. New content uploaded into OF first lands in All Media and must then be sorted into the correct folder system. 
When there is no new content, vault maintenance still continues as a review and cleanup process by checking whether all existing content has the correct pricing, descriptive categories, and quarterly folder placement. 
✅ Task
Maintain Emily’s OF vault by:
 sorting newly uploaded content into the proper folders 
 assigning the correct price folder 
 applying descriptive category tags 
 moving content based on age 
 checking old content for missing or incorrect folder placement 
 cleaning up unnecessary or duplicate folders to keep the vault organized   
🛠 Tools Required
 OnlyFans Vault 
 All Media section in OF 
 Model Info Sheet 
 ClickUp 
 Slack vault maintenance thread 
 Google Drive, if new content is first stored there before being uploaded to OF  
📋 Step-by-Step Process
1️⃣ Open the Vault and Check All Media
Go to Emily’s OF Vault and open All Media.
All newly uploaded or newly dropped content appears in All Media first. This is the starting point for vault maintenance. Any new content found here must be sorted into the proper folders. 
2️⃣ Sort New Content Into the Correct Folder Set
If the content is newly uploaded for the week, it must be added to all applicable folders:
New Content
 the correct Quarterly Folder
 the correct descriptive category folder
Use the circle selector on the media item, then click the folder icon to assign the content to the proper categories. New weekly content should always be placed in all required folders, not left only in All Media. 
3️⃣ Create the Correct Quarterly Folder if Missing
Check whether the correct quarterly folder already exists.
If a new quarter has started and the folder does not yet exist, create a new quarterly folder using the proper naming structure. Example: if the current quarter is April to June 2026, create the corresponding quarterly folder before sorting content into it. 
4️⃣ Apply the Correct Price Folder
After sorting the content into New Content and the correct Quarterly Folder, assign the proper price folder.
Current process requires that even newly uploaded content must already be assigned to a price folder. Pricing must not be guessed. Always cross-check against the Model Info Sheet first before applying the correct vault price. 
5️⃣ Check the Model Info Sheet for Original Pricing
Open the Model Info Sheet and identify:
 content type 
 content duration, if video 
 applicable base/original price 
Use the Model Info Sheet as the source of truth for original pricing. Vault pricing is then applied based on the current pricing rule, content type, and age of the content. 
6️⃣ Price Videos Based on Type, Duration, and Age
For videos, determine:
 the content type 
 the content duration 
 the original price from the Model Info Sheet 
Vault pricing is based on the generic lowest applicable tier. If the content is already 6 months old, apply the 6–6 rule and reduce the original price by 50%. Example: if the original low-tier price is $50, the updated vault price becomes $25 once the content is 6 months old. 
For older video content, the price shown in the vault should reflect the updated discounted folder, not the original full price. 
7️⃣ Price Photos Using the Standard Folder Guide
For older photo content, use the following standard folder guide:
 boob only or butt only = $5
 boob and butt visible = $10
 pussy visible only = $10
 full nude with pussy visible = $15
Also assess image quality:
 If the content is very old or pixelated, lower the price when appropriate. 
 If the content quality is especially strong, the folder price may be justified at a higher tier within the existing rule set.  
8️⃣ Apply Descriptive Category Tags
Add the content to the proper descriptive category folders based on what appears in the content.
A single piece of content may have multiple descriptive tags if applicable. For example, if a video includes more than one content element, it may be tagged in more than one descriptive category. However, it must only have one final price folder and remain properly sorted by date. 
9️⃣ Move Content Based on Age
Content must be moved through the temporary folders based on age:
Week 1: place in New Content
After 1 week: move to Last Week New Content
After 2 weeks: remove from Last Week New Content
 after that, keep it in its proper Quarterly Folder only  
This keeps the “new” folders accurate and prevents old content from staying in short-term folders too long.
🔟 Maintain the Vault Even When There Is No New Content
If there is no new content uploaded, continue vault maintenance by auditing older content.
Check that all existing content has:
 a price folder 
 descriptive category tags 
 correct quarterly placement  
This applies especially to older videos, since videos usually require closer review to confirm category and pricing. 
1️⃣1️⃣ Clean Up Unnecessary or Incorrect Categories
Part of vault maintenance is cleanup.
If a category is unnecessary, one-off, duplicated, or no longer useful:
 rename it if needed 
 move content into the proper permanent folder 
 delete the extra category if no longer needed 
This prevents the vault from becoming too cluttered and makes it easier for chatters to find content. 
1️⃣2️⃣ Update Internal Notes or Task Records if Needed
If there are major changes made during vault maintenance, update the relevant SOP, ClickUp task, or internal tracking notes as needed so the folder logic and pricing rules remain clear for the team. 
⚠️ Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
1. Never guess pricing
Always use the Model Info Sheet first, especially for videos. Pricing must be based on the documented pricing structure, then adjusted according to current vault rules. 
2. Use the generic lowest pricing tier for vault pricing
Vault pricing should be based on the lowest applicable tier for the generic vault system. Do not apply different vault prices based on individual fan spender tiers. 
3. Multiple descriptive tags are allowed, but only one price folder
A content item can belong to multiple descriptive folders, but it must not be assigned to multiple price folders. 
4. Videos require more review than photos
Videos may need to be watched or reviewed more carefully to determine correct duration, category, and pricing. 
5. Quality affects photo pricing
For photos, use the standard folder rules, but consider whether the content is old, pixelated, or especially high quality before finalizing the folder price. 
6. Vault maintenance still applies even without new content
If no new content has been uploaded, the task becomes a maintenance audit of existing content rather than a new-content sorting task. 
7. Keep the vault clean and easy to use
Too many unnecessary folders make content harder to manage and sell. Regular cleanup is part of the task.

title: Payroll Computation
description:
Overview
This SOP explains how to compute weekly payroll for YUM chatters using the verified hours, approved hourly rates, and eligible bonuses. Payroll should be completed carefully using only checked/validated data from the official sheets and ClickUp payroll table.
Task
Compute each chatter’s payroll by entering their verified working hours, calculating base pay, adding eligible bonuses, and validating the final total pay before submission.
Tools Required
Google Sheets
ClickUp https://app.clickup.com/9008122222/v/dc/8ceu2be-6793/8ceu2be-52973
YUM Hours Sheet 
VIP Top Chatters Sheet 
Model’s Info Sheet / Resub and Transfer Tracker 
Bonus Structure / KPI Tracker 
Calculator, if needed
Step-by-Step Process
1. Open the payroll table in ClickUp
Go to ClickUp and open the correct payroll/EOS page for the payroll date or pay period.
Look for the payroll table with these columns:
Name
 Rate
 Hours
 Base Pay
 Top Chatter Bonus
 Resub/Transfer Bonus
 KPI Bonus
 Total Pay
Make sure you are working on the correct date or week before entering any data.
2. Check the chatter’s hourly rate
Review the Rate column for each chatter.
Do not change the rate unless there is an approved update from management.
If the rate is missing or looks incorrect, confirm first before continuing.
3. Get verified hours from the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours Google Sheet. 
Go to the Weekly Hours Checked tab or the correct weekly hours section.
Find the correct payweek, then locate each chatter’s total working hours.
Use the checked/validated total hours, not the unconfirmed schedule.
If a chatter has approved overtime, make sure it is included only if it is already noted or validated in the sheet.
Example:
Regular hours are listed per day.
 The weekly total is shown in the Total Working Hours row.
 The checked/validated total may appear in the green row.
Copy the verified total hours for each chatter into the Hours column in ClickUp.
4. Calculate the base pay
For each chatter, compute:
Base Pay = Rate x Hours
Example:
If the rate is $5.00 and the chatter worked 41 hours:
$5.00 x 41 = $205
Enter the computed amount in the Base Pay column.
Use the same format across all rows.
5. Check Top Chatter Bonus
Open the VIP Top Chatters sheet or the correct bonus tracker.
(VIP)
(FREE)
Go to the Bonus tab or the relevant weekly bonus section.
Find the correct payweek.
Review the chatter rankings and identify who qualifies for Top Chatter Bonus.
Based on the current bonus structure shown in the tracker:
Top 1 = $75
 Top 2 = $50
Enter the correct bonus amount under Top Chatter Bonus.
If the chatter does not qualify, enter a dash or leave it as the approved blank format.
Do not add a top chatter bonus unless the chatter is clearly listed as qualified in the tracker.
6. Check Resub/Transfer Bonus
Open the Model’s Info Sheet or the Resub/Transfer tracker.
Go to the Fans Transfer/Resub or relevant process tab.
Filter or review the dates included in the payroll period.
Check each chatter’s validated resub or transfer entries.
Only include entries that are confirmed or approved.
Enter the approved bonus amount in the Resub/Transfer Bonus column.
If there is no valid bonus, enter a dash.
Do not include pending, unclear, or unvalidated entries.
7. Check KPI Bonus
Review the KPI tracker or Bonus Structure sheet.
Confirm whether each chatter qualified for a KPI bonus for the pay period.
Enter the approved KPI bonus amount in the KPI Bonus column.
If the chatter did not qualify, enter a dash.
Never manually add a KPI bonus without confirmation from the KPI tracker or management.
8. Calculate Total Pay
For each chatter, compute:
Total Pay = Base Pay + Top Chatter Bonus + Resub/Transfer Bonus + KPI Bonus
Treat dashes as zero.
Example:
Base Pay: $279.50
 Top Chatter Bonus: $75
 Resub/Transfer Bonus: $40
 KPI Bonus: $0
Total Pay = $394.50
Enter the final amount in the Total Pay column.
9. Compute team subtotal, if applicable
If there is a team subtotal row, add the total hours and total pay of all chatters under that team.
Example:
Team Hours = Sum of all team chatter hours
 Team Total Pay = Sum of all team chatter total pay
Make sure the subtotal row matches the individual chatter rows below it.
10. Final validation
Before submitting, double-check the following:
Each chatter has the correct rate.
 Hours match the verified hours sheet.
 Base Pay is Rate x Hours.
 Top Chatter Bonus matches the bonus tracker.
 Resub/Transfer Bonus includes only validated entries.
 KPI Bonus is added only when approved.
 Total Pay is correctly added.
 Team subtotal matches the sum of the team’s chatter rows.
11. Submit or mark as complete
Once all payroll values are checked, leave the ClickUp table updated.
Notify the assigned manager or payroll reviewer that the payroll computation is ready for review.
Important Notes / Tips / Warnings
Always use the checked/validated hours, not just the scheduled hours.
Do not guess missing hours, bonus amounts, or rates.
If a chatter has an OFF day, do not include hours for that day unless there is an approved note.
Approved overtime should only be included if it is clearly documented.
Use a dash for bonuses that do not apply.
Never add bonuses based on memory. Always check the tracker.
Do not edit hourly rates unless management confirms the update.
Always validate the final total before submitting because payroll errors can affect payout accuracy.

Recording on how to do it: 
https://t9016642965.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9016642965/1fe7054f-ec19-4a67-8e24-c2dc2d5d11c7/YUM_Payroll%20Computation.mp4?view=open

title: Timesheet & Resub/Transfer
description:
TIMESHEEET OVERVIEW
This SOP outlines the weekly process of validating individual chatter timesheets, cross-referencing them with Slack reports, and consolidating verified work hours into the master YUM Hours sheet. This ensures accurate and timely payroll tracking for Emily’s OnlyFans team.
TASK
Verify and update each chatter’s weekly working hours and meeting attendance by cross-checking individual logs with Slack activity and compiling results in the YUM Hours sheet. Final submission is due every Thursday by 7:00 AM PST.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Individual Chatter Timesheets 
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Chatters - Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Hours Master Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Slack – For verifying login/logout times
Fathom / Meeting Notes – For verifying meeting attendance
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Access Chatter Timesheets
Open each chatter’s individual Google Sheet
Review login/out times, shift durations, and coverage notes (if any)
 
STEP 2: Cross-Reference with Slack Logs (Reports Channel) 
Use Slack reports (via Dali’s view or direct access)
Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PHT)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PHT
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PHT
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
Check attendance for Monday meetings 
 Verify via recording or Slack updates 
Pay Computation
 Adjust hours first 
 Multiply hours × rate = base pay 
Incentives
Top Chatter:
 Top 1 → $75 
 Top 2 → $50 
Resub & Transfer Bonus:
 $10–$19 → $40 
 $20+ → $100 
Top Chatter Computation
 Based on audit report (Monday–Sunday data) 
Adjustment:
 6-day worker (Xaviera) → divide earnings by 6 
 Others → divide by 5 
 Rank based on adjusted values 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"
If any of the above criteria is missed, mark as Invalid. 

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

Resub Cases
 Fan explicitly resubscribed 
 Previous VIP → stopped → re-engaged via message/MM 
 Check Billing info to verify if the fan actually resubscribed 
MM Checking
 Use MM Tracker to identify sender 
 Since MM has no chatter name, always cross-check 
Interaction Rule
 Any chatter can interact 
 Credit goes to: 
 Last MM sender 
 Source of resub/transfer 
Invalid Cases
 Username not found / inactive 
 No interaction (buried or no reply) 
 No clear MM or chat basis 
STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 5: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

	📊 EOW REPORT SOP
Meeting Recording: 
Recurring Frequency: Weekly
Deadline: Submit within the required weekly reporting window
Main Objective:
 To complete the End of Week (EOW) Report accurately using verified FansMetric data, internal trackers, MM Tracker validation, refund checks, and weekly KPI analysis.
🎯 PURPOSE
The EOW Report is used to provide a full weekly view of chatter performance, including:
 Weekly VIP and Free sales 
 Weekly PPV/MM sales 
 RCH / RCW 
 PPV conversion 
 Refund rate 
 KPI compliance 
 Weekly risks, performance trends, and coaching priorities 
This report must be based on exact weekly data only. No estimates, no guessing, and no unverified figures.
🗂 STEP 1: OPEN THE REQUIRED FILES AND TOOLS
Before starting, open all required tabs/files first so the process is faster:
Required Files / Sheets
 Weekly EOW Report file/template 
YUM Chatter KPI Tracker
MM Tracker
Model Info Sheet
Audit Report
 Previous week’s EOW report for reference 
Required Platforms
FansMetric
OF Data / OF Scripts / Internal sheets
ChatGPT for weekly analysis formatting 
Recommended Tabs to Open in Advance
 FM → Chat Analytics 
 FM → Chatting Client → Statistics → Messages 
 FM → Chargebacks / Refund section 
 MM Tracker 
 KPI Tracker 
 Last week’s EOW analysis 
📅 STEP 2: SET THE CORRECT WEEKLY DATE RANGE
Before pulling any data, confirm the exact weekly range first.
Example:
If reporting for Week 2, set the date to:
April 6 to April 12
Use this same weekly range consistently across:
 VIP message data 
 Free message data 
 Message statistics 
 MM validation 
 Refund checks 
 KPI reference 
⚠️ Make sure all tabs are using the same exact week range.
 Do not mix weekly data with month-to-date or daily data unless the section specifically requires it.
💎 STEP 3: PULL WEEKLY VIP DATA
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting → Chat Analytics
Filter Setup
 Select the correct VIP account
 Set custom date range to the correct week
 Remove unnecessary filters if not needed 
 Make sure the data shown is only for that weekly period 
Pull the following weekly VIP metrics:
For each chatter, record:
VIP Message Sales / All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
These will be used in the Weekly Chatters Data table.
Important
For weekly reporting, the core metrics taken from VIP are:
 Weekly message sales 
 RCH 
 PPV conversion 
Do not rely on memory or previous values. Always read directly from FansMetric.
💬 STEP 4: TRANSFER WEEKLY VIP MESSAGE SALES INTO THE KPI TRACKER / EOW TABLE
Using the weekly VIP Chat Analytics data, input each chatter’s:
 Weekly VIP message sales 
 Earnings per hour 
 Unlock ratio 
Make sure each chatter’s data is placed in the correct row.
Reminder
The weekly VIP sales figure used here is the chatter’s weekly VIP sales value shown in FansMetric for that date range. This value is later combined with other data points in the report where needed. 
📈 STEP 5: VALIDATE WEEKLY PPV / MM SALES USING MM TRACKER
This is one of the most important parts of the EOW process.
Go to:
MM Tracker
 Filter the tracker to the correct weekly dates 
 Select the chatter you are checking 
Important Rule
Do not trust the MM Tracker unlock counts immediately.
The unlock counts inside MM Tracker must be manually verified against FansMetric message statistics because some unlock counts may not yet be updated. 
STEP 5A: FILTER THE MM TRACKER
Apply filter to the weekly date range only.
Example:
 April 6 
 April 7 
 April 8 
 April 9 
 April 10 
 April 11 
 April 12 
Then isolate one chatter at a time.
STEP 5B: VERIFY EACH PPV CAPTION MANUALLY IN FANSMETRIC
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting Client → Statistics → Engagement → Messages
Set the date to the same weekly range.
For each MM/PPV row in the MM Tracker:
 Copy the caption or a searchable keyword from the caption 
 Search it inside FansMetric message statistics 
 Check whether the post exists 
 Verify the unlock count
 Verify the price
 Update the MM Tracker if the unlock count is outdated 
 Exclude posts that fall outside the weekly range 
If the unlock count in FM is different from MM Tracker:
Update the MM Tracker unlock count manually.
If pricing is incorrect:
Correct the price after verifying in FM.
If a post cannot be found:
Check:
 spacing 
 shortened text 
 first few words only 
 whether the caption was changed 
 whether it was posted on another date 
If a post was posted late and falls into the next day/week:
Do not count it in the current week.
 Update the date instead so it will be counted in the correct reporting week. 
If a caption cannot be found at all after checking:
Do not force it into the report. Flag it for caption replacement or exclude it until verified. 
STEP 5C: CALCULATE WEEKLY PPV/MM SALES PER CHATTER
After validating all included PPVs for that chatter:
 Sum the verified weekly PPV/MM sales total 
 Enter the total in the EOW sheet / KPI tracker under the weekly PPV/MM sales field 
Repeat the same full validation process for each chatter.
⚠️ Never use unverified subtotal numbers if rows were not checked individually.
💸 STEP 6: CHECK WEEKLY REFUNDS / CHARGEBACKS
Refunds must be checked separately.
Go to the weekly refund / chargeback section and review all entries within the same weekly period.
Process
 Check each day within the weekly date range 
 Identify refund values per chatter 
 Record only confirmed refund amounts for the week 
Important
Refund rate is not manually guessed. It must be calculated.
Formula per chatter:
Refund Rate = Refund Amount ÷ Weekly Total Sales × 100
Make sure you divide by the correct weekly total used for that chatter.
Total Weekly Refund Rate
To get the team weekly refund rate:
 Add all weekly refund amounts 
 Divide by the total weekly sales 
 Multiply by 100 
This must be entered in the overall summary section.
🆓 STEP 7: PULL WEEKLY FREE MESSAGE SALES
Go to the Free account data source and set the same weekly range.
For each chatter, record:
 Weekly Free Message Sales 
Enter the value into the weekly report.
Weekly Free PPV Sales
If Free PPV sales are being tracked that week:
 Use the same validation process as VIP PPV/MM sales 
 If there are no Free PPV sales set up yet, enter zero only if confirmed operationally 
The transcript notes that Free PPV posting may still depend on schedule setup and approval, so only record Free PPV sales if they actually exist and are verified. 
🔁 STEP 8: CHECK FREE TRANSFERS / RESUBS
Go to:
YUM → Model Info Sheet
Look for entries in the relevant weekly period under:
 pause funds 
 resub 
 transfer 
Important Rule
Only count transfer
 Do not count resub
If the chatter did not clearly label whether the entry is resub or transfer:
 confirm first if possible 
 if still unclear, leave it pending for update 
Enter only confirmed transfer counts into the weekly report.
📊 STEP 9: COMPLETE WEEKLY CHATTERS DATA TABLE
Populate the Weekly Chatters Data table for each chatter using verified values only.
Include:
 VIP Message Sales 
 PPV/MM Sales 
 RCH 
 PPV Conversion 
 Refund Amount 
 Refund Rate 
 Free Message Sales 
 Free PPV Sales 
 Free Transfers 
Double-check every row before moving forward.
🟨🟩🟥 STEP 10: APPLY KPI COLOR CODING AND COMPLIANCE STATUS
After completing the weekly data, apply KPI color coding based on the current KPI thresholds.
Chatter Performance Status
Categorize chatters by weekly KPI result:
 🟢 Green – Meeting KPI 
 🟡 Yellow – Slightly below KPI 
 🔴 Red – Not meeting KPI 
Important Weekly Rule
For weekly compliance, the transcript indicates that not all fields are included in weekly color coding the same way as daily. Weekly review focuses mainly on whether the required weekly KPI metrics are hit, especially RCW/RCH and PPV conversion, while some fields are kept visible for tracking but are not the main compliance basis. 
Compliance Status
Mark each chatter as:
Compliant
Non-compliant
based on the current weekly KPI rules.
Double-check highlighted KPI colors before finalizing. The weekly ChatGPT analysis can misread these if your raw table is wrong.
📌 STEP 11: COMPLETE OVERALL PERFORMANCE SNAPSHOT
This section summarizes the whole team’s weekly performance.
Include:
A. PPV Conversion Trend – Summary & Analysis
Write a short analysis of:
 weekly unlock ratio trend 
 whether conversion improved, declined, or stayed stable 
 which chatters performed strongly 
 which chatters underperformed 
 possible reasons based on data 
B. Chatter Performance Status
List chatters under:
 Green 
 Yellow 
 Red 
Add short notes for Yellow and Red performers.
C. Risks / Projected Shortfalls (Bottom 3)
Identify the bottom 3 performers based on weekly performance.
For each, summarize:
 what likely went wrong 
 risk to KPI / bonus / consistency 
 what intervention or coaching is needed 
⚠️ Make sure the correct bottom 3 are used. The transcript specifically shows the need to double-check because ChatGPT may mislabel which chatters are actually red/yellow if the KPI reference is not read properly. 
🤖 STEP 12: USE CHATGPT TO GENERATE THE WEEKLY ANALYSIS
After your weekly table is complete, use ChatGPT to draft the narrative analysis.
Process
 Copy the previous week’s analysis format 
 Provide the previous week’s data first so ChatGPT understands the comparison point 
 Then provide the current week’s data 
 Include KPI screenshots or weekly table screenshots 
 Instruct ChatGPT to keep the same format as the previous week 
Important
If the output is wrong:
 correct it 
 tell ChatGPT exactly what was misread 
 make it regenerate using the correct KPI interpretation 
The transcript shows that this correction step is necessary because the first output may wrongly classify performers. 
Proofreading Rule
Never paste ChatGPT output directly without checking:
 KPI colors 
 Bottom 3 names 
 Weekly figures 
 trend statements 
 wording consistency 
📝 STEP 13: COMPLETE OTHER NOTES / FYI
Include the following sections:
A. Audit Report
Insert the spreadsheet link only.
B. Past Due Report
List:
 pending customs 
 unresolved fan concerns 
 delayed requests 
 items requiring follow-up 
C. Issues / Proposals
Include:
 operational concerns 
 approval delays 
 caption replacement issues 
 free schedule setup issues 
 process improvement suggestions 
Only include actual items that happened during the week.
📅 STEP 14: FILL MONTH-TO-DATE / TOTAL SUMMARY FIELDS IF REQUIRED
If your EOW template contains a team summary or month-to-date section, populate it carefully using the correct source.
This may include:
 month-to-date message sales 
 month-to-date tips 
 total net sales 
 total RCH/RCW 
 overall refund rate 
 overall unlock ratio 
⚠️ Be very careful not to confuse:
 weekly totals 
 daily totals 
 month-to-date totals 
Only fill these if the template specifically requires them.
✅ STEP 15: FINAL REVIEW BEFORE SUBMISSION
Before submitting, confirm all of the following:
Data Accuracy Check
 Correct weekly date range used everywhere 
 VIP data matches FansMetric 
 Free data matches source sheet 
 MM/PPV sales were manually validated 
 Refund amounts were checked separately 
 KPI colors are correct 
 Bottom 3 are correct 
 Compliance labels are correct 
Report Completeness Check
 Weekly Chatters Data table completed 
 Overall Performance Snapshot completed 
 Risks / Projected Shortfalls completed 
 Audit Report link added 
 Past Due Report updated 
 Issues / Proposals updated 
 ChatGPT analysis proofread and corrected 
🚨 NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES
 Do not estimate missing values 
 Do not count unverified MM sales 
 Do not include posts outside the weekly date range 
 Do not count resubs as transfers 
 Do not rely on MM Tracker alone without FM checking 
 Do not rely on ChatGPT analysis without manual proofreading 
 Do not finalize the report unless all weekly figures are verified 
✔ EOW REPORT IS COMPLETE ONLY WHEN:
 Weekly data is fully verified 
 MM sales are manually checked 
 Refunds are confirmed 
 KPI status is accurate 
 Analysis is proofread 
 Links and operational notes are updated 
 Report is ready for manager / Boss D review 
	3️⃣ Other Notes / FYI
	Audit Report
Just provide the link of the audit report.
	Past Due Report
List pending customs or unresolved fan requests.
	Issues / Proposals
Include operational issues, improvement suggestions, or strategy proposals.
	
✔ Ensure data is verified before submission.
 ✔ Weekly report should clearly highlight performance trends, risks, and operational updates.

title: Chatter MM Approval
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure Mass Messages (MM) prepared by chatters follow approved captions, correct pricing, and content rotation rules before being sent to fans.
This prevents:
Incorrect pricing
Reused content too frequently
Low-performing captions
Unapproved messaging
🛠 Tools Needed
MM Tracker
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
FansMetrics (FM)
(Vault section)
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Check MM Tracker
Open the MM Tracker and locate entries with the status:
FOR APPROVAL
These are Mass Messages waiting for admin validation.
2️⃣ Validate Caption
Confirm the caption used is:
✔ From the Scripts tab, OR
 ✔ A recycled caption from previous MMs with high unlocks
Reject if:
Caption is misleading
Caption is duplicated from a recent MM
Caption is poorly written or incomplete
3️⃣ Validate Price
Check that the price follows approved pricing structure.
✔ If the content exists in the Priced Vault Folder, the price must match.
✔ Allowance:
 Price may vary ± $5
✔ If the content is not in the priced vault, verify price using the Model Info Sheet pricing guide. OnlyFans_Pricing_Guidelines_FIN…
Reject if:
Price is missing
Price is significantly different
Pricing does not follow the model's guidelines
4️⃣ Validate Content Usage
Open FansMetrics → Vault and verify the media.
✔ Confirm the content has NOT been used in any Mass Message within the last 2 weeks.
Reject if:
The content was used recently
The content is already scheduled in another MM
5️⃣ If Issues Are Found
If any validation fails:
Add explanation in the Notes column in MM Tracker.
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → NEEDS REVISION
Common note examples:
Caption not from scripts
Incorrect pricing
Content used recently
6️⃣ If Everything Is Correct
If all checks pass:
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → APPROVED
No additional comment required.
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated MM Tracker status:
APPROVED → Ready for scheduling
NEEDS REVISION → Returned to chatter with notes
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before approving:
☑ Caption follows approved scripts or high-performing captions
 ☑ Price follows vault pricing or pricing guide
 ☑ Price difference within $5 allowance
 ☑ Content not used in last 2 weeks
 ☑ Tracker status updated correctly
📝 Notes
Always prioritize content freshness to maintain fan engagement.
Avoid approving MMs with repeated captions or recycled content too frequently.
Use clear and short comments when requesting revisions.

title: SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily

Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)
A stock keeping unit, or SKU, is an internal product identifier that helps businesses track inventory, categorize items, and monitor sales. Each SKU is unique to a product or product variation and is created by the retailer, not the manufacturer.
🎯 Objective
Ensure all chatter End-of-Day (EOD) reports are complete, clean, and properly tracked by recording reported SKUs into the monthly inventory sheet, identifying missing SKUs, and creating new SKUs when needed.
🛠 Tools Needed
SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
YUM Google Drive
FansMetrics (FM) Vault
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Review Chatter EOD Reports
Open the SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report and review all chatter submissions for the day.
Check that:
SKU entries are provided
Report format looks clean and complete
No obvious missing content references
2️⃣ Track Reported SKUs in the Month Tab
For every SKU submitted by the chatter:
Locate the correct Month tab
Add the SKU to the monthly tracking sheet
Ensure it is entered in the proper row/section
Once successfully tracked, highlight the cell so it is easy to identify which SKU has already been added.
3️⃣ If No SKU Is Provided
If the chatter submitted a sale or content entry without a SKU:
Report immediately to the Manager
Request a screenshot of the content from the chatter for verification
Do not leave the entry unresolved.
4️⃣ If SKU Is Not Found in the Monthly Tab
If the chatter provided a SKU but it cannot be found or verified in the Month tab:
Check the VIP Vault folder
Path: Emily’s OnlyFans → Google Drive → PPV Content
Verify whether the content already exists in the vault
5️⃣ If Content Exists 
Advise Manager and provide ss to communicate to chatter.
6️⃣ If Content Do not Exist
If the content do not exist in the vault: 
Go to FM > Vault and locate the content 
Take a screenshot of the content
Upload the screenshot to Google Drive
Create a new SKU for the content
Use the separate How to Create SKU process reference for the proper SKU creation steps.
 Finalize Tracking
Once the SKU is verified or newly created:
Add it to the Month tab
Highlight the added cell
Make sure the report is now complete and trackable
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report with:
All reported SKUs tracked in the Month tab
Highlighted cells for newly added SKUs
Missing SKU cases escalated
New SKUs created when applicable
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before closing the task, verify:
☑ Chatter EOD reports were reviewed
 ☑ SKU entries were tracked in the correct Month tab
 ☑ Newly tracked SKUs were highlighted
 ☑ Missing SKUs were reported to Manager
 ☑ VIP Vault was checked when SKU could not be found
 ☑ Screenshot was uploaded before creating a new SKU
 ☑ New SKU was created only if content existed and no SKU was assigned yet
🚨 Escalation Rules
Escalate immediately if:
Chatter submitted a sale with no SKU
Screenshot is still missing after request
Content cannot be found in vault or report
Duplicate or conflicting SKU is detected
Report submission is incomplete or unclear
📝 Notes
Always make sure tracking is updated on the same day to avoid missed inventory entries.
Highlighting newly added SKUs is required for easy monitoring.
Do not guess or invent a SKU without verifying the content first.
Follow the separate How to Create SKU guide when creating a new one.

title: Timesheet & Resub/Transfer
description:
TIMESHEEET OVERVIEW
This SOP outlines the weekly process of validating individual chatter timesheets, cross-referencing them with Slack reports, and consolidating verified work hours into the master YUM Hours sheet. This ensures accurate and timely payroll tracking for Emily’s OnlyFans team.
TASK
Verify and update each chatter’s weekly working hours and meeting attendance by cross-checking individual logs with Slack activity and compiling results in the YUM Hours sheet. Final submission is due every Thursday by 7:00 AM PST.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Individual Chatter Timesheets 
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Chatters - Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Hours Master Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Slack – For verifying login/logout times
Fathom / Meeting Notes – For verifying meeting attendance
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Access Chatter Timesheets
Open each chatter’s individual Google Sheet
Review login/out times, shift durations, and coverage notes (if any)
 
STEP 2: Cross-Reference with Slack Logs (Reports Channel) 
Use Slack reports (via Dali’s view or direct access)
Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PHT)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PHT
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PHT
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
Check attendance for Monday meetings 
 Verify via recording or Slack updates 
Pay Computation
 Adjust hours first 
 Multiply hours × rate = base pay 
Incentives
Top Chatter:
 Top 1 → $75 
 Top 2 → $50 
Resub & Transfer Bonus:
 $10–$19 → $40 
 $20+ → $100 
Top Chatter Computation
 Based on audit report (Monday–Sunday data) 
Adjustment:
 6-day worker (Xaviera) → divide earnings by 6 
 Others → divide by 5 
 Rank based on adjusted values 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"
If any of the above criteria is missed, mark as Invalid. 

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

Resub Cases
 Fan explicitly resubscribed 
 Previous VIP → stopped → re-engaged via message/MM 
 Check Billing info to verify if the fan actually resubscribed 
MM Checking
 Use MM Tracker to identify sender 
 Since MM has no chatter name, always cross-check 
Interaction Rule
 Any chatter can interact 
 Credit goes to: 
 Last MM sender 
 Source of resub/transfer 
Invalid Cases
 Username not found / inactive 
 No interaction (buried or no reply) 
 No clear MM or chat basis 
STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 5: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

views

	📊 EOW REPORT SOP
Meeting Recording: 
Recurring Frequency: Weekly
Deadline: Submit within the required weekly reporting window
Main Objective:
 To complete the End of Week (EOW) Report accurately using verified FansMetric data, internal trackers, MM Tracker validation, refund checks, and weekly KPI analysis.
🎯 PURPOSE
The EOW Report is used to provide a full weekly view of chatter performance, including:
 Weekly VIP and Free sales 
 Weekly PPV/MM sales 
 RCH / RCW 
 PPV conversion 
 Refund rate 
 KPI compliance 
 Weekly risks, performance trends, and coaching priorities 
This report must be based on exact weekly data only. No estimates, no guessing, and no unverified figures.
🗂 STEP 1: OPEN THE REQUIRED FILES AND TOOLS
Before starting, open all required tabs/files first so the process is faster:
Required Files / Sheets
 Weekly EOW Report file/template 
YUM Chatter KPI Tracker
MM Tracker
Model Info Sheet
Audit Report
 Previous week’s EOW report for reference 
Required Platforms
FansMetric
OF Data / OF Scripts / Internal sheets
ChatGPT for weekly analysis formatting 
Recommended Tabs to Open in Advance
 FM → Chat Analytics 
 FM → Chatting Client → Statistics → Messages 
 FM → Chargebacks / Refund section 
 MM Tracker 
 KPI Tracker 
 Last week’s EOW analysis 
📅 STEP 2: SET THE CORRECT WEEKLY DATE RANGE
Before pulling any data, confirm the exact weekly range first.
Example:
If reporting for Week 2, set the date to:
April 6 to April 12
Use this same weekly range consistently across:
 VIP message data 
 Free message data 
 Message statistics 
 MM validation 
 Refund checks 
 KPI reference 
⚠️ Make sure all tabs are using the same exact week range.
 Do not mix weekly data with month-to-date or daily data unless the section specifically requires it.
💎 STEP 3: PULL WEEKLY VIP DATA
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting → Chat Analytics
Filter Setup
 Select the correct VIP account
 Set custom date range to the correct week
 Remove unnecessary filters if not needed 
 Make sure the data shown is only for that weekly period 
Pull the following weekly VIP metrics:
For each chatter, record:
VIP Message Sales / All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
These will be used in the Weekly Chatters Data table.
Important
For weekly reporting, the core metrics taken from VIP are:
 Weekly message sales 
 RCH 
 PPV conversion 
Do not rely on memory or previous values. Always read directly from FansMetric.
💬 STEP 4: TRANSFER WEEKLY VIP MESSAGE SALES INTO THE KPI TRACKER / EOW TABLE
Using the weekly VIP Chat Analytics data, input each chatter’s:
 Weekly VIP message sales 
 Earnings per hour 
 Unlock ratio 
Make sure each chatter’s data is placed in the correct row.
Reminder
The weekly VIP sales figure used here is the chatter’s weekly VIP sales value shown in FansMetric for that date range. This value is later combined with other data points in the report where needed. 
📈 STEP 5: VALIDATE WEEKLY PPV / MM SALES USING MM TRACKER
This is one of the most important parts of the EOW process.
Go to:
MM Tracker
 Filter the tracker to the correct weekly dates 
 Select the chatter you are checking 
Important Rule
Do not trust the MM Tracker unlock counts immediately.
The unlock counts inside MM Tracker must be manually verified against FansMetric message statistics because some unlock counts may not yet be updated. 
STEP 5A: FILTER THE MM TRACKER
Apply filter to the weekly date range only.
Example:
 April 6 
 April 7 
 April 8 
 April 9 
 April 10 
 April 11 
 April 12 
Then isolate one chatter at a time.
STEP 5B: VERIFY EACH PPV CAPTION MANUALLY IN FANSMETRIC
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting Client → Statistics → Engagement → Messages
Set the date to the same weekly range.
For each MM/PPV row in the MM Tracker:
 Copy the caption or a searchable keyword from the caption 
 Search it inside FansMetric message statistics 
 Check whether the post exists 
 Verify the unlock count
 Verify the price
 Update the MM Tracker if the unlock count is outdated 
 Exclude posts that fall outside the weekly range 
If the unlock count in FM is different from MM Tracker:
Update the MM Tracker unlock count manually.
If pricing is incorrect:
Correct the price after verifying in FM.
If a post cannot be found:
Check:
 spacing 
 shortened text 
 first few words only 
 whether the caption was changed 
 whether it was posted on another date 
If a post was posted late and falls into the next day/week:
Do not count it in the current week.
 Update the date instead so it will be counted in the correct reporting week. 
If a caption cannot be found at all after checking:
Do not force it into the report. Flag it for caption replacement or exclude it until verified. 
STEP 5C: CALCULATE WEEKLY PPV/MM SALES PER CHATTER
After validating all included PPVs for that chatter:
 Sum the verified weekly PPV/MM sales total 
 Enter the total in the EOW sheet / KPI tracker under the weekly PPV/MM sales field 
Repeat the same full validation process for each chatter.
⚠️ Never use unverified subtotal numbers if rows were not checked individually.
💸 STEP 6: CHECK WEEKLY REFUNDS / CHARGEBACKS
Refunds must be checked separately.
Go to the weekly refund / chargeback section and review all entries within the same weekly period.
Process
 Check each day within the weekly date range 
 Identify refund values per chatter 
 Record only confirmed refund amounts for the week 
Important
Refund rate is not manually guessed. It must be calculated.
Formula per chatter:
Refund Rate = Refund Amount ÷ Weekly Total Sales × 100
Make sure you divide by the correct weekly total used for that chatter.
Total Weekly Refund Rate
To get the team weekly refund rate:
 Add all weekly refund amounts 
 Divide by the total weekly sales 
 Multiply by 100 
This must be entered in the overall summary section.
🆓 STEP 7: PULL WEEKLY FREE MESSAGE SALES
Go to the Free account data source and set the same weekly range.
For each chatter, record:
 Weekly Free Message Sales 
Enter the value into the weekly report.
Weekly Free PPV Sales
If Free PPV sales are being tracked that week:
 Use the same validation process as VIP PPV/MM sales 
 If there are no Free PPV sales set up yet, enter zero only if confirmed operationally 
The transcript notes that Free PPV posting may still depend on schedule setup and approval, so only record Free PPV sales if they actually exist and are verified. 
🔁 STEP 8: CHECK FREE TRANSFERS / RESUBS
Go to:
YUM → Model Info Sheet
Look for entries in the relevant weekly period under:
 pause funds 
 resub 
 transfer 
Important Rule
Only count transfer
 Do not count resub
If the chatter did not clearly label whether the entry is resub or transfer:
 confirm first if possible 
 if still unclear, leave it pending for update 
Enter only confirmed transfer counts into the weekly report.
📊 STEP 9: COMPLETE WEEKLY CHATTERS DATA TABLE
Populate the Weekly Chatters Data table for each chatter using verified values only.
Include:
 VIP Message Sales 
 PPV/MM Sales 
 RCH 
 PPV Conversion 
 Refund Amount 
 Refund Rate 
 Free Message Sales 
 Free PPV Sales 
 Free Transfers 
Double-check every row before moving forward.
🟨🟩🟥 STEP 10: APPLY KPI COLOR CODING AND COMPLIANCE STATUS
After completing the weekly data, apply KPI color coding based on the current KPI thresholds.
Chatter Performance Status
Categorize chatters by weekly KPI result:
 🟢 Green – Meeting KPI 
 🟡 Yellow – Slightly below KPI 
 🔴 Red – Not meeting KPI 
Important Weekly Rule
For weekly compliance, the transcript indicates that not all fields are included in weekly color coding the same way as daily. Weekly review focuses mainly on whether the required weekly KPI metrics are hit, especially RCW/RCH and PPV conversion, while some fields are kept visible for tracking but are not the main compliance basis. 
Compliance Status
Mark each chatter as:
Compliant
Non-compliant
based on the current weekly KPI rules.
Double-check highlighted KPI colors before finalizing. The weekly ChatGPT analysis can misread these if your raw table is wrong.
📌 STEP 11: COMPLETE OVERALL PERFORMANCE SNAPSHOT
This section summarizes the whole team’s weekly performance.
Include:
A. PPV Conversion Trend – Summary & Analysis
Write a short analysis of:
 weekly unlock ratio trend 
 whether conversion improved, declined, or stayed stable 
 which chatters performed strongly 
 which chatters underperformed 
 possible reasons based on data 
B. Chatter Performance Status
List chatters under:
 Green 
 Yellow 
 Red 
Add short notes for Yellow and Red performers.
C. Risks / Projected Shortfalls (Bottom 3)
Identify the bottom 3 performers based on weekly performance.
For each, summarize:
 what likely went wrong 
 risk to KPI / bonus / consistency 
 what intervention or coaching is needed 
⚠️ Make sure the correct bottom 3 are used. The transcript specifically shows the need to double-check because ChatGPT may mislabel which chatters are actually red/yellow if the KPI reference is not read properly. 
🤖 STEP 12: USE CHATGPT TO GENERATE THE WEEKLY ANALYSIS
After your weekly table is complete, use ChatGPT to draft the narrative analysis.
Process
 Copy the previous week’s analysis format 
 Provide the previous week’s data first so ChatGPT understands the comparison point 
 Then provide the current week’s data 
 Include KPI screenshots or weekly table screenshots 
 Instruct ChatGPT to keep the same format as the previous week 
Important
If the output is wrong:
 correct it 
 tell ChatGPT exactly what was misread 
 make it regenerate using the correct KPI interpretation 
The transcript shows that this correction step is necessary because the first output may wrongly classify performers. 
Proofreading Rule
Never paste ChatGPT output directly without checking:
 KPI colors 
 Bottom 3 names 
 Weekly figures 
 trend statements 
 wording consistency 
📝 STEP 13: COMPLETE OTHER NOTES / FYI
Include the following sections:
A. Audit Report
Insert the spreadsheet link only.
B. Past Due Report
List:
 pending customs 
 unresolved fan concerns 
 delayed requests 
 items requiring follow-up 
C. Issues / Proposals
Include:
 operational concerns 
 approval delays 
 caption replacement issues 
 free schedule setup issues 
 process improvement suggestions 
Only include actual items that happened during the week.
📅 STEP 14: FILL MONTH-TO-DATE / TOTAL SUMMARY FIELDS IF REQUIRED
If your EOW template contains a team summary or month-to-date section, populate it carefully using the correct source.
This may include:
 month-to-date message sales 
 month-to-date tips 
 total net sales 
 total RCH/RCW 
 overall refund rate 
 overall unlock ratio 
⚠️ Be very careful not to confuse:
 weekly totals 
 daily totals 
 month-to-date totals 
Only fill these if the template specifically requires them.
✅ STEP 15: FINAL REVIEW BEFORE SUBMISSION
Before submitting, confirm all of the following:
Data Accuracy Check
 Correct weekly date range used everywhere 
 VIP data matches FansMetric 
 Free data matches source sheet 
 MM/PPV sales were manually validated 
 Refund amounts were checked separately 
 KPI colors are correct 
 Bottom 3 are correct 
 Compliance labels are correct 
Report Completeness Check
 Weekly Chatters Data table completed 
 Overall Performance Snapshot completed 
 Risks / Projected Shortfalls completed 
 Audit Report link added 
 Past Due Report updated 
 Issues / Proposals updated 
 ChatGPT analysis proofread and corrected 
🚨 NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES
 Do not estimate missing values 
 Do not count unverified MM sales 
 Do not include posts outside the weekly date range 
 Do not count resubs as transfers 
 Do not rely on MM Tracker alone without FM checking 
 Do not rely on ChatGPT analysis without manual proofreading 
 Do not finalize the report unless all weekly figures are verified 
✔ EOW REPORT IS COMPLETE ONLY WHEN:
 Weekly data is fully verified 
 MM sales are manually checked 
 Refunds are confirmed 
 KPI status is accurate 
 Analysis is proofread 
 Links and operational notes are updated 
 Report is ready for manager / Boss D review 
	3️⃣ Other Notes / FYI
	Audit Report
Just provide the link of the audit report.
	Past Due Report
List pending customs or unresolved fan requests.
	Issues / Proposals
Include operational issues, improvement suggestions, or strategy proposals.
	
✔ Ensure data is verified before submission.
 ✔ Weekly report should clearly highlight performance trends, risks, and operational updates.

title: Chatter MM Approval
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure Mass Messages (MM) prepared by chatters follow approved captions, correct pricing, and content rotation rules before being sent to fans.
This prevents:
Incorrect pricing
Reused content too frequently
Low-performing captions
Unapproved messaging
🛠 Tools Needed
MM Tracker
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
FansMetrics (FM)
(Vault section)
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Check MM Tracker
Open the MM Tracker and locate entries with the status:
FOR APPROVAL
These are Mass Messages waiting for admin validation.
2️⃣ Validate Caption
Confirm the caption used is:
✔ From the Scripts tab, OR
 ✔ A recycled caption from previous MMs with high unlocks
Reject if:
Caption is misleading
Caption is duplicated from a recent MM
Caption is poorly written or incomplete
3️⃣ Validate Price
Check that the price follows approved pricing structure.
✔ If the content exists in the Priced Vault Folder, the price must match.
✔ Allowance:
 Price may vary ± $5
✔ If the content is not in the priced vault, verify price using the Model Info Sheet pricing guide. OnlyFans_Pricing_Guidelines_FIN…
Reject if:
Price is missing
Price is significantly different
Pricing does not follow the model's guidelines
4️⃣ Validate Content Usage
Open FansMetrics → Vault and verify the media.
✔ Confirm the content has NOT been used in any Mass Message within the last 2 weeks.
Reject if:
The content was used recently
The content is already scheduled in another MM
5️⃣ If Issues Are Found
If any validation fails:
Add explanation in the Notes column in MM Tracker.
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → NEEDS REVISION
Common note examples:
Caption not from scripts
Incorrect pricing
Content used recently
6️⃣ If Everything Is Correct
If all checks pass:
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → APPROVED
No additional comment required.
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated MM Tracker status:
APPROVED → Ready for scheduling
NEEDS REVISION → Returned to chatter with notes
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before approving:
☑ Caption follows approved scripts or high-performing captions
 ☑ Price follows vault pricing or pricing guide
 ☑ Price difference within $5 allowance
 ☑ Content not used in last 2 weeks
 ☑ Tracker status updated correctly
📝 Notes
Always prioritize content freshness to maintain fan engagement.
Avoid approving MMs with repeated captions or recycled content too frequently.
Use clear and short comments when requesting revisions.

title: QA AOM set-up
description:
OVERVIEW
Automated Online Messages (AOMs) are short, engaging one-liners sent to fans when they log in. These messages are designed to reflect Emily’s personality and encourage chat engagement across both VIP (Paid) and Free OnlyFans accounts.
TASK
Create one-liner AOMs per day to be used across:
VIP (Paid) Account (4 AOMs daily)
Free Account (2 AOMs daily)
These AOMs should drive engagement and feel natural, even if a fan receives all on the same day.
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Create the AOMs
Use ChatGPT to help write the AOMs.
Tone must match Emily’s brand: bubbly, sexy/flirty, and playful.
Keep messages short, natural, one-liner, and conversational
Avoid endearments (e.g., babe, hun, baby).
STEP 2: Schedule the AOMs in Fansmetric
VIP (Paid) Account
Schedule the 4 AOMs with 6 hours intervals
Starts 10:00 PM PHT (current day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 4:00 AM PHT (next day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 10:00 AM PHT (next day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 4:00 PM PHT (next day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
To: Fans
Exclude: Muted, Whales, Boyfriend VIP, Exclude from PPV/MM
Add 3 Preview Photos weekly to any AOM in the Paid Account by navigating to: Chatting Client > Automations > Auto Online Messages (select AOM, edit message, add media)
Free Account
Schedule 2 AOMs
Starts 10:00 PM PHT (current day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 11:50 PM PHT (current day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
To: Fans
Exclude: Muted, Already in Paid, Exclude from PPV/MM
 
NOTES
Always prioritize the VIP account first before scheduling for the Free account.
Watch out for weekly manager meeting updates, as AOM strategies may be reviewed or changed.

title: QA Wall Post & Content Drops Scheduling
description:
TASK
Prepare and schedule one week’s worth of OF wall posts and PPV/Content drops across Free and VIP accounts, ensuring captions are contextual, scheduled content is tracked, and performance is monitored via Fansmetric.
PREREQUISITE
Google Drive – Source of all content assets (Free, VIP, PPV)
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Emily's OF - Google Drive

OF Caption Tracker (Google Sheets) – For planning post schedule, captions, links, drop info
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > OF Caption Tracker - Google Sheets
Fansmetric – Platform used to schedule and monitor posts
ChatGPT (YUM GPT Workspace) – Optional for drafting captions
Slack / Internal Comms – To notify Jerold and coordinate approvals
OnlyFans Banned Words List – For reference when writing captions 
INSTRUCTIONS

STEP 1: PREPARATION
1.1. Access Google Drive
Navigate to Emily’s folder inside “YUM Production > Emily’s OnlyFans”.
Navigate to Paid Account or Free Account
1.2. Check for New Content under NEW (paid) and New Non-PPV Wall Posts (free)
Confirm if there’s new content uploaded
If no new content, navigate to the Used Wall (PAID) or Used Wall (FREE) and reuse old photos by downloading them and then uploading into the NEW folders
Content can be reused for wall posts after at least 2 weeks since it was last posted

STEP 2: FILL OUT THE CAPTION TRACKER
2.1. Open the OF Caption Tracker via the YUM Production bookmarks.
2.2. Under the appropriate monthly tab, input:
Date and Time
Category (e.g. Daily Post, Drop - Photo, Drop - Video)
Account (Free or VIP)
Caption: Captions can be copy-pasted from other OF models from Emily's feed (short, one-liner captions). Alternatively, you can use ChatGPT to generate short, one-liner captions that are bubbly/playful/flirty and fits the content being posted. 
Note: for fake drops (2x a week), we need to add an additional line of caption such as "New video drops tonight!" or "Shot some fresh nudes, dropping tonight!". Alternate between video and nude set for fake drops. No specific days of the week, only 2 days per week. 
Additional Note: Confirm weekly with Divine if fake drops are continuing or if the model plans on dropping new content
Asset Link (Drive link to content)

STEP 3: GET APPROVAL
3.1. Notify Jerold once the tracker is complete.
