title: Timesheet & Resub/Transfer
description:
TIMESHEEET OVERVIEW
This SOP outlines the weekly process of validating individual chatter timesheets, cross-referencing them with Slack reports, and consolidating verified work hours into the master YUM Hours sheet. This ensures accurate and timely payroll tracking for Emily’s OnlyFans team.
TASK
Verify and update each chatter’s weekly working hours and meeting attendance by cross-checking individual logs with Slack activity and compiling results in the YUM Hours sheet. Final submission is due every Thursday by 7:00 AM PST.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Individual Chatter Timesheets 
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Chatters - Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Hours Master Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Slack – For verifying login/logout times
Fathom / Meeting Notes – For verifying meeting attendance
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Access Chatter Timesheets
Open each chatter’s individual Google Sheet
Review login/out times, shift durations, and coverage notes (if any)
 
STEP 2: Cross-Reference with Slack Logs (Reports Channel) 
Use Slack reports (via Dali’s view or direct access)
Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PHT)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PHT
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PHT
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
Check attendance for Monday meetings 
 Verify via recording or Slack updates 
Pay Computation
 Adjust hours first 
 Multiply hours × rate = base pay 
Incentives
Top Chatter:
 Top 1 → $75 
 Top 2 → $50 
Resub & Transfer Bonus:
 $10–$19 → $40 
 $20+ → $100 
Top Chatter Computation
 Based on audit report (Monday–Sunday data) 
Adjustment:
 6-day worker (Xaviera) → divide earnings by 6 
 Others → divide by 5 
 Rank based on adjusted values 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"
If any of the above criteria is missed, mark as Invalid. 

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

Resub Cases
 Fan explicitly resubscribed 
 Previous VIP → stopped → re-engaged via message/MM 
 Check Billing info to verify if the fan actually resubscribed 
MM Checking
 Use MM Tracker to identify sender 
 Since MM has no chatter name, always cross-check 
Interaction Rule
 Any chatter can interact 
 Credit goes to: 
 Last MM sender 
 Source of resub/transfer 
Invalid Cases
 Username not found / inactive 
 No interaction (buried or no reply) 
 No clear MM or chat basis 
STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 5: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

	📊 EOW REPORT SOP

 Weekly VIP and Free sales

 KPI compliance 
 Weekly risks, performance trends, and coaching priorities 
This report must be based on exact weekly data only. No estimates, no guessing, and no unverified figures.

April 6 to April 12

📈 STEP 5: VALIDATE WEEKLY PPV / MM SALES USING MM TRACKER
This is one of the most important parts of the EOW process.
Go to:
MM Tracker

Go to:

For each MM/PPV row in the MM Tracker:

 Check whether the post exists 
 Verify the unlock count
 Verify the price
 Update the MM Tracker if the unlock count is outdated 
 Exclude posts that fall outside the weekly range 
If the unlock count in FM is different from MM Tracker:
Update the MM Tracker unlock count manually.
If pricing is incorrect:
Correct the price after verifying in FM.
If a post cannot be found:
Check:
 spacing 
 shortened text 
 first few words only 
 whether the caption was changed

 Update the date instead so it will be counted in the correct reporting week. 
If a caption cannot be found at all after checking:
Do not force it into the report. Flag it for caption replacement or exclude it until verified. 
STEP 5C: CALCULATE WEEKLY PPV/MM SALES PER CHATTER
After validating all included PPVs for that chatter:

 Enter the total in the EOW sheet / KPI tracker under the weekly PPV/MM sales field

 Identify refund values per chatter

Important

Formula per chatter:
Refund Rate = Refund Amount ÷ Weekly Total Sales × 100
Make sure you divide by the correct weekly total used for that chatter.
Total Weekly Refund Rate
To get the team weekly refund rate:

For weekly compliance, the transcript indicates that not all fields are included in weekly color coding the same way as daily. Weekly review focuses mainly on whether the required weekly KPI metrics are hit, especially RCW/RCH and PPV conversion, while some fields are kept visible for tracking but are not the main compliance basis.

Compliant
Non-compliant
based on the current weekly KPI rules.

📌 STEP 11: COMPLETE OVERALL PERFORMANCE SNAPSHOT
This section summarizes the whole team’s weekly performance.

Write a short analysis of:

 possible reasons based on data

⚠️ Make sure the correct bottom 3 are used. The transcript specifically shows the need to double-check because ChatGPT may mislabel which chatters are actually red/yellow if the KPI reference is not read properly. 
🤖 STEP 12: USE CHATGPT TO GENERATE THE WEEKLY ANALYSIS
After your weekly table is complete, use ChatGPT to draft the narrative analysis.
Process
 Copy the previous week’s analysis format

title: Chatter MM Approval
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure Mass Messages (MM) prepared by chatters follow approved captions, correct pricing, and content rotation rules before being sent to fans.
This prevents:
Incorrect pricing
Reused content too frequently
Low-performing captions
Unapproved messaging
🛠 Tools Needed
MM Tracker
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
FansMetrics (FM)
(Vault section)
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Check MM Tracker
Open the MM Tracker and locate entries with the status:
FOR APPROVAL
These are Mass Messages waiting for admin validation.
2️⃣ Validate Caption
Confirm the caption used is:
✔ From the Scripts tab, OR
 ✔ A recycled caption from previous MMs with high unlocks
Reject if:
Caption is misleading
Caption is duplicated from a recent MM
Caption is poorly written or incomplete
3️⃣ Validate Price
Check that the price follows approved pricing structure.
✔ If the content exists in the Priced Vault Folder, the price must match.
✔ Allowance:
 Price may vary ± $5
✔ If the content is not in the priced vault, verify price using the Model Info Sheet pricing guide. OnlyFans_Pricing_Guidelines_FIN…
Reject if:
Price is missing
Price is significantly different
Pricing does not follow the model's guidelines
4️⃣ Validate Content Usage
Open FansMetrics → Vault and verify the media.
✔ Confirm the content has NOT been used in any Mass Message within the last 2 weeks.
Reject if:
The content was used recently
The content is already scheduled in another MM
5️⃣ If Issues Are Found
If any validation fails:
Add explanation in the Notes column in MM Tracker.
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → NEEDS REVISION
Common note examples:
Caption not from scripts
Incorrect pricing
Content used recently
6️⃣ If Everything Is Correct
If all checks pass:
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → APPROVED
No additional comment required.
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated MM Tracker status:
APPROVED → Ready for scheduling
NEEDS REVISION → Returned to chatter with notes
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before approving:
☑ Caption follows approved scripts or high-performing captions
 ☑ Price follows vault pricing or pricing guide
 ☑ Price difference within $5 allowance
 ☑ Content not used in last 2 weeks
 ☑ Tracker status updated correctly
📝 Notes
Always prioritize content freshness to maintain fan engagement.
Avoid approving MMs with repeated captions or recycled content too frequently.
Use clear and short comments when requesting revisions.

title: SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily

Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)
A stock keeping unit, or SKU, is an internal product identifier that helps businesses track inventory, categorize items, and monitor sales. Each SKU is unique to a product or product variation and is created by the retailer, not the manufacturer.
🎯 Objective
Ensure all chatter End-of-Day (EOD) reports are complete, clean, and properly tracked by recording reported SKUs into the monthly inventory sheet, identifying missing SKUs, and creating new SKUs when needed.
🛠 Tools Needed
SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
YUM Google Drive
FansMetrics (FM) Vault
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Review Chatter EOD Reports
Open the SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report and review all chatter submissions for the day.
Check that:
SKU entries are provided
Report format looks clean and complete
No obvious missing content references
2️⃣ Track Reported SKUs in the Month Tab
For every SKU submitted by the chatter:
Locate the correct Month tab
Add the SKU to the monthly tracking sheet
Ensure it is entered in the proper row/section
Once successfully tracked, highlight the cell so it is easy to identify which SKU has already been added.
3️⃣ If No SKU Is Provided
If the chatter submitted a sale or content entry without a SKU:
Report immediately to the Manager
Request a screenshot of the content from the chatter for verification
Do not leave the entry unresolved.
4️⃣ If SKU Is Not Found in the Monthly Tab
If the chatter provided a SKU but it cannot be found or verified in the Month tab:
Check the VIP Vault folder
Path: Emily’s OnlyFans → Google Drive → PPV Content
Verify whether the content already exists in the vault
5️⃣ If Content Exists 
Advise Manager and provide ss to communicate to chatter.
6️⃣ If Content Do not Exist
If the content do not exist in the vault: 
Go to FM > Vault and locate the content 
Take a screenshot of the content
Upload the screenshot to Google Drive
Create a new SKU for the content
Use the separate How to Create SKU process reference for the proper SKU creation steps.
 Finalize Tracking
Once the SKU is verified or newly created:
Add it to the Month tab
Highlight the added cell
Make sure the report is now complete and trackable
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report with:
All reported SKUs tracked in the Month tab
Highlighted cells for newly added SKUs
Missing SKU cases escalated
New SKUs created when applicable
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before closing the task, verify:
☑ Chatter EOD reports were reviewed
 ☑ SKU entries were tracked in the correct Month tab
 ☑ Newly tracked SKUs were highlighted
 ☑ Missing SKUs were reported to Manager
 ☑ VIP Vault was checked when SKU could not be found
 ☑ Screenshot was uploaded before creating a new SKU
 ☑ New SKU was created only if content existed and no SKU was assigned yet
🚨 Escalation Rules
Escalate immediately if:
Chatter submitted a sale with no SKU
Screenshot is still missing after request
Content cannot be found in vault or report
Duplicate or conflicting SKU is detected
Report submission is incomplete or unclear
📝 Notes
Always make sure tracking is updated on the same day to avoid missed inventory entries.
Highlighting newly added SKUs is required for easy monitoring.
Do not guess or invent a SKU without verifying the content first.
Follow the separate How to Create SKU guide when creating a new one.

description:

	🎯 Purpose

	⚠️ If the selected date has no tables yet:

Shift Time filter

Adjust to correct date

	5️⃣ Cross-Check Slack & Internal Compliance
Before finalizing EOS, you MUST check:

Missed Shift reports (Report Channel)
Any announcements affecting the shift
	📩 Direct Messages:
Check chatter’s DM to Divine

	⚠️ SOP Violations:

	📊 STEP 3: Fill Out EOS Table

Enter all extracted data from:
FM → Chatting → Chat Analytics
FM → Chatting Client → VIP → Statistics → Chargebacks
Include only the required metrics:
All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Chargebacks (if any)
⚠️ Removed:
Messages Sent
Priced Messages
PPVs Sold

 No estimates. No manual manipulation.
	
	2️⃣ Paste Supporting Screenshots
EOS must include proof of data:
📸 Screenshot of Chat Analytics
📸 Screenshot of Chargebacks (if applicable)
No EOS submission without screenshots.
	
	3️⃣ Under “Other Sections / FYI”
You MUST include:
	🔎 Slack Cross-Reference Confirmation
Confirm whether:
There were any SFL (Save For Later) operational items
Status of Ongoing Projects / Tasks
Fans Corner – Any issue raised by fans and reported by the chatter
Example structure:
Other Sections / FYI:
Ongoing Projects/Tasks Status: [Brief update]
Fans Corner:
[Fan Name] – Issue raised
[Fan Name] – Complaint / request / concern
[Fan Name] – Pending model confirmation
If none:
	No SFL items, no ongoing escalations, no fan issues reported then just omit the section
	
 
 
	PPV Summary & Overview 
Screenshot the ff: 
Messages > Statistics > MM > Adjust Date
MM Tracker for chatter  and captions references
 
Utilize ChatGPT in summarizing and proof read. 
 Prompt: 
 
You are helping me create a daily VIP PPV MM sales report based on FM screenshots + sheet screenshots.
Your job is to produce the report in the exact same format and logic every time.
Core Rules
Always validate first before creating the table.
Use FM screenshots as the source of truth for:
total messages
total revenue
views
purchases/unlocks
visible prices
Use the sheet screenshot only to identify the chatter by matching the caption.
Never guess the chatter, price, unlocks, or revenue.
If a row appears in FM but the chatter cannot be confirmed from the sheet, flag it instead of assuming.
Include only priced PPV rows with visible unlocks/purchases in the table.
Exclude:
Pic MM
free messages
rows with no visible purchases/unlocks
uncaptured or unverified rows
Keep the rows in the same order as shown in the FM screenshot.
Calculate:
Revenue = Price x Unlocks
Conv. Rate = Unlocks / Viewed x 100
If visible rows do not match the FM header total, mention that there is a difference / unreconciled amount and do not invent missing rows.
Output Format
Title:
# 📊 VIP PPV MM Overview Summary
Summary style:
paragraph form only
start with: For this day,
mention total Mass Messages and total revenue from FM header
mention overall trend if shown (increase/decrease %)
mention strongest performer(s)
mention best-performing price band / pricing insight
keep it concise and analytical
Table title:
# 📋 PPV Breakdown (with Unlocks Only)
Table columns:
| Chatter | Caption | Price | Viewed | Unlocks | Revenue | Conv. Rate |
Validation Process You Must Follow Before Writing
Read FM header total
List all visible FM priced rows with unlocks
Match each FM caption to the chatter using the sheet
Remove rows that cannot be verified
Compute revenue and conversion rate
Check whether visible subtotal matches FM header
Then create the final summary and table
Important Writing Rules
Keep captions full, never shorten them
Keep formatting clean
Do not add bullets below the summary unless asked
Do not add extra commentary unless there is a mismatch that needs flagging
If there is a mismatch, add one short note only
 
	Past Due Custom Request
Check Model Info Sheet and screenshots any past due requests.
	4️⃣ Intervention / Coaching Feedback

Step 2: Use the internal coaching prompt
"Here's the [date] data of the team and anyone who are below minimum, provide an analysis based on the data attached, what you think went wrong and recommendation also provide any action needed for the chatter to improve, but if they had not worked for atleast 8hours then no need to include. Wait until I provide sample chats for the day to complete your analysis, cross reference other metrics as well on the data and check if previous day's action required is applied/meet."
Step 3: Attach:

At least 5 pages of chatter’s sample chats

Step 4: Review ChatGPT’s recommendation

Check if recommendations make operational sense
Remove anything unrealistic or irrelevant
Ensure it aligns with KPI goals and SOP
Step 5: Paste the finalized coaching recommendations into EOS
Then send it directly to the chatter via YUM Slack.
Step 6: Repeat Steps 4–6 for the next chatter

Individualized feedback

Specific action items

This tracker is used for:

Performance evaluation
Promotion / probation review
Accuracy is mandatory.

Once:
EOS is completed
Screenshots attached
Coaching feedback sent
KPI Tracker updated

	📊 EOW REPORT SOP
Meeting Recording: 
Recurring Frequency: Weekly
Deadline: Submit within the required weekly reporting window
Main Objective:
 To complete the End of Week (EOW) Report accurately using verified FansMetric data, internal trackers, MM Tracker validation, refund checks, and weekly KPI analysis.
🎯 PURPOSE
The EOW Report is used to provide a full weekly view of chatter performance, including:
 Weekly VIP and Free sales 
 Weekly PPV/MM sales 
 RCH / RCW 
 PPV conversion 
 Refund rate 
 KPI compliance 
 Weekly risks, performance trends, and coaching priorities 
This report must be based on exact weekly data only. No estimates, no guessing, and no unverified figures.
🗂 STEP 1: OPEN THE REQUIRED FILES AND TOOLS
Before starting, open all required tabs/files first so the process is faster:
Required Files / Sheets
 Weekly EOW Report file/template 
YUM Chatter KPI Tracker
MM Tracker
Model Info Sheet
Audit Report
 Previous week’s EOW report for reference 
Required Platforms
FansMetric
OF Data / OF Scripts / Internal sheets
ChatGPT for weekly analysis formatting 
Recommended Tabs to Open in Advance
 FM → Chat Analytics

 FM → Chargebacks / Refund section 
 MM Tracker 
 KPI Tracker 
 Last week’s EOW analysis 
📅 STEP 2: SET THE CORRECT WEEKLY DATE RANGE
Before pulling any data, confirm the exact weekly range first.
Example:
If reporting for Week 2, set the date to:
April 6 to April 12
Use this same weekly range consistently across:
 VIP message data 
 Free message data 
 Message statistics 
 MM validation 
 Refund checks 
 KPI reference 
⚠️ Make sure all tabs are using the same exact week range.
 Do not mix weekly data with month-to-date or daily data unless the section specifically requires it.
💎 STEP 3: PULL WEEKLY VIP DATA
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting → Chat Analytics
Filter Setup
 Select the correct VIP account
 Set custom date range to the correct week
 Remove unnecessary filters if not needed 
 Make sure the data shown is only for that weekly period 
Pull the following weekly VIP metrics:
For each chatter, record:
VIP Message Sales / All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
These will be used in the Weekly Chatters Data table.
Important
For weekly reporting, the core metrics taken from VIP are:
 Weekly message sales 
 RCH 
 PPV conversion 
Do not rely on memory or previous values. Always read directly from FansMetric.
💬 STEP 4: TRANSFER WEEKLY VIP MESSAGE SALES INTO THE KPI TRACKER / EOW TABLE
Using the weekly VIP Chat Analytics data, input each chatter’s:
 Weekly VIP message sales 
 Earnings per hour 
 Unlock ratio 
Make sure each chatter’s data is placed in the correct row.
Reminder
The weekly VIP sales figure used here is the chatter’s weekly VIP sales value shown in FansMetric for that date range. This value is later combined with other data points in the report where needed. 
📈 STEP 5: VALIDATE WEEKLY PPV / MM SALES USING MM TRACKER
This is one of the most important parts of the EOW process.
Go to:
MM Tracker
 Filter the tracker to the correct weekly dates 
 Select the chatter you are checking 
Important Rule
Do not trust the MM Tracker unlock counts immediately.
The unlock counts inside MM Tracker must be manually verified against FansMetric message statistics because some unlock counts may not yet be updated. 
STEP 5A: FILTER THE MM TRACKER
Apply filter to the weekly date range only.
Example:
 April 6 
 April 7 
 April 8 
 April 9 
 April 10 
 April 11 
 April 12 
Then isolate one chatter at a time.
STEP 5B: VERIFY EACH PPV CAPTION MANUALLY IN FANSMETRIC
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting Client → Statistics → Engagement → Messages
Set the date to the same weekly range.
For each MM/PPV row in the MM Tracker:
 Copy the caption or a searchable keyword from the caption 
 Search it inside FansMetric message statistics 
 Check whether the post exists 
 Verify the unlock count
 Verify the price
 Update the MM Tracker if the unlock count is outdated 
 Exclude posts that fall outside the weekly range 
If the unlock count in FM is different from MM Tracker:
Update the MM Tracker unlock count manually.
If pricing is incorrect:
Correct the price after verifying in FM.
If a post cannot be found:
Check:
 spacing 
 shortened text 
 first few words only 
 whether the caption was changed 
 whether it was posted on another date 
If a post was posted late and falls into the next day/week:
Do not count it in the current week.
 Update the date instead so it will be counted in the correct reporting week. 
If a caption cannot be found at all after checking:
Do not force it into the report. Flag it for caption replacement or exclude it until verified. 
STEP 5C: CALCULATE WEEKLY PPV/MM SALES PER CHATTER
After validating all included PPVs for that chatter:
 Sum the verified weekly PPV/MM sales total 
 Enter the total in the EOW sheet / KPI tracker under the weekly PPV/MM sales field 
Repeat the same full validation process for each chatter.
⚠️ Never use unverified subtotal numbers if rows were not checked individually.
💸 STEP 6: CHECK WEEKLY REFUNDS / CHARGEBACKS
Refunds must be checked separately.
Go to the weekly refund / chargeback section and review all entries within the same weekly period.
Process
 Check each day within the weekly date range 
 Identify refund values per chatter 
 Record only confirmed refund amounts for the week 
Important
Refund rate is not manually guessed. It must be calculated.
Formula per chatter:
Refund Rate = Refund Amount ÷ Weekly Total Sales × 100
Make sure you divide by the correct weekly total used for that chatter.
Total Weekly Refund Rate
To get the team weekly refund rate:
 Add all weekly refund amounts 
 Divide by the total weekly sales 
 Multiply by 100 
This must be entered in the overall summary section.
🆓 STEP 7: PULL WEEKLY FREE MESSAGE SALES
Go to the Free account data source and set the same weekly range.
For each chatter, record:
 Weekly Free Message Sales 
Enter the value into the weekly report.
Weekly Free PPV Sales
If Free PPV sales are being tracked that week:

The transcript notes that Free PPV posting may still depend on schedule setup and approval, so only record Free PPV sales if they actually exist and are verified. 
🔁 STEP 8: CHECK FREE TRANSFERS / RESUBS
Go to:
YUM → Model Info Sheet
Look for entries in the relevant weekly period under:

 resub 
 transfer 
Important Rule
Only count transfer
 Do not count resub
If the chatter did not clearly label whether the entry is resub or transfer:

Enter only confirmed transfer counts into the weekly report.
📊 STEP 9: COMPLETE WEEKLY CHATTERS DATA TABLE

Include:

Double-check every row before moving forward.
🟨🟩🟥 STEP 10: APPLY KPI COLOR CODING AND COMPLIANCE STATUS

Categorize chatters by weekly KPI result:

Important Weekly Rule
For weekly compliance, the transcript indicates that not all fields are included in weekly color coding the same way as daily. Weekly review focuses mainly on whether the required weekly KPI metrics are hit, especially RCW/RCH and PPV conversion, while some fields are kept visible for tracking but are not the main compliance basis. 
Compliance Status
Mark each chatter as:
Compliant
Non-compliant
based on the current weekly KPI rules.
Double-check highlighted KPI colors before finalizing. The weekly ChatGPT analysis can misread these if your raw table is wrong.
📌 STEP 11: COMPLETE OVERALL PERFORMANCE SNAPSHOT
This section summarizes the whole team’s weekly performance.
Include:
A. PPV Conversion Trend – Summary & Analysis
Write a short analysis of:
 weekly unlock ratio trend

 which chatters performed strongly 
 which chatters underperformed 
 possible reasons based on data 
B. Chatter Performance Status
List chatters under:

C. Risks / Projected Shortfalls (Bottom 3)
Identify the bottom 3 performers based on weekly performance.
For each, summarize:

 risk to KPI / bonus / consistency 
 what intervention or coaching is needed 
⚠️ Make sure the correct bottom 3 are used. The transcript specifically shows the need to double-check because ChatGPT may mislabel which chatters are actually red/yellow if the KPI reference is not read properly. 
🤖 STEP 12: USE CHATGPT TO GENERATE THE WEEKLY ANALYSIS
After your weekly table is complete, use ChatGPT to draft the narrative analysis.
Process

 Provide the previous week’s data first so ChatGPT understands the comparison point

Important
If the output is wrong:
 correct it

The transcript shows that this correction step is necessary because the first output may wrongly classify performers. 
Proofreading Rule

 KPI colors 
 Bottom 3 names

 wording consistency 
📝 STEP 13: COMPLETE OTHER NOTES / FYI

 pending customs 
 unresolved fan concerns 
 delayed requests 
 items requiring follow-up

 operational concerns

 process improvement suggestions

 weekly totals 
 daily totals 
 month-to-date totals

✅ STEP 15: FINAL REVIEW BEFORE SUBMISSION

title: Chatter MM Approval
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure Mass Messages (MM) prepared by chatters follow approved captions, correct pricing, and content rotation rules before being sent to fans.
This prevents:
Incorrect pricing
Reused content too frequently
Low-performing captions
Unapproved messaging
🛠 Tools Needed
MM Tracker
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
FansMetrics (FM)
(Vault section)
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Check MM Tracker
Open the MM Tracker and locate entries with the status:
FOR APPROVAL
These are Mass Messages waiting for admin validation.
2️⃣ Validate Caption
Confirm the caption used is:
✔ From the Scripts tab, OR
 ✔ A recycled caption from previous MMs with high unlocks
Reject if:
Caption is misleading
Caption is duplicated from a recent MM
Caption is poorly written or incomplete
3️⃣ Validate Price
Check that the price follows approved pricing structure.
✔ If the content exists in the Priced Vault Folder, the price must match.
✔ Allowance:
 Price may vary ± $5
✔ If the content is not in the priced vault, verify price using the Model Info Sheet pricing guide. OnlyFans_Pricing_Guidelines_FIN…
Reject if:
Price is missing
Price is significantly different
Pricing does not follow the model's guidelines
4️⃣ Validate Content Usage
Open FansMetrics → Vault and verify the media.
✔ Confirm the content has NOT been used in any Mass Message within the last 2 weeks.
Reject if:
The content was used recently
The content is already scheduled in another MM
5️⃣ If Issues Are Found
If any validation fails:
Add explanation in the Notes column in MM Tracker.
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → NEEDS REVISION
Common note examples:
Caption not from scripts
Incorrect pricing
Content used recently
6️⃣ If Everything Is Correct
If all checks pass:
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → APPROVED
No additional comment required.
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated MM Tracker status:
APPROVED → Ready for scheduling
NEEDS REVISION → Returned to chatter with notes
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before approving:
☑ Caption follows approved scripts or high-performing captions
 ☑ Price follows vault pricing or pricing guide
 ☑ Price difference within $5 allowance
 ☑ Content not used in last 2 weeks
 ☑ Tracker status updated correctly
📝 Notes
Always prioritize content freshness to maintain fan engagement.
Avoid approving MMs with repeated captions or recycled content too frequently.
Use clear and short comments when requesting revisions.

title: SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily

Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)
A stock keeping unit, or SKU, is an internal product identifier that helps businesses track inventory, categorize items, and monitor sales. Each SKU is unique to a product or product variation and is created by the retailer, not the manufacturer.
🎯 Objective
Ensure all chatter End-of-Day (EOD) reports are complete, clean, and properly tracked by recording reported SKUs into the monthly inventory sheet, identifying missing SKUs, and creating new SKUs when needed.
🛠 Tools Needed
SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
YUM Google Drive
FansMetrics (FM) Vault
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Review Chatter EOD Reports
Open the SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report and review all chatter submissions for the day.
Check that:
SKU entries are provided
Report format looks clean and complete
No obvious missing content references
2️⃣ Track Reported SKUs in the Month Tab
For every SKU submitted by the chatter:
Locate the correct Month tab
Add the SKU to the monthly tracking sheet
Ensure it is entered in the proper row/section
Once successfully tracked, highlight the cell so it is easy to identify which SKU has already been added.
3️⃣ If No SKU Is Provided
If the chatter submitted a sale or content entry without a SKU:
Report immediately to the Manager
Request a screenshot of the content from the chatter for verification
Do not leave the entry unresolved.
4️⃣ If SKU Is Not Found in the Monthly Tab
If the chatter provided a SKU but it cannot be found or verified in the Month tab:
Check the VIP Vault folder
Path: Emily’s OnlyFans → Google Drive → PPV Content
Verify whether the content already exists in the vault
5️⃣ If Content Exists 
Advise Manager and provide ss to communicate to chatter.
6️⃣ If Content Do not Exist
If the content do not exist in the vault: 
Go to FM > Vault and locate the content 
Take a screenshot of the content
Upload the screenshot to Google Drive
Create a new SKU for the content
Use the separate How to Create SKU process reference for the proper SKU creation steps.
 Finalize Tracking
Once the SKU is verified or newly created:
Add it to the Month tab
Highlight the added cell
Make sure the report is now complete and trackable
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report with:
All reported SKUs tracked in the Month tab
Highlighted cells for newly added SKUs
Missing SKU cases escalated
New SKUs created when applicable
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before closing the task, verify:
☑ Chatter EOD reports were reviewed
 ☑ SKU entries were tracked in the correct Month tab
 ☑ Newly tracked SKUs were highlighted
 ☑ Missing SKUs were reported to Manager
 ☑ VIP Vault was checked when SKU could not be found
 ☑ Screenshot was uploaded before creating a new SKU

Escalate immediately if:
Chatter submitted a sale with no SKU
Screenshot is still missing after request

title: Timesheet & Resub/Transfer
description:
TIMESHEEET OVERVIEW
This SOP outlines the weekly process of validating individual chatter timesheets, cross-referencing them with Slack reports, and consolidating verified work hours into the master YUM Hours sheet. This ensures accurate and timely payroll tracking for Emily’s OnlyFans team.
TASK
Verify and update each chatter’s weekly working hours and meeting attendance by cross-checking individual logs with Slack activity and compiling results in the YUM Hours sheet. Final submission is due every Thursday by 7:00 AM PST.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Individual Chatter Timesheets 
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Chatters - Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Hours Master Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Slack – For verifying login/logout times
Fathom / Meeting Notes – For verifying meeting attendance
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Access Chatter Timesheets
Open each chatter’s individual Google Sheet
Review login/out times, shift durations, and coverage notes (if any)
 
STEP 2: Cross-Reference with Slack Logs (Reports Channel) 
Use Slack reports (via Dali’s view or direct access)
Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PHT)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PHT
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PHT
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
Check attendance for Monday meetings 
 Verify via recording or Slack updates 
Pay Computation
 Adjust hours first 
 Multiply hours × rate = base pay 
Incentives
Top Chatter:
 Top 1 → $75 
 Top 2 → $50 
Resub & Transfer Bonus:
 $10–$19 → $40 
 $20+ → $100 
Top Chatter Computation
 Based on audit report (Monday–Sunday data) 
Adjustment:
 6-day worker (Xaviera) → divide earnings by 6 
 Others → divide by 5 
 Rank based on adjusted values 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"
If any of the above criteria is missed, mark as Invalid. 

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

Resub Cases
 Fan explicitly resubscribed 
 Previous VIP → stopped → re-engaged via message/MM 
 Check Billing info to verify if the fan actually resubscribed 
MM Checking
 Use MM Tracker to identify sender 
 Since MM has no chatter name, always cross-check 
Interaction Rule
 Any chatter can interact 
 Credit goes to: 
 Last MM sender 
 Source of resub/transfer 
Invalid Cases
 Username not found / inactive 
 No interaction (buried or no reply) 
 No clear MM or chat basis 
STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 5: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

title: Onboard/Offboard list
description:
SOP: Chatter Onboarding and Offboarding Access
Overview
This SOP is used when adding a new chatter to the team or removing access from a chatter who is no longer active.
The goal is to make sure every chatter has the correct tools, trackers, folders, documents, and communication access needed for their assigned role. It also ensures that all access is removed properly during offboarding.
Important: Chatters must only be added to ClickUp as Guest. Do not add chatters as ClickUp Members.
Task
Add or remove chatter access from the required YUM tools, trackers, folders, SOP documents, and communication platforms.
Tools Required
☑ Google Drive
☑ Google Sheets
☑ ClickUp
☑ ClickUp Docs / SOPs for Chatters
☑ Slack
☑ OnlyFans / Fan Management Access
ONBOARDING CHECKLIST
1. Confirm Chatter Details
Before giving access, confirm the following:
☐ Chatter full name
☐ Email address to be used for access
☐ Assigned account: VIP, FREE, or both
☐ Start date
☐ Assigned manager or team lead
☐ Role or responsibility
2. Add Access to Main Tools
Give the chatter access to the required main tools.
Core Access
☐ Slack
☐ ClickUp — add as Guest only
☐ Emily’s OnlyFans Google Drive
☐ Chatters - Yum Hours Google Sheet
☐ Model’s Info Sheet: Emily’s Custom & Live Schedule
Important: Do not add chatters to ClickUp as Members. Always add them as Guests only.
3. Add Access to SOPs for Chatters
Add the chatter to the SOPs for Chatters document in ClickUp.
Steps:
Open ClickUp.
Go to the SOPs for Chatters document.
Click the three dots beside the document.
Select Sharing and Permissions.
Add the chatter using their correct work email.
Make sure the chatter is added as Guest only, not Member.
Confirm that they can open and view the document.
Make sure the chatter has access to the SOPs they need before they start working.
4. Add Access to Account-Specific Trackers
Only give access based on the chatter’s assigned account.
VIP Account Access
☐ VIP YUM Sales SKU Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
☐ MM Tracker - VIP Account
☐ Wallpost Tracker - VIP
☐ Green Sales Folder - VIP
FREE Account Access
☐ FREE YUM Sales SKU Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
☐ MM Tracker - FREE Account
☐ Wallpost Tracker - FREE
☐ Green Sales Folder - FREE
If the chatter is assigned to both VIP and FREE, give access to both sets of trackers and folders.
5. Set Up Communication Access
Add the chatter to the correct Slack channels.
☐ General / team announcement channel
☐ Chatter updates channel
☐ VIP account channel, if assigned to VIP
☐ FREE account channel, if assigned to FREE
☐ Approval / reporting channel, if applicable
Remind the chatter to check Slack daily for updates, announcements, revisions, and important instructions.
6. Confirm Tracker and Folder Access
Ask the chatter to open each assigned tool, tracker, folder, and document to make sure they have access.
Confirm the following:
☐ They can open the Google Sheets
☐ They can edit the required tracker tabs
☐ They can access the correct Google Drive folders
☐ They can see ClickUp tasks or docs as Guest
☐ They can access SOPs for Chatters in ClickUp
☐ They can access the correct Slack channels
If anything is restricted, update the sharing settings immediately.
7. Send Onboarding Confirmation
Once access is complete, send a short confirmation message to the chatter.
Example:
Hi, your access has been added. Please check Slack, ClickUp, SOPs for Chatters, Drive, Yum Hours, and your assigned trackers. Let me know if anything is restricted or not opening on your end.
OFFBOARDING CHECKLIST
1. Confirm Offboarding Details
Before removing access, confirm the following:
☐ Chatter name
☐ Last working day
☐ Assigned account: VIP, FREE, or both
☐ Final payroll status
☐ Pending tasks or reports
☐ Any files, trackers, or entries that need to be reviewed before removal
2. Remove Access from Main Tools
Remove the chatter from the following platforms:
☐ Slack
☐ ClickUp Guest access
☐ Emily’s OnlyFans Google Drive
☐ Chatters - Yum Hours Google Sheet
☐ Model’s Info Sheet: Emily’s Custom & Live Schedule
3. Remove Access from SOPs for Chatters
Remove the chatter from the SOPs for Chatters document in ClickUp.
Steps:
Open ClickUp.
Go to the SOPs for Chatters document.
Click the three dots beside the document.
Select Sharing and Permissions.
Remove the chatter’s email from the document access.
Confirm that the chatter no longer has access.
4. Remove Access from Account-Specific Trackers
Remove access based on the chatter’s previous assignment.
VIP Account Access
☐ VIP YUM Sales SKU Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
☐ MM Tracker - VIP Account
☐ Wallpost Tracker - VIP
☐ Green Sales Folder - VIP
FREE Account Access
☐ FREE YUM Sales SKU Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
☐ MM Tracker - FREE Account
☐ Wallpost Tracker - FREE
☐ Green Sales Folder - FREE
If the chatter had access to both VIP and FREE, remove access from both.
5. Remove from Slack Channels
Remove the chatter from all related Slack channels.
☐ Team announcement channel
☐ Chatter updates channel
☐ VIP account channel
☐ FREE account channel
☐ Approval / reporting channel
☐ Any private or manager-only channels, if applicable
6. Review Pending Work Before Full Removal
Before fully closing access, check if the chatter has any pending work.
☐ Unsubmitted EOD report
☐ Unscheduled MM entry
☐ Pending wallpost entry
☐ Payroll hours not yet checked
☐ Open ClickUp task
☐ Pending correction or revision
☐ Pending custom request entry, if applicable
If there are pending items, document them first before removing access.
7. Confirm Access Removal
After removing all access, do a final check.
☐ Google Drive access removed
☐ Google Sheets access removed
☐ ClickUp Guest access removed
☐ SOPs for Chatters access removed
☐ Slack access removed
☐ Account-specific trackers removed
☐ Manager or team lead notified
Important Notes / Tips / Warnings
☑ Always add chatters to ClickUp as Guest only.
☑ Do not ever add chatters to ClickUp as Members.
☑ Only give access to the trackers needed for the chatter’s assigned account.
☑ Do not give VIP access to FREE-only chatters unless approved.
☑ Do not give FREE access to VIP-only chatters unless approved.
☑ Always use the chatter’s correct work email when adding access.
☑ Always add chatters to SOPs for Chatters through Sharing and Permissions in ClickUp.
☑ Always remove access immediately once a chatter is officially offboarded.
☑ Check Google Drive, Google Sheets, ClickUp Docs, and folders separately because removing access from one file does not always remove access from all files.
☑ Document the date when access was added or removed.
☑ If access cannot be added or removed, notify the manager immediately.
Completion Standard
The onboarding or offboarding process is complete when:
☐ All required access has been added or removed.
☐ The chatter has been added to or removed from SOPs for Chatters.
☐ The chatter was added to ClickUp as Guest only.
☐ The correct account-specific trackers have been updated.
☐ Slack and ClickUp access have been updated.
☐ The chatter or manager has been notified.
☐ Any access issues have been reported and resolved.

title: Reporting (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
description:
Recurring: Daily
	Deadline: 5PM 
	🎯 Purpose
To ensure all End of Shift (EOS) Reports are completed accurately, consistently, and based on verified FansMetric data.
	
	🗂 STEP 1: Access the EOS Folder
Go to Info Bookmark Folder
Click on: YUM
Open: 2026 | EOS
Select the dedicated EOS template for the correct date
	⚠️ If the selected date has no tables yet:
Copy the previous day’s EOS table format
Paste it into the current day’s document
Make sure all dates are updated correctly
	
	📊 STEP 2: Generate the Data (3PM PHT)
	1️⃣ Access FansMetric Data
Go to:
FM → Chatting → Chat Analytics
	
	2️⃣ Adjust Filters
Select correct Account (Free or VIP)
Select correct Date
	❌ Remove:
Shift Time filter
Correct Chatter filter
(We now extract overall account dat  a per shift based on date only.)
	
	3️⃣ Extract & Rename Required Metrics
When pulling data from Chat Analytics, use the following naming standards in EOS:
VIP MESSAGES + TIPS / RCD → All Earnings
RCH → Earnings Per Hour
PPV Con % → Unlock Ratio
Ensure all data reflects:
Total Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Messages Sent
Priced Messages
PPVs Sold
Other required KPI metrics
⚠️ No estimated values. Only use exact FansMetric numbers.
	
	4️⃣ Extract Refund / Chargeback Data (Separate Process)
Refunds are NOT taken from Chat Analytics.
Go to:
FM → Chatting Client → VIP → Statistics → Adjust Date → Chargebacks
Adjust to correct date
Extract total chargebacks for that day
Record net refund impact in EOS
If applicable, note which shift it falls under
	
	5️⃣ Cross-Check Slack & Internal Compliance
Before finalizing EOS, you MUST check:
	🔎 YUM Slack:
Missed Shift reports (Report Channel)
Any announcements affecting the shift
	📩 Direct Messages:
Check chatter’s DM to Divine
Check SFL (Save For Later)
	⚠️ SOP Violations:
Confirm if any violation was reported during the shift
Add note in EOS if applicable
 
	📊 STEP 3: Fill Out EOS Table 
	1️⃣ Fill Out Required Data in the Table
Enter all extracted data from:
FM → Chatting → Chat Analytics
FM → Chatting Client → VIP → Statistics → Chargebacks
Include only the required metrics:
All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Chargebacks (if any)
⚠️ Removed:
Messages Sent
Priced Messages
PPVs Sold
Double-check totals before submission.
 No estimates. No manual manipulation.
	
	2️⃣ Paste Supporting Screenshots
EOS must include proof of data:
📸 Screenshot of Chat Analytics
📸 Screenshot of Chargebacks (if applicable)
No EOS submission without screenshots.
	
	3️⃣ Under “Other Sections / FYI”
You MUST include:
	🔎 Slack Cross-Reference Confirmation
Confirm whether:
There were any SFL (Save For Later) operational items
Status of Ongoing Projects / Tasks
Fans Corner – Any issue raised by fans and reported by the chatter
Example structure:
Other Sections / FYI:
Ongoing Projects/Tasks Status: [Brief update]

[Fan Name] – Issue raised
[Fan Name] – Complaint / request / concern
[Fan Name] – Pending model confirmation
If none:
	No SFL items, no ongoing escalations, no fan issues reported then just omit the section
	
 
 
	PPV Summary & Overview 
Screenshot the ff: 
Messages > Statistics > MM > Adjust Date
MM Tracker for chatter  and captions references
 
Utilize ChatGPT in summarizing and proof read.

📈 STEP 5: VALIDATE WEEKLY PPV / MM SALES USING MM TRACKER

MM Tracker

 Check whether the post exists 
 Verify the unlock count
 Verify the price
 Update the MM Tracker if the unlock count is outdated 
 Exclude posts that fall outside the weekly range 
If the unlock count in FM is different from MM Tracker:
Update the MM Tracker unlock count manually.
If pricing is incorrect:
Correct the price after verifying in FM.
If a post cannot be found:
Check:
 spacing 
 shortened text 
 first few words only 
 whether the caption was changed 
 whether it was posted on another date

 Update the date instead so it will be counted in the correct reporting week.

Make sure you divide by the correct weekly total used for that chatter.
Total Weekly Refund Rate
To get the team weekly refund rate:
 Add all weekly refund amounts 
 Divide by the total weekly sales 
 Multiply by 100

description:

Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure Mass Messages (MM) prepared by chatters follow approved captions, correct pricing, and content rotation rules before being sent to fans.
This prevents:
Incorrect pricing
Reused content too frequently
Low-performing captions
Unapproved messaging
🛠 Tools Needed
MM Tracker
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
FansMetrics (FM)
(Vault section)
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Check MM Tracker
Open the MM Tracker and locate entries with the status:
FOR APPROVAL
These are Mass Messages waiting for admin validation.
2️⃣ Validate Caption
Confirm the caption used is:
✔ From the Scripts tab, OR
 ✔ A recycled caption from previous MMs with high unlocks
Reject if:
Caption is misleading
Caption is duplicated from a recent MM
Caption is poorly written or incomplete
3️⃣ Validate Price
Check that the price follows approved pricing structure.
✔ If the content exists in the Priced Vault Folder, the price must match.
✔ Allowance:
 Price may vary ± $5
✔ If the content is not in the priced vault, verify price using the Model Info Sheet pricing guide. OnlyFans_Pricing_Guidelines_FIN…
Reject if:
Price is missing
Price is significantly different
Pricing does not follow the model's guidelines
4️⃣ Validate Content Usage
Open FansMetrics → Vault and verify the media.
✔ Confirm the content has NOT been used in any Mass Message within the last 2 weeks.
Reject if:
The content was used recently
The content is already scheduled in another MM
5️⃣ If Issues Are Found
If any validation fails:
Add explanation in the Notes column in MM Tracker.
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → NEEDS REVISION
Common note examples:
Caption not from scripts
Incorrect pricing
Content used recently
6️⃣ If Everything Is Correct
If all checks pass:
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → APPROVED
No additional comment required.
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated MM Tracker status:
APPROVED → Ready for scheduling
NEEDS REVISION → Returned to chatter with notes
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before approving:
☑ Caption follows approved scripts or high-performing captions
 ☑ Price follows vault pricing or pricing guide
 ☑ Price difference within $5 allowance
 ☑ Content not used in last 2 weeks
 ☑ Tracker status updated correctly
📝 Notes
Always prioritize content freshness to maintain fan engagement.
Avoid approving MMs with repeated captions or recycled content too frequently.
Use clear and short comments when requesting revisions.

description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily

Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)
A stock keeping unit, or SKU, is an internal product identifier that helps businesses track inventory, categorize items, and monitor sales. Each SKU is unique to a product or product variation and is created by the retailer, not the manufacturer.
🎯 Objective
Ensure all chatter End-of-Day (EOD) reports are complete, clean, and properly tracked by recording reported SKUs into the monthly inventory sheet, identifying missing SKUs, and creating new SKUs when needed.
🛠 Tools Needed
SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
YUM Google Drive
FansMetrics (FM) Vault
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Review Chatter EOD Reports
Open the SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report and review all chatter submissions for the day.
Check that:
SKU entries are provided
Report format looks clean and complete
No obvious missing content references
2️⃣ Track Reported SKUs in the Month Tab
For every SKU submitted by the chatter:
Locate the correct Month tab
Add the SKU to the monthly tracking sheet
Ensure it is entered in the proper row/section
Once successfully tracked, highlight the cell so it is easy to identify which SKU has already been added.
3️⃣ If No SKU Is Provided
If the chatter submitted a sale or content entry without a SKU:
Report immediately to the Manager
Request a screenshot of the content from the chatter for verification
Do not leave the entry unresolved.
4️⃣ If SKU Is Not Found in the Monthly Tab
If the chatter provided a SKU but it cannot be found or verified in the Month tab:
Check the VIP Vault folder
Path: Emily’s OnlyFans → Google Drive → PPV Content
Verify whether the content already exists in the vault
5️⃣ If Content Exists 
Advise Manager and provide ss to communicate to chatter.
6️⃣ If Content Do not Exist
If the content do not exist in the vault: 
Go to FM > Vault and locate the content 
Take a screenshot of the content
Upload the screenshot to Google Drive
Create a new SKU for the content
Use the separate How to Create SKU process reference for the proper SKU creation steps.
 Finalize Tracking
Once the SKU is verified or newly created:
Add it to the Month tab
Highlight the added cell
Make sure the report is now complete and trackable
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report with:
All reported SKUs tracked in the Month tab
Highlighted cells for newly added SKUs
Missing SKU cases escalated
New SKUs created when applicable
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before closing the task, verify:
☑ Chatter EOD reports were reviewed
 ☑ SKU entries were tracked in the correct Month tab
 ☑ Newly tracked SKUs were highlighted
 ☑ Missing SKUs were reported to Manager
 ☑ VIP Vault was checked when SKU could not be found
 ☑ Screenshot was uploaded before creating a new SKU
 ☑ New SKU was created only if content existed and no SKU was assigned yet
🚨 Escalation Rules
Escalate immediately if:
Chatter submitted a sale with no SKU
Screenshot is still missing after request
Content cannot be found in vault or report
Duplicate or conflicting SKU is detected
Report submission is incomplete or unclear
📝 Notes
Always make sure tracking is updated on the same day to avoid missed inventory entries.
Highlighting newly added SKUs is required for easy monitoring.
Do not guess or invent a SKU without verifying the content first.
Follow the separate How to Create SKU guide when creating a new one.

title: QA AOM set-up
description:
OVERVIEW
Automated Online Messages (AOMs) are short, engaging one-liners sent to fans when they log in. These messages are designed to reflect Emily’s personality and encourage chat engagement across both VIP (Paid) and Free OnlyFans accounts.
TASK
Create one-liner AOMs per day to be used across:
VIP (Paid) Account (4 AOMs daily)
Free Account (2 AOMs daily)
These AOMs should drive engagement and feel natural, even if a fan receives all on the same day.
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Create the AOMs
Use ChatGPT to help write the AOMs.
Tone must match Emily’s brand: bubbly, sexy/flirty, and playful.
Keep messages short, natural, one-liner, and conversational
Avoid endearments (e.g., babe, hun, baby).
STEP 2: Schedule the AOMs in Fansmetric
VIP (Paid) Account
Schedule the 4 AOMs with 6 hours intervals
Starts 10:00 PM PHT (current day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 4:00 AM PHT (next day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 10:00 AM PHT (next day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 4:00 PM PHT (next day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
To: Fans
Exclude: Muted, Whales, Boyfriend VIP, Exclude from PPV/MM
Add 3 Preview Photos weekly to any AOM in the Paid Account by navigating to: Chatting Client > Automations > Auto Online Messages (select AOM, edit message, add media)
Free Account
Schedule 2 AOMs
Starts 10:00 PM PHT (current day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
Starts 11:50 PM PHT (current day) Ends 10:00 PM PHT (next day)
To: Fans
Exclude: Muted, Already in Paid, Exclude from PPV/MM
 
NOTES
Always prioritize the VIP account first before scheduling for the Free account.
Watch out for weekly manager meeting updates, as AOM strategies may be reviewed or changed.

	📊 EOW REPORT SOP
Meeting Recording: 
Recurring Frequency: Weekly
Deadline: Submit within the required weekly reporting window
Main Objective:
 To complete the End of Week (EOW) Report accurately using verified FansMetric data, internal trackers, MM Tracker validation, refund checks, and weekly KPI analysis.
🎯 PURPOSE
The EOW Report is used to provide a full weekly view of chatter performance, including:
 Weekly VIP and Free sales 
 Weekly PPV/MM sales 
 RCH / RCW 
 PPV conversion 
 Refund rate 
 KPI compliance 
 Weekly risks, performance trends, and coaching priorities 
This report must be based on exact weekly data only. No estimates, no guessing, and no unverified figures.
🗂 STEP 1: OPEN THE REQUIRED FILES AND TOOLS
Before starting, open all required tabs/files first so the process is faster:
Required Files / Sheets
 Weekly EOW Report file/template 
YUM Chatter KPI Tracker
MM Tracker
Model Info Sheet
Audit Report
 Previous week’s EOW report for reference 
Required Platforms
FansMetric
OF Data / OF Scripts / Internal sheets
ChatGPT for weekly analysis formatting 
Recommended Tabs to Open in Advance
 FM → Chat Analytics 
 FM → Chatting Client → Statistics → Messages 
 FM → Chargebacks / Refund section 
 MM Tracker 
 KPI Tracker 
 Last week’s EOW analysis 
📅 STEP 2: SET THE CORRECT WEEKLY DATE RANGE
Before pulling any data, confirm the exact weekly range first.
Example:
If reporting for Week 2, set the date to:
April 6 to April 12
Use this same weekly range consistently across:
 VIP message data 
 Free message data 
 Message statistics 
 MM validation 
 Refund checks 
 KPI reference 
⚠️ Make sure all tabs are using the same exact week range.
 Do not mix weekly data with month-to-date or daily data unless the section specifically requires it.
💎 STEP 3: PULL WEEKLY VIP DATA
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting → Chat Analytics
Filter Setup
 Select the correct VIP account
 Set custom date range to the correct week
 Remove unnecessary filters if not needed 
 Make sure the data shown is only for that weekly period 
Pull the following weekly VIP metrics:
For each chatter, record:
VIP Message Sales / All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
These will be used in the Weekly Chatters Data table.
Important
For weekly reporting, the core metrics taken from VIP are:
 Weekly message sales 
 RCH 
 PPV conversion 
Do not rely on memory or previous values. Always read directly from FansMetric.
💬 STEP 4: TRANSFER WEEKLY VIP MESSAGE SALES INTO THE KPI TRACKER / EOW TABLE
Using the weekly VIP Chat Analytics data, input each chatter’s:
 Weekly VIP message sales 
 Earnings per hour 
 Unlock ratio 
Make sure each chatter’s data is placed in the correct row.
Reminder
The weekly VIP sales figure used here is the chatter’s weekly VIP sales value shown in FansMetric for that date range. This value is later combined with other data points in the report where needed. 
📈 STEP 5: VALIDATE WEEKLY PPV / MM SALES USING MM TRACKER
This is one of the most important parts of the EOW process.
Go to:
MM Tracker
 Filter the tracker to the correct weekly dates 
 Select the chatter you are checking 
Important Rule
Do not trust the MM Tracker unlock counts immediately.
The unlock counts inside MM Tracker must be manually verified against FansMetric message statistics because some unlock counts may not yet be updated. 
STEP 5A: FILTER THE MM TRACKER
Apply filter to the weekly date range only.
Example:
 April 6 
 April 7 
 April 8 
 April 9 
 April 10 
 April 11 
 April 12 
Then isolate one chatter at a time.
STEP 5B: VERIFY EACH PPV CAPTION MANUALLY IN FANSMETRIC
Go to:
FansMetric → Chatting Client → Statistics → Engagement → Messages
Set the date to the same weekly range.
For each MM/PPV row in the MM Tracker:
 Copy the caption or a searchable keyword from the caption 
 Search it inside FansMetric message statistics 
 Check whether the post exists 
 Verify the unlock count
 Verify the price
 Update the MM Tracker if the unlock count is outdated 
 Exclude posts that fall outside the weekly range 
If the unlock count in FM is different from MM Tracker:
Update the MM Tracker unlock count manually.
If pricing is incorrect:
Correct the price after verifying in FM.
If a post cannot be found:
Check:
 spacing 
 shortened text 
 first few words only 
 whether the caption was changed 
 whether it was posted on another date 
If a post was posted late and falls into the next day/week:
Do not count it in the current week.
 Update the date instead so it will be counted in the correct reporting week. 
If a caption cannot be found at all after checking:
Do not force it into the report. Flag it for caption replacement or exclude it until verified. 
STEP 5C: CALCULATE WEEKLY PPV/MM SALES PER CHATTER
After validating all included PPVs for that chatter:
 Sum the verified weekly PPV/MM sales total 
 Enter the total in the EOW sheet / KPI tracker under the weekly PPV/MM sales field 
Repeat the same full validation process for each chatter.
⚠️ Never use unverified subtotal numbers if rows were not checked individually.
💸 STEP 6: CHECK WEEKLY REFUNDS / CHARGEBACKS
Refunds must be checked separately.
Go to the weekly refund / chargeback section and review all entries within the same weekly period.
Process
 Check each day within the weekly date range 
 Identify refund values per chatter 
 Record only confirmed refund amounts for the week 
Important
Refund rate is not manually guessed. It must be calculated.
Formula per chatter:
Refund Rate = Refund Amount ÷ Weekly Total Sales × 100
Make sure you divide by the correct weekly total used for that chatter.
Total Weekly Refund Rate
To get the team weekly refund rate:
 Add all weekly refund amounts 
 Divide by the total weekly sales 
 Multiply by 100 
This must be entered in the overall summary section.
🆓 STEP 7: PULL WEEKLY FREE MESSAGE SALES
Go to the Free account data source and set the same weekly range.
For each chatter, record:
 Weekly Free Message Sales 
Enter the value into the weekly report.
Weekly Free PPV Sales
If Free PPV sales are being tracked that week:
 Use the same validation process as VIP PPV/MM sales 
 If there are no Free PPV sales set up yet, enter zero only if confirmed operationally 
The transcript notes that Free PPV posting may still depend on schedule setup and approval, so only record Free PPV sales if they actually exist and are verified. 
🔁 STEP 8: CHECK FREE TRANSFERS / RESUBS
Go to:
YUM → Model Info Sheet
Look for entries in the relevant weekly period under:
 pause funds 
 resub 
 transfer 
Important Rule
Only count transfer
 Do not count resub
If the chatter did not clearly label whether the entry is resub or transfer:
 confirm first if possible 
 if still unclear, leave it pending for update 
Enter only confirmed transfer counts into the weekly report.
📊 STEP 9: COMPLETE WEEKLY CHATTERS DATA TABLE
Populate the Weekly Chatters Data table for each chatter using verified values only.
Include:
 VIP Message Sales 
 PPV/MM Sales 
 RCH 
 PPV Conversion 
 Refund Amount 
 Refund Rate 
 Free Message Sales 
 Free PPV Sales 
 Free Transfers 
Double-check every row before moving forward.
🟨🟩🟥 STEP 10: APPLY KPI COLOR CODING AND COMPLIANCE STATUS
After completing the weekly data, apply KPI color coding based on the current KPI thresholds.
Chatter Performance Status
Categorize chatters by weekly KPI result:
 🟢 Green – Meeting KPI 
 🟡 Yellow – Slightly below KPI 
 🔴 Red – Not meeting KPI 
Important Weekly Rule
For weekly compliance, the transcript indicates that not all fields are included in weekly color coding the same way as daily. Weekly review focuses mainly on whether the required weekly KPI metrics are hit, especially RCW/RCH and PPV conversion, while some fields are kept visible for tracking but are not the main compliance basis. 
Compliance Status
Mark each chatter as:
Compliant
Non-compliant
based on the current weekly KPI rules.
Double-check highlighted KPI colors before finalizing. The weekly ChatGPT analysis can misread these if your raw table is wrong.
📌 STEP 11: COMPLETE OVERALL PERFORMANCE SNAPSHOT
This section summarizes the whole team’s weekly performance.
Include:
A. PPV Conversion Trend – Summary & Analysis
Write a short analysis of:
 weekly unlock ratio trend 
 whether conversion improved, declined, or stayed stable 
 which chatters performed strongly 
 which chatters underperformed 
 possible reasons based on data 
B. Chatter Performance Status
List chatters under:
 Green 
 Yellow 
 Red 
Add short notes for Yellow and Red performers.
C. Risks / Projected Shortfalls (Bottom 3)
Identify the bottom 3 performers based on weekly performance.
For each, summarize:
 what likely went wrong 
 risk to KPI / bonus / consistency 
 what intervention or coaching is needed 
⚠️ Make sure the correct bottom 3 are used. The transcript specifically shows the need to double-check because ChatGPT may mislabel which chatters are actually red/yellow if the KPI reference is not read properly. 
🤖 STEP 12: USE CHATGPT TO GENERATE THE WEEKLY ANALYSIS
After your weekly table is complete, use ChatGPT to draft the narrative analysis.
Process
 Copy the previous week’s analysis format 
 Provide the previous week’s data first so ChatGPT understands the comparison point 
 Then provide the current week’s data 
 Include KPI screenshots or weekly table screenshots 
 Instruct ChatGPT to keep the same format as the previous week 
Important
If the output is wrong:
 correct it 
 tell ChatGPT exactly what was misread 
 make it regenerate using the correct KPI interpretation 
The transcript shows that this correction step is necessary because the first output may wrongly classify performers. 
Proofreading Rule
Never paste ChatGPT output directly without checking:
 KPI colors 
 Bottom 3 names 
 Weekly figures 
 trend statements 
 wording consistency 
📝 STEP 13: COMPLETE OTHER NOTES / FYI
Include the following sections:
A. Audit Report
Insert the spreadsheet link only.
B. Past Due Report
List:
 pending customs 
 unresolved fan concerns 
 delayed requests 
 items requiring follow-up 
C. Issues / Proposals
Include:
 operational concerns 
 approval delays 
 caption replacement issues 
 free schedule setup issues 
 process improvement suggestions 
Only include actual items that happened during the week.
📅 STEP 14: FILL MONTH-TO-DATE / TOTAL SUMMARY FIELDS IF REQUIRED
If your EOW template contains a team summary or month-to-date section, populate it carefully using the correct source.
This may include:
 month-to-date message sales 
 month-to-date tips 
 total net sales 
 total RCH/RCW 
 overall refund rate 
 overall unlock ratio 
⚠️ Be very careful not to confuse:
 weekly totals 
 daily totals 
 month-to-date totals 
Only fill these if the template specifically requires them.
✅ STEP 15: FINAL REVIEW BEFORE SUBMISSION
Before submitting, confirm all of the following:
Data Accuracy Check
 Correct weekly date range used everywhere 
 VIP data matches FansMetric 
 Free data matches source sheet 
 MM/PPV sales were manually validated 
 Refund amounts were checked separately 
 KPI colors are correct 
 Bottom 3 are correct 
 Compliance labels are correct 
Report Completeness Check
 Weekly Chatters Data table completed 
 Overall Performance Snapshot completed 
 Risks / Projected Shortfalls completed 
 Audit Report link added 
 Past Due Report updated 
 Issues / Proposals updated 
 ChatGPT analysis proofread and corrected 
🚨 NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES
 Do not estimate missing values 
 Do not count unverified MM sales 
 Do not include posts outside the weekly date range 
 Do not count resubs as transfers 
 Do not rely on MM Tracker alone without FM checking 
 Do not rely on ChatGPT analysis without manual proofreading 
 Do not finalize the report unless all weekly figures are verified 
✔ EOW REPORT IS COMPLETE ONLY WHEN:
 Weekly data is fully verified 
 MM sales are manually checked 
 Refunds are confirmed 
 KPI status is accurate 
 Analysis is proofread 
 Links and operational notes are updated 
 Report is ready for manager / Boss D review 
	3️⃣ Other Notes / FYI
	Audit Report
Just provide the link of the audit report.
	Past Due Report
List pending customs or unresolved fan requests.
	Issues / Proposals
Include operational issues, improvement suggestions, or strategy proposals.
	
✔ Ensure data is verified before submission.
 ✔ Weekly report should clearly highlight performance trends, risks, and operational updates.

title: SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily

Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)
A stock keeping unit, or SKU, is an internal product identifier that helps businesses track inventory, categorize items, and monitor sales. Each SKU is unique to a product or product variation and is created by the retailer, not the manufacturer.
🎯 Objective
Ensure all chatter End-of-Day (EOD) reports are complete, clean, and properly tracked by recording reported SKUs into the monthly inventory sheet, identifying missing SKUs, and creating new SKUs when needed.
🛠 Tools Needed
SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
YUM Google Drive
FansMetrics (FM) Vault
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Review Chatter EOD Reports
Open the SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report and review all chatter submissions for the day.
Check that:
SKU entries are provided
Report format looks clean and complete
No obvious missing content references
2️⃣ Track Reported SKUs in the Month Tab
For every SKU submitted by the chatter:
Locate the correct Month tab
Add the SKU to the monthly tracking sheet
Ensure it is entered in the proper row/section
Once successfully tracked, highlight the cell so it is easy to identify which SKU has already been added.
3️⃣ If No SKU Is Provided
If the chatter submitted a sale or content entry without a SKU:
Report immediately to the Manager
Request a screenshot of the content from the chatter for verification
Do not leave the entry unresolved.
4️⃣ If SKU Is Not Found in the Monthly Tab
If the chatter provided a SKU but it cannot be found or verified in the Month tab:
Check the VIP Vault folder
Path: Emily’s OnlyFans → Google Drive → PPV Content
Verify whether the content already exists in the vault
5️⃣ If Content Exists 
Advise Manager and provide ss to communicate to chatter.
6️⃣ If Content Do not Exist
If the content do not exist in the vault: 
Go to FM > Vault and locate the content 
Take a screenshot of the content
Upload the screenshot to Google Drive
Create a new SKU for the content
Use the separate How to Create SKU process reference for the proper SKU creation steps.
 Finalize Tracking
Once the SKU is verified or newly created:
Add it to the Month tab
Highlight the added cell
Make sure the report is now complete and trackable
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report with:
All reported SKUs tracked in the Month tab
Highlighted cells for newly added SKUs
Missing SKU cases escalated
New SKUs created when applicable
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before closing the task, verify:
☑ Chatter EOD reports were reviewed
 ☑ SKU entries were tracked in the correct Month tab
 ☑ Newly tracked SKUs were highlighted
 ☑ Missing SKUs were reported to Manager
 ☑ VIP Vault was checked when SKU could not be found
 ☑ Screenshot was uploaded before creating a new SKU
 ☑ New SKU was created only if content existed and no SKU was assigned yet
🚨 Escalation Rules
Escalate immediately if:
Chatter submitted a sale with no SKU
Screenshot is still missing after request
Content cannot be found in vault or report
Duplicate or conflicting SKU is detected
Report submission is incomplete or unclear
📝 Notes
Always make sure tracking is updated on the same day to avoid missed inventory entries.
Highlighting newly added SKUs is required for easy monitoring.
Do not guess or invent a SKU without verifying the content first.
Follow the separate How to Create SKU guide when creating a new one.

Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)
A stock keeping unit, or SKU, is an internal product identifier that helps businesses track inventory, categorize items, and monitor sales. Each SKU is unique to a product or product variation and is created by the retailer, not the manufacturer.
🎯 Objective
Ensure all chatter End-of-Day (EOD) reports are complete, clean, and properly tracked by recording reported SKUs into the monthly inventory sheet, identifying missing SKUs, and creating new SKUs when needed.

 Finalize Tracking

Highlight the added cell
Make sure the report is now complete and trackable

Updated SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report with:
