title: Audit Report
description:
OBJECTIVE
To accurately generate weekly audit reports for OnlyFans accounts, ensuring all data is updated, and necessary details and screenshots are included.
PREREQUISITES
Access Requirements:
FansMetric (FM) account login credentials.
Access to info@divineorigines.com.
Access to the Reports folder in Google Drive: Google Drive Reports Folder.
Timing:
Run the report after 12:00 AM (Monday, EST).
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Log in to FansMetric (FM)
Open the FansMetric platform.
Use the credentials for divine.origines@gmail.com to log in.
STEP 2: Access the Latest Report
Open the Google Drive Reports Folder.
Locate the most recent report file.
Make a copy of the file to avoid overwriting the original.
STEP 3: Update Dates
Open the copied report in Google Slides.
Update the date range in the report title and on the first page. Use the reporting period of the past week (Monday to Sunday).
STEP 4: Populate Key Data
Total Followers:
Extract the Paid Account and Free Account follower count data from FansMetric.
Include the weekly change (e.g., +218 or -202).
Follow the same steps for both accounts.

Weekly Sales (Paid and Free Accounts):
Navigate to the Sales Metrics section in FansMetric.

Scroll down and include Chatter Performance Report screenshots. 
Total Sales:
Add Net Sales and Gross Sales data.
Match the font color if there's a decrease or increase from last week's sales. 

Popular Content:
Identify the top-performing posts and PPV (Pay-Per-View) messages based on metrics such as purchases, views, and likes.
MOST POPULAR WALL POST: Engagement > Posts > Views
MOST SOLD PPV: Engagement > Messages > Purchase 
TOP FANS: Fans > Top Fans
STATEMENTS (FREE ONLY): Statements
STEP 5: Add Screenshots
Take screenshots directly from FansMetric for the following sections:
Follower counts (Paid and Free accounts).
Weekly Sales data.
Total Sales charts.
Popular posts and PPV messages (including engagement metrics).
Ensure screenshots are clear and relevant. Position them neatly within the report slides.
STEP 6: Verify and Save
Double-check the report for accuracy and completeness.
Ensure all updated dates, screenshots, and data match the weekly reporting period.
Save the file with a naming convention like:
Audit_Report_[DateRange]
STEP 7: Submit the Report
Save the updated report in the designated Google Drive folder.
Notify the team via project management tool (e.g., ClickUp and Slack).
BEST PRACTICES
Always use the previous report as a reference to maintain consistency in layout and data presentation.
Ensure data integrity by cross-checking all figures with FansMetric.
Submit the report no later than Monday 5 PM (PHT).

title: Story Post
description:
OVERVIEW
This SOP outlines the daily process for posting story content on both Free and VIP OnlyFans accounts. The purpose is to engage fans consistently, promote VIP subscriptions, and encourage tipping through teasers and upsells—while ensuring all activity is tracked and aligned with content guidelines.
TASK
To create and schedule 1 daily story post for both Free and VIP accounts, alternating once every few days with and without captions. Ensure posts align with strategy (Free posts directing fans to VIP, VIP posts teasing sexier upsell) and are tracked for reference and consistency.
PREREQUISITE
OnlyFans (Free and VIP accounts)
Google Sheets – OF Captions Tracker
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > OF Caption Tracker - Google Sheets
Slack – YUM Channel (for advising chatters)
Vault – Photo Previews Folder (for story content)
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Choose Content from Vault
Go to the Vault > Photo Previews folder
Select 1 image for Free and 1 for VIP story post
Ensure sexier or nude version of the content is indeed available in either quarterly or priced folder. 
 
STEP 2: Determine Caption Plan for the Day
Access OF Captions Tracker and log the stories daily in the 'OF Stories - MMM'26'
Create a new sheet for each month by duplicating the current month and replacing the contents
Follow the alternate rule:
Day 1: No Caption
Day 2: No Caption
Day 3: No Caption
Day 4: With Caption
(and so on)
 
STEP 3: Write Captions
For Free Story Post:
Caption must encourage fans to join VIP (e.g., “Want the uncensored version? Join my VIP @emjaybird 💋”)
For VIP Story Post:
Caption must encourage tipping to unlock the sexier version
Example: “Wanna see how this ends? Tip $15 and I’ll send you the uncut version 😘🔥”
 
STEP 4: Advise Chatters
Once VIP captions are finalized, notify chatters in the YUM Slack channel
Indicate what “sexier version” to send when a fan tips (e.g., name of content in vault or linked preview set)
 
STEP 5: Schedule the Story Posts
Log in to OnlyFans Free account and post the Free story for 8:00 AM PHT
Log in to OnlyFans VIP account and do the same
Upload the selected media and add caption (or leave blank per alternation schedule)
Vault > Add to > Add to your story

 
STEP 6: Final Check
Ensure both stories are scheduled correctly for 8:00 AM PHT
Confirm captions are accurate and properly logged
Make sure chatters are tagged in Slack with the upsell content info
Update the status in the tracker to 'Posted' after posting
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Follow the caption alternation rule strictly to maintain story engagement variety
Content can be reused for stories after at least 2 weeks 
Captions for Free must always point to VIP and feel teasing, not spammy
VIP captions should sound playful and enticing, encouraging interaction (e.g., tipping)
Notify chatters promptly if upsell content is changed or unavailable
Maintain consistency in posting time — always post for 8:00 AM PHT

title: SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure all chatter End-of-Day (EOD) reports are complete, clean, and properly tracked by recording reported SKUs into the monthly inventory sheet, identifying missing SKUs, and creating new SKUs when needed.
🛠 Tools Needed
SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
YUM Google Drive
FansMetrics (FM) Vault
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Review Chatter EOD Reports
Open the SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report and review all chatter submissions for the day.
Check that:
SKU entries are provided
Report format looks clean and complete
No obvious missing content references
2️⃣ Track Reported SKUs in the Month Tab
For every SKU submitted by the chatter:
Locate the correct Month tab
Add the SKU to the monthly tracking sheet
Ensure it is entered in the proper row/section
Once successfully tracked, highlight the cell so it is easy to identify which SKU has already been added.
3️⃣ If No SKU Is Provided
If the chatter submitted a sale or content entry without a SKU:
Report immediately to the Manager
Request a screenshot of the content from the chatter for verification
Do not leave the entry unresolved.
4️⃣ If SKU Is Not Found in the Monthly Tab
If the chatter provided a SKU but it cannot be found or verified in the Month tab:
Check the VIP Vault folder
Path: Emily’s OnlyFans → Google Drive → PPV Content
Verify whether the content already exists in the vault
5️⃣ If Content Exists 
Advise Manager and provide ss to communicate to chatter.
6️⃣ If Content Do not Exist
If the content do not exist in the vault: 
Go to FM > Vault and locate the content 
Take a screenshot of the content
Upload the screenshot to Google Drive
Create a new SKU for the content
Use the separate How to Create SKU process reference for the proper SKU creation steps.
 Finalize Tracking
Once the SKU is verified or newly created:
Add it to the Month tab
Highlight the added cell
Make sure the report is now complete and trackable
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated SKU Sales Inventory & Chatters EOD Report with:
All reported SKUs tracked in the Month tab
Highlighted cells for newly added SKUs
Missing SKU cases escalated
New SKUs created when applicable
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before closing the task, verify:
☑ Chatter EOD reports were reviewed
 ☑ SKU entries were tracked in the correct Month tab
 ☑ Newly tracked SKUs were highlighted
 ☑ Missing SKUs were reported to Manager
 ☑ VIP Vault was checked when SKU could not be found
 ☑ Screenshot was uploaded before creating a new SKU
 ☑ New SKU was created only if content existed and no SKU was assigned yet
🚨 Escalation Rules
Escalate immediately if:
Chatter submitted a sale with no SKU
Screenshot is still missing after request
Content cannot be found in vault or report
Duplicate or conflicting SKU is detected
Report submission is incomplete or unclear
📝 Notes
Always make sure tracking is updated on the same day to avoid missed inventory entries.
Highlighting newly added SKUs is required for easy monitoring.
Do not guess or invent a SKU without verifying the content first.
Follow the separate How to Create SKU guide when creating a new one.

title: Chatter MM Approval
description:
🔁 Recurring Frequency
Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure Mass Messages (MM) prepared by chatters follow approved captions, correct pricing, and content rotation rules before being sent to fans.
This prevents:
Incorrect pricing
Reused content too frequently
Low-performing captions
Unapproved messaging
🛠 Tools Needed
MM Tracker
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
FansMetrics (FM)
(Vault section)
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Check MM Tracker
Open the MM Tracker and locate entries with the status:
FOR APPROVAL
These are Mass Messages waiting for admin validation.
2️⃣ Validate Caption
Confirm the caption used is:
✔ From the Scripts tab, OR
 ✔ A recycled caption from previous MMs with high unlocks
Reject if:
Caption is misleading
Caption is duplicated from a recent MM
Caption is poorly written or incomplete
3️⃣ Validate Price
Check that the price follows approved pricing structure.
✔ If the content exists in the Priced Vault Folder, the price must match.
✔ Allowance:
 Price may vary ± $5
✔ If the content is not in the priced vault, verify price using the Model Info Sheet pricing guide. OnlyFans_Pricing_Guidelines_FIN…
Reject if:
Price is missing
Price is significantly different
Pricing does not follow the model's guidelines
4️⃣ Validate Content Usage
Open FansMetrics → Vault and verify the media.
✔ Confirm the content has NOT been used in any Mass Message within the last 2 weeks.
Reject if:
The content was used recently
The content is already scheduled in another MM
5️⃣ If Issues Are Found
If any validation fails:
Add explanation in the Notes column in MM Tracker.
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → NEEDS REVISION
Common note examples:
Caption not from scripts
Incorrect pricing
Content used recently
6️⃣ If Everything Is Correct
If all checks pass:
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → APPROVED
No additional comment required.
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated MM Tracker status:
APPROVED → Ready for scheduling
NEEDS REVISION → Returned to chatter with notes
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before approving:
☑ Caption follows approved scripts or high-performing captions
 ☑ Price follows vault pricing or pricing guide
 ☑ Price difference within $5 allowance
 ☑ Content not used in last 2 weeks
 ☑ Tracker status updated correctly
📝 Notes
Always prioritize content freshness to maintain fan engagement.
Avoid approving MMs with repeated captions or recycled content too frequently.
Use clear and short comments when requesting revisions.

title: Reporting (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
description:
Recurring: Daily
Deadline: 5PM 
🎯 Purpose
To ensure all End of Shift (EOS) Reports are completed accurately, consistently, and based on verified FansMetric data.
🗂 STEP 1: Access the EOS Folder
Go to Info Bookmark Folder
Click on: YUM
Open: 2026 | EOS
Select the dedicated EOS template for the correct date
⚠️ If the selected date has no tables yet:
Copy the previous day’s EOS table format
Paste it into the current day’s document
Make sure all dates are updated correctly
📊 STEP 2: Generate the Data (3PM PHT)
1️⃣ Access FansMetric Data
Go to:
FM → Chatting → Chat Analytics
2️⃣ Adjust Filters
Select correct Account (Free or VIP)
Select correct Date
❌ Remove:
Shift Time filter
Correct Chatter filter
(We now extract overall account data per shift based on date only.)
3️⃣ Extract & Rename Required Metrics
When pulling data from Chat Analytics, use the following naming standards in EOS:
RCD → All Earnings
RCH → Earnings Per Hour
PPV Con % → Unlock Ratio
Ensure all data reflects:
Total Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Messages Sent
Priced Messages
PPVs Sold
Other required KPI metrics
⚠️ No estimated values. Only use exact FansMetric numbers.
4️⃣ Extract Refund / Chargeback Data (Separate Process)
Refunds are NOT taken from Chat Analytics.
Go to:
FM → Chatting Client → VIP → Statistics → Adjust Date → Chargebacks
Adjust to correct date
Extract total chargebacks for that day
Record net refund impact in EOS
If applicable, note which shift it falls under
5️⃣ Cross-Check Slack & Internal Compliance
Before finalizing EOS, you MUST check:
🔎 YUM Slack:
Missed Shift reports (Report Channel)
Any announcements affecting the shift
📩 Direct Messages:
Check chatter’s DM to Divine
Check SFL (Save For Later)
⚠️ SOP Violations:
Confirm if any violation was reported during the shift
Add note in EOS if applicable
 
📊 STEP 3: Fill Out EOS Table 
1️⃣ Fill Out Required Data in the Table
Enter all extracted data from:
FM → Chatting → Chat Analytics
FM → Chatting Client → VIP → Statistics → Chargebacks
Include only the required metrics:
All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Chargebacks (if any)
⚠️ Removed:
Messages Sent
Priced Messages
PPVs Sold
Double-check totals before submission.
 No estimates. No manual manipulation.
2️⃣ Paste Supporting Screenshots
EOS must include proof of data:
📸 Screenshot of Chat Analytics
📸 Screenshot of Chargebacks (if applicable)
No EOS submission without screenshots.
3️⃣ Under “Other Sections / FYI”
You MUST include:
🔎 Slack Cross-Reference Confirmation
Confirm whether:
There were any SFL (Save For Later) operational items
Status of Ongoing Projects / Tasks
Fans Corner – Any issue raised by fans and reported by the chatter
Example structure:
Other Sections / FYI:
Ongoing Projects/Tasks Status: [Brief update]
Fans Corner:
[Fan Name] – Issue raised
[Fan Name] – Complaint / request / concern
[Fan Name] – Pending model confirmation
If none:
No SFL items, no ongoing escalations, no fan issues reported then just omit the section
 
 
PPV Summary & Overview 
Screenshot the ff: 
Messages > Statistics > MM > Adjust Date
MM Tracker for chatter  and captions references
 
Utilize ChatGPT in summarizing and proof read. 
 Prompt: 
 
You are helping me create a daily VIP PPV MM sales report based on FM screenshots + sheet screenshots.
Your job is to produce the report in the exact same format and logic every time.
Core Rules
Always validate first before creating the table.
Use FM screenshots as the source of truth for:
total messages
total revenue
views
purchases/unlocks
visible prices
Use the sheet screenshot only to identify the chatter by matching the caption.
Never guess the chatter, price, unlocks, or revenue.
If a row appears in FM but the chatter cannot be confirmed from the sheet, flag it instead of assuming.
Include only priced PPV rows with visible unlocks/purchases in the table.
Exclude:
Pic MM
free messages
rows with no visible purchases/unlocks
uncaptured or unverified rows
Keep the rows in the same order as shown in the FM screenshot.
Calculate:
Revenue = Price x Unlocks
Conv. Rate = Unlocks / Viewed x 100
If visible rows do not match the FM header total, mention that there is a difference / unreconciled amount and do not invent missing rows.
Output Format
Title:
# 📊 VIP PPV MM Overview Summary
Summary style:
paragraph form only
start with: For this day,
mention total Mass Messages and total revenue from FM header
mention overall trend if shown (increase/decrease %)
mention strongest performer(s)
mention best-performing price band / pricing insight
keep it concise and analytical
Table title:
# 📋 PPV Breakdown (with Unlocks Only)
Table columns:
| Chatter | Caption | Price | Viewed | Unlocks | Revenue | Conv. Rate |
Validation Process You Must Follow Before Writing
Read FM header total
List all visible FM priced rows with unlocks
Match each FM caption to the chatter using the sheet
Remove rows that cannot be verified
Compute revenue and conversion rate
Check whether visible subtotal matches FM header
Then create the final summary and table
Important Writing Rules
Keep captions full, never shorten them
Keep formatting clean
Do not add bullets below the summary unless asked
Do not add extra commentary unless there is a mismatch that needs flagging
If there is a mismatch, add one short note only
 
Past Due Custom Request
Check Model Info Sheet and screenshots any past due requests.
4️⃣ Intervention / Coaching Feedback
This section is mandatory daily.
Coaching Process:
Step 1: Go to ChatGPT
Step 2: Use the internal coaching prompt
"Here's the [date] data of the team and anyone who are below minimum, provide an analysis based on the data attached, what you think went wrong and recommendation also provide any action needed for the chatter to improve, but if they had not worked for atleast 8hours then no need to include. Wait until I provide sample chats for the day to complete your analysis, cross reference other metrics as well on the data and check if previous day's action required is applied/meet."
Step 3: Attach:
Chat Analytics screenshots
At least 5 pages of chatter’s sample chats
Location of chats:
Chat Analytics → Message Dashboard → Filter: Date (Today) → Select Specific Chatter
Step 4: Review ChatGPT’s recommendation
Proofread carefully
Check if recommendations make operational sense
Remove anything unrealistic or irrelevant
Ensure it aligns with KPI goals and SOP
Step 5: Paste the finalized coaching recommendations into EOS
Then send it directly to the chatter via YUM Slack.
Step 6: Repeat Steps 4–6 for the next chatter
Each chatter must receive:
Individualized feedback
Clear improvement points
Specific action items
Step 7: Schedule a message at 10PM via Slack  to Emily of the EOS link
 
📊 STEP 4: Fill Out Internal Chatter KPI Tracker
1️⃣ Update Internal KPI Tracker
After completing the EOS:
Go to:
Info Bookmarks → YUM Folder → YUM Chatter KPI Tracker
Update the required fields for the specific chatter.
⚠️ Ensure:
Data matches exactly what was submitted in EOS
No discrepancies between EOS and KPI Tracker
Correct chatter and correct date are selected
This tracker is used for:
Weekly KPI assessment
Bonus qualification
Performance evaluation
Promotion / probation review
Accuracy is mandatory.
2️⃣ Notify Manager for Review
Once:
EOS is completed
Screenshots attached
Coaching feedback sent
KPI Tracker updated
You must:
👉 Inform the assigned Manager that the report is ready for review.
This should ideally be done before 8:00 PM.
Example Slack message:
EOS completed and KPI tracker updated. Ready for review.

🚨 Final Reminder
EOS process is not complete until:
✔ EOS submitted
 ✔ Coaching sent to all chatters
 ✔ KPI Tracker updated
 ✔ Manager notified
 ✔ Completed before 8PM


📊 Weekly YUM Report SOP
This report provides a weekly overview of chatter performance, trends, risks, and operational updates.
1️⃣ Weekly Chatters Data
Source:
FansMetric → Chatting → Chat Analytics
Adjust filters to weekly date range and collect:
All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Chargebacks (if any)
Populate the Weekly Chatters Data table for each chatter.
2️⃣ Overall Performance Snapshot
PPV Conversion Trend – Summary & Analysis
Provide a short analysis of the Unlock Ratio trend for the week and note any significant changes or causes.
Chatter Performance Status
Categorize chatters based on their Weekly Revenue:
🟢 Green – Meeting KPI
🟡 Yellow – Slightly below KPI
🔴 Red – Not meeting KPI
Add short notes for Yellow/Red.
Risks / Projected Shortfalls (Bottom 3)
Identify the bottom 3 performers, summarize issues, and mention potential risks and intervention provided. 
3️⃣ Other Notes / FYI
Audit Report
Just provide the link of the audit report.
Past Due Report
List pending customs or unresolved fan requests.
Issues / Proposals
Include operational issues, improvement suggestions, or strategy proposals.
✔ Ensure data is verified before submission.
 ✔ Weekly report should clearly highlight performance trends, risks, and operational updates.

description:

Daily
🎯 Objective
Ensure Mass Messages (MM) prepared by chatters follow approved captions, correct pricing, and content rotation rules before being sent to fans.

Incorrect pricing
Reused content too frequently
Low-performing captions
Unapproved messaging

MM Tracker
(Info → Bookmarks → YUM)
FansMetrics (FM)
(Vault section)
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Check MM Tracker
Open the MM Tracker and locate entries with the status:
FOR APPROVAL
These are Mass Messages waiting for admin validation.
2️⃣ Validate Caption
Confirm the caption used is:
✔ From the Scripts tab, OR
 ✔ A recycled caption from previous MMs with high unlocks
Reject if:
Caption is misleading
Caption is duplicated from a recent MM
Caption is poorly written or incomplete
3️⃣ Validate Price
Check that the price follows approved pricing structure.
✔ If the content exists in the Priced Vault Folder, the price must match.
✔ Allowance:
 Price may vary ± $5
✔ If the content is not in the priced vault, verify price using the Model Info Sheet pricing guide. OnlyFans_Pricing_Guidelines_FIN…
Reject if:
Price is missing
Price is significantly different
Pricing does not follow the model's guidelines
4️⃣ Validate Content Usage
Open FansMetrics → Vault and verify the media.
✔ Confirm the content has NOT been used in any Mass Message within the last 2 weeks.
Reject if:
The content was used recently
The content is already scheduled in another MM
5️⃣ If Issues Are Found
If any validation fails:
Add explanation in the Notes column in MM Tracker.
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → NEEDS REVISION
Common note examples:
Caption not from scripts
Incorrect pricing
Content used recently
6️⃣ If Everything Is Correct
If all checks pass:
Change status from:
FOR APPROVAL → APPROVED
No additional comment required.
📊 Output / Deliverable
Updated MM Tracker status:
APPROVED → Ready for scheduling
NEEDS REVISION → Returned to chatter with notes
⚠️ Validation Checklist
Before approving:
☑ Caption follows approved scripts or high-performing captions
 ☑ Price follows vault pricing or pricing guide
 ☑ Price difference within $5 allowance
 ☑ Content not used in last 2 weeks
 ☑ Tracker status updated correctly
📝 Notes
Always prioritize content freshness to maintain fan engagement.
Avoid approving MMs with repeated captions or recycled content too frequently.
Use clear and short comments when requesting revisions.

title: Timesheet & Resub/Transfer
description:
TIMESHEEET OVERVIEW
This SOP outlines the weekly process of validating individual chatter timesheets, cross-referencing them with Slack reports, and consolidating verified work hours into the master YUM Hours sheet. This ensures accurate and timely payroll tracking for Emily’s OnlyFans team.
TASK
Verify and update each chatter’s weekly working hours and meeting attendance by cross-checking individual logs with Slack activity and compiling results in the YUM Hours sheet. Final submission is due every Thursday by 7:00 AM PST.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Individual Chatter Timesheets 
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Chatters - Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Hours Master Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Slack – For verifying login/logout times
Fathom / Meeting Notes – For verifying meeting attendance
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Access Chatter Timesheets
Open each chatter’s individual Google Sheet
Review login/out times, shift durations, and coverage notes (if any)
 
STEP 2: Cross-Reference with Slack Logs (Reports Channel) 
Use Slack reports (via Dali’s view or direct access)
Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PST)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PST
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PST
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
 
 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"
If any of the above criteria is missed, mark as Invalid. 

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 4: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

title: Reporting (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
description:
Recurring: Daily
Deadline: 5PM 
🎯 Purpose
To ensure all End of Shift (EOS) Reports are completed accurately, consistently, and based on verified FansMetric data.
🗂 STEP 1: Access the EOS Folder
Go to Info Bookmark Folder
Click on: YUM
Open: 2026 | EOS
Select the dedicated EOS template for the correct date
⚠️ If the selected date has no tables yet:
Copy the previous day’s EOS table format
Paste it into the current day’s document
Make sure all dates are updated correctly
📊 STEP 2: Generate the Data (3PM PHT)
1️⃣ Access FansMetric Data
Go to:
FM → Chatting → Chat Analytics
2️⃣ Adjust Filters
Select correct Account (Free or VIP)
Select correct Date
❌ Remove:
Shift Time filter
Correct Chatter filter
(We now extract overall account data per shift based on date only.)
3️⃣ Extract & Rename Required Metrics
When pulling data from Chat Analytics, use the following naming standards in EOS:
RCD → All Earnings
RCH → Earnings Per Hour
PPV Con % → Unlock Ratio
Ensure all data reflects:
Total Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Messages Sent
Priced Messages
PPVs Sold
Other required KPI metrics
⚠️ No estimated values. Only use exact FansMetric numbers.
4️⃣ Extract Refund / Chargeback Data (Separate Process)
Refunds are NOT taken from Chat Analytics.
Go to:
FM → Chatting Client → VIP → Statistics → Adjust Date → Chargebacks
Adjust to correct date
Extract total chargebacks for that day
Record net refund impact in EOS
If applicable, note which shift it falls under
5️⃣ Cross-Check Slack & Internal Compliance
Before finalizing EOS, you MUST check:
🔎 YUM Slack:
Missed Shift reports (Report Channel)
Any announcements affecting the shift
📩 Direct Messages:
Check chatter’s DM to Divine
Check SFL (Save For Later)
⚠️ SOP Violations:
Confirm if any violation was reported during the shift
Add note in EOS if applicable
 
📊 STEP 3: Fill Out EOS Table 
1️⃣ Fill Out Required Data in the Table
Enter all extracted data from:
FM → Chatting → Chat Analytics
FM → Chatting Client → VIP → Statistics → Chargebacks
Include only the required metrics:
All Earnings
Earnings Per Hour
Unlock Ratio
Chargebacks (if any)
⚠️ Removed:
Messages Sent
Priced Messages
PPVs Sold
Double-check totals before submission.
 No estimates. No manual manipulation.
2️⃣ Paste Supporting Screenshots
EOS must include proof of data:
📸 Screenshot of Chat Analytics
📸 Screenshot of Chargebacks (if applicable)
No EOS submission without screenshots.
3️⃣ Under “Other Sections / FYI”
You MUST include:
🔎 Slack Cross-Reference Confirmation
Confirm whether:
There were any SFL (Save For Later) operational items
Status of Ongoing Projects / Tasks
Fans Corner – Any issue raised by fans and reported by the chatter
Example structure:
Other Sections / FYI:
Ongoing Projects/Tasks Status: [Brief update]
Fans Corner:
[Fan Name] – Issue raised
[Fan Name] – Complaint / request / concern
[Fan Name] – Pending model confirmation
If none:
No SFL items, no ongoing escalations, no fan issues reported then just omit the section
 
 
PPV Summary & Overview 
Screenshot the ff: 
Messages > Statistics > MM > Adjust Date
MM Tracker for chatter  and captions references
 
Utilize ChatGPT in summarizing and proof read. 
 Prompt: 
 
You are helping me create a daily VIP PPV MM sales report based on FM screenshots + sheet screenshots.
Your job is to produce the report in the exact same format and logic every time.
Core Rules
Always validate first before creating the table.
Use FM screenshots as the source of truth for:
total messages
total revenue
views
purchases/unlocks
visible prices
Use the sheet screenshot only to identify the chatter by matching the caption.
Never guess the chatter, price, unlocks, or revenue.
If a row appears in FM but the chatter cannot be confirmed from the sheet, flag it instead of assuming.
Include only priced PPV rows with visible unlocks/purchases in the table.
Exclude:
Pic MM
free messages
rows with no visible purchases/unlocks
uncaptured or unverified rows
Keep the rows in the same order as shown in the FM screenshot.
Calculate:
Revenue = Price x Unlocks
Conv. Rate = Unlocks / Viewed x 100
If visible rows do not match the FM header total, mention that there is a difference / unreconciled amount and do not invent missing rows.
Output Format
Title:
# 📊 VIP PPV MM Overview Summary
Summary style:
paragraph form only
start with: For this day,
mention total Mass Messages and total revenue from FM header
mention overall trend if shown (increase/decrease %)
mention strongest performer(s)
mention best-performing price band / pricing insight
keep it concise and analytical
Table title:
# 📋 PPV Breakdown (with Unlocks Only)
Table columns:
| Chatter | Caption | Price | Viewed | Unlocks | Revenue | Conv. Rate |
Validation Process You Must Follow Before Writing
Read FM header total
List all visible FM priced rows with unlocks
Match each FM caption to the chatter using the sheet
Remove rows that cannot be verified
Compute revenue and conversion rate
Check whether visible subtotal matches FM header
Then create the final summary and table
Important Writing Rules
Keep captions full, never shorten them
Keep formatting clean
Do not add bullets below the summary unless asked
Do not add extra commentary unless there is a mismatch that needs flagging
If there is a mismatch, add one short note only
 
Past Due Custom Request
Check Model Info Sheet and screenshots any past due requests.
4️⃣ Intervention / Coaching Feedback
This section is mandatory daily.
Coaching Process:
Step 1: Go to ChatGPT
Step 2: Use the internal coaching prompt
"Here's the [date] data of the team and anyone who are below minimum, provide an analysis based on the data attached, what you think went wrong and recommendation also provide any action needed for the chatter to improve, but if they had not worked for atleast 8hours then no need to include. Wait until I provide sample chats for the day to complete your analysis, cross reference other metrics as well on the data and check if previous day's action required is applied/meet."
Step 3: Attach:
Chat Analytics screenshots
At least 5 pages of chatter’s sample chats
Location of chats:
Chat Analytics → Message Dashboard → Filter: Date (Today) → Select Specific Chatter
Step 4: Review ChatGPT’s recommendation
Proofread carefully
Check if recommendations make operational sense
Remove anything unrealistic or irrelevant
Ensure it aligns with KPI goals and SOP
Step 5: Paste the finalized coaching recommendations into EOS
Then send it directly to the chatter via YUM Slack.
Step 6: Repeat Steps 4–6 for the next chatter
Each chatter must receive:
Individualized feedback
Clear improvement points
Specific action items
Step 7: Schedule a message at 10PM via Slack  to Emily of the EOS link
 
📊 STEP 4: Fill Out Internal Chatter KPI Tracker
1️⃣ Update Internal KPI Tracker
After completing the EOS:
Go to:
Info Bookmarks → YUM Folder → YUM Chatter KPI Tracker
Update the required fields for the specific chatter.
⚠️ Ensure:
Data matches exactly what was submitted in EOS
No discrepancies between EOS and KPI Tracker
Correct chatter and correct date are selected
This tracker is used for:
Weekly KPI assessment
Bonus qualification
Performance evaluation
Promotion / probation review
Accuracy is mandatory.
2️⃣ Notify Manager for Review
Once:
EOS is completed
Screenshots attached
Coaching feedback sent
KPI Tracker updated
You must:
👉 Inform the assigned Manager that the report is ready for review.
This should ideally be done before 8:00 PM.
Example Slack message:
EOS completed and KPI tracker updated. Ready for review.
🚨 Final Reminder
EOS process is not complete until:
✔ EOS submitted
 ✔ Coaching sent to all chatters
 ✔ KPI Tracker updated
 ✔ Manager notified
 ✔ Completed before 8PM

title: Wall Post & Content Drops Scheduling
description:
TASK
Prepare and schedule one week’s worth of OF wallposts and PPV/Content drops across Free and VIP accounts, ensuring captions are contextual, scheduled content is tracked, and performance is monitored via Fansmetric.
PREREQUISITE
Google Drive – Source of all content assets (Free, VIP, PPV)
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Emily's OF - Google Drive

OF Caption Tracker (Google Sheets) – For planning post schedule, captions, links, drop info
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > OF Caption Tracker - Google Sheets
Fansmetric – Platform used to schedule and monitor posts
ChatGPT (YUM GPT Workspace) – Optional for drafting captions
Slack / Internal Comms – To notify Divine/Marj and coordinate approvals
OnlyFans Banned Words List – For reference when writing captions 
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: PREPARATION
1.1. Access Google Drive
Navigate to Emily’s folder inside “Young Production > Emily’s OnlyFans”.
Open subfolders: Wallpost (Free), Wallpost Paid (VIP), and PPV.
1.2. Check for New Content
Confirm if there’s enough content for:
7 Free posts
14 VIP posts
2–3 PPV drops
If insufficient, notify Divine/Marj to coordinate with the client. 
STEP 2: FILL OUT THE CAPTION TRACKER
 2.1. Open the OF Caption Tracker via the Young Production bookmarks.
 2.2. Under the appropriate weekly tab, input:
Date and Time
Category (e.g. Promotion, Drop, Release, Live Announcement)
Account (Free or VIP)
Caption (freestyle or using GPT with human touch)
Note: Captions must have the following: 
Embody Model's personality: bubbly, playful and flirt/sexy 
Anticipation/Hype/Build Up: Wall post = Countdown for Content drop 
 - Write anticipation captions (e.g., “drops in 24 hrs”)days before
 - Post release captions (e.g., “now live”) on drop day
Call To Action (CTA) e.g., "Comment you answer", "DM me", of in FREE account "Go to @emjaybird  or VIP account"
Utilize emojis to look friendly and personalized
Asset Link (Drive link to content)
Drop Schedule no need for captions for PPV/Content drop
STEP 3: GET APPROVAL
 3.1. Notify Divine/Marj once the tracker is complete.
3.2. Wait for her review and approval before scheduling.
STEP 4: SCHEDULING IN FANSMETRIC
 4.1. After access is granted, go to Fansmetric > Queue > Add Post

 4.2. Upload the asset, paste the caption, and choose publish time.
Be mindful that FM time is based on your computer time and post must be scheduled in EST (adjust if needed).
4.3. Mark the status in the tracker as:
Scheduled (after posting in Fansmetric)
Published (after confirming it went live properly)
4.4. Move the content to Used (Wall Post) folder in Google Drive
STEP 5: PPV/CONTENT DROP PLANNING
 5.1. Plan PPV drops once a week:
 - Alternate between videos and photo sets
 - Rename files with drop date for clarity
 - Coordinate drop summary with Divine for vault upload
STEP 6: PERFORMANCE CHECK (Optional for Now)
 6.1. Use Fansmetric > Statistics > Posts to:
 - Identify best post times
 - Review top-performing captions for style inspiration
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Avoid robotic captions — always match caption tone with the content vibe
Strictly avoid banned words per OnlyFans policy (e.g., "young", "teen", "child")
Free account: Used for soft teasing, directing fans to VIP
VIP account: Full access + PPV drops
PPV drops require extra payment, even for VIP subscribers
Coordinate with Marj if you encounter scheduling issues or file discrepancies
Live Show Promotion: Only promote the Thursday VIP live via the Free account to drive conversion

title: Audit Report
description:
OBJECTIVE
To accurately generate weekly audit reports for OnlyFans accounts, ensuring all data is updated, and necessary details and screenshots are included.
PREREQUISITES
Access Requirements:
FansMetric (FM) account login credentials.
Access to info@divineorigines.com.
Access to the Reports folder in Google Drive: Google Drive Reports Folder.
Timing:
Run the report after 12:00 AM (Monday, EST).
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Log in to FansMetric (FM)
Open the FansMetric platform.
Use the credentials for divine.origines@gmail.com to log in.
STEP 2: Access the Latest Report
Open the Google Drive Reports Folder.
Locate the most recent report file.
Make a copy of the file to avoid overwriting the original.
STEP 3: Update Dates
Open the copied report in Google Slides.
Update the date range in the report title and on the first page. Use the reporting period of the past week (Monday to Sunday).
STEP 4: Populate Key Data
Total Followers:
Extract the Paid Account and Free Account follower count data from FansMetric.
Include the weekly change (e.g., +218 or -202).
Follow the same steps for both accounts.

Weekly Sales (Paid and Free Accounts):
Navigate to the Sales Metrics section in FansMetric.

Scroll down and include Chatter Performance Report screenshots. 
Total Sales:
Add Net Sales and Gross Sales data.
Match the font color if there's a decrease or increase from last week's sales. 

Popular Content:
Identify the top-performing posts and PPV (Pay-Per-View) messages based on metrics such as purchases, views, and likes.
MOST POPULAR WALL POST: Engagement > Posts > Views
MOST SOLD PPV: Engagement > Messages > Purchase 
TOP FANS: Fans > Top Fans
STATEMENTS (FREE ONLY): Statements
STEP 5: Add Screenshots
Take screenshots directly from FansMetric for the following sections:
Follower counts (Paid and Free accounts).
Weekly Sales data.
Total Sales charts.
Popular posts and PPV messages (including engagement metrics).
Ensure screenshots are clear and relevant. Position them neatly within the report slides.
STEP 6: Verify and Save
Double-check the report for accuracy and completeness.
Ensure all updated dates, screenshots, and data match the weekly reporting period.
Save the file with a naming convention like:
Audit_Report_[DateRange]
STEP 7: Submit the Report
Save the updated report in the designated Google Drive folder.
Notify the team via project management tool (e.g., ClickUp and Slack).
BEST PRACTICES
Always use the previous report as a reference to maintain consistency in layout and data presentation.
Ensure data integrity by cross-checking all figures with FansMetric.
Submit the report no later than Monday 5 PM (PHT).

This SOP outlines the weekly process of validating individual chatter timesheets, cross-referencing them with Slack reports, and consolidating verified work hours into the master YUM Hours sheet. This ensures accurate and timely payroll tracking for Emily’s OnlyFans team.
TASK
Verify and update each chatter’s weekly working hours and meeting attendance by cross-checking individual logs with Slack activity and compiling results in the YUM Hours sheet. Final submission is due every Thursday by 7:00 AM PST.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Individual Chatter Timesheets 
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Chatters - Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Hours Master Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Yum Hours - Google Sheets
YUM Slack – For verifying login/logout times
Fathom / Meeting Notes – For verifying meeting attendance
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Access Chatter Timesheets
Open each chatter’s individual Google Sheet
Review login/out times, shift durations, and coverage notes (if any)
 
STEP 2: Cross-Reference with Slack Logs (Reports Channel) 
Use Slack reports (via Dali’s view or direct access)
Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PST)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PST
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PST
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
 
 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)

INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"
If any of the above criteria is missed, mark as Invalid. 

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 4: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

title: Project Management | Slack Comms
description:
Project Management | Slack Comms SOP
Recurring Frequency
 Daily
Deadline
 Ongoing throughout the shift, with priority checks before critical deadlines
🎯 Purpose
To ensure all active YUM tasks, deadlines, and team communications are properly monitored so no urgent deliverables, updates, or operational issues are missed. This task focuses on project oversight, Slack follow-ups, time-sensitive task monitoring, and stepping in early if a deadline is at risk. 
🛠 Tools Needed
 ClickUp 
 Slack 
 Save for Later (SFL) 
 Task threads and comments 
 Daily operations task list 
📋 Procedure
1️⃣ Review all active YUM tasks in ClickUp
Open the assigned YUM workspace and review all active operational tasks for the day.
Check:
 task status 
 assignee 
 due time 
 comments or updates 
 whether the task is already in progress, pending, or at risk of being missed 
The goal of project management is to make sure no assigned task is missed and that all time-sensitive items are being monitored properly. 
2️⃣ Check Slack for updates, issues, and follow-ups
Open Slack and review all relevant channels, threads, and direct messages related to YUM operations.
Pay close attention to:
 urgent requests 
 deadline changes 
 missing deliverables 
 operational clarifications 
 chatter concerns 
 manager instructions 
 anything saved for later that may require action 
This task includes communication monitoring, so Slack must be checked consistently throughout the shift, not just once. 
3️⃣ Review Save for Later (SFL) items
Check all items saved in Save for Later and determine whether any require action, follow-up, escalation, or review.
SFL may contain:
 reported issues 
 incomplete tasks 
 screenshots needing review 
 chatter concerns 
 pending manager follow-ups 
 time-sensitive reminders 
If there are unresolved SFL items, make sure they are either completed, escalated, or reassigned before the shift ends. 
4️⃣ Monitor time-sensitive tasks before cutoff times
Check all tasks that must be completed within the day and review them before the deadline window, not at the exact due time.
For example, if a task needs to be completed by 5:00 PM, check its progress earlier, around 5:45 PM to 5:50 PM equivalent check window before final cutoff, so there is still time to step in if needed. The objective is to catch delays before they become missed deadlines. 
If the assigned person is behind or unable to complete the task on time, step in early or escalate immediately.
5️⃣ Check task threads for latest updates
Open each important task thread and confirm whether the information is still current.
Review:
 latest comments 
 status updates 
 manager instructions 
 attached screenshots or files 
 whether there are unresolved questions 
 whether action has already been taken 
Project management includes making sure task threads are up to date and not silently stalled. 
6️⃣ Identify blocked or at-risk tasks
Flag any task that appears delayed, incomplete, unclear, or dependent on missing information.
A task is considered at risk if:
 it has no update close to deadline 
 it still needs review or approval 
 the assignee has not responded 
 Slack or task comments show confusion 
 supporting screenshots or files are still missing 
 the task cannot be completed without manager input 
Once identified, either:
 follow up in Slack 
 comment in the task 
 step in directly if allowed 
 escalate to the appropriate manager 
7️⃣ Follow up through Slack when needed
If an update is missing, follow up with the responsible person through Slack.
Use Slack to:
 ask for a status update 
 remind them of a deadline 
 confirm if support is needed 
 clarify blockers 
 request proof of completion 
 inform a manager that a task may need escalation 
This keeps communication fast and prevents missed deliverables due to lack of follow-up.
8️⃣ Step in if a task is close to being missed
If a task is approaching deadline and the assigned person is unable to complete it, step in where possible to prevent a miss.
This may include:
 completing the task directly 
 helping gather missing information 
 checking related threads or files 
 preparing the next step so the assignee can finish faster 
 notifying the manager that intervention was needed 
Project management is not only monitoring. It also includes stepping in to prevent operational gaps when necessary. 
9️⃣ Keep task ownership and responsibility clear
If project management coverage is already built into the task assignment, maintain clarity on who is responsible for execution versus oversight.
When reviewing the task, ensure:
 the main executor is clear 
 the project management role is clear 
 follow-ups are documented 
 no duplicate work is being done unnecessarily 
If needed, update the task description or task structure so oversight responsibilities are easier to understand. 
🔟 Leave clear task comments when necessary
If you check a task and identify an issue, leave a clear comment in ClickUp or Slack.
Good update comments should include:
 what was checked 
 current status 
 what is missing 
 who needs to act 
 by when it should be resolved 
This makes handoffs and manager review easier.
1️⃣1️⃣ Confirm completed tasks are actually complete
Do not assume a task is done just because it looks complete.
Before considering it resolved, verify:
 final output has been submitted 
 screenshots or proof are attached if needed 
 the task matches the actual requirement 
 there are no unresolved Slack follow-ups 
 no one is waiting on an answer or clarification 
1️⃣2️⃣ End the shift with a final Slack and task sweep
Before ending the shift, do one final review of:
 outstanding Slack messages 
 unresolved SFL items 
 tasks still marked in progress 
 deadlines still open 
 anything needing manager awareness 
This final sweep ensures no urgent issue is left hanging overnight.
⚠️ Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
1. This is an oversight task, not just a checklist task
Project Management | Slack Comms is meant to ensure no important task or communication is missed. The role is to monitor, follow up, and intervene early when needed. 
2. Always check before the actual deadline
Do not wait until the exact deadline to review task progress. Check early enough to still have time to step in. 
3. SFL is part of daily monitoring
Save for Later should be treated as part of operational follow-up, not optional review. Important issues may sit there if not checked. 
4. Escalate early if something looks blocked
If a task is clearly at risk, do not wait too long hoping it resolves on its own. Follow up or escalate early.
5. Document follow-ups clearly
Whenever you intervene, leave a clear comment or message so others can understand what was checked and what still needs action.
6. Prevent missed tasks, do not just report them
The purpose of this SOP is to avoid misses before they happen, not only to document them afterward.

TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.

Google Sheets

Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)

INSTRUCTIONS

Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).
The fan's name was updated and matched in VIP. 
The fan has been "Already in PAID/VIP"

a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST

d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.

Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.

Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

Confirm captions are accurate and properly logged

PPVMM for VIP Account - Daily at 5AM PHT, priced between $40-$55, Sent to: Fans, Excluded: Muted, Tagged, Exclude from PPVMM, Whales
MM for Free Account - Twice a week for current VIP promos (benefits) and discount link
 
PREREQUISITE
FansMetric (FM) – For scheduling, accessing the vault, and analytics
PPVMM Tracker (ClickUp Docs) – To log captions, dates, prices, purchase counts (in EST)

1.1. Log in to FansMetric (FM) and go to the Vault.
1.2. Browse folders priced $5–$100, but select content for PPVMMs within the $15–$35 price range.
Prioritize older content first.
For videos, pair with a preview photo if the clip is short.
For photosets, group related images (e.g. 3–4 pics as a bundle).
1.3. Use ChatGPT or former captions n the PPVMM Tracker for reference.
Captions should be seductive, enticing, and not robotic.
Focus on teasing, sensory cues, emotional pull and make it all about the fan.
Highlight power/tease words and ensure to have CTA phrases. 
 
STEP 2: UPDATE TRACKER IN CLICKUP

Add Date & Time (in EST)
Paste Caption
Include Price ($40-$55)

Leave a space for # of Purchases (to update daily)

Send to Fans, then exclude:
Muted
Tagged
Whales
Exclude from PPVMM

Use heatmap from FM analytics (PH timezone) to pick peak hour

Pricing Strategy:

$25–$35 for premium videos or larger photo bundles

Content Preview Rules: Avoid showing full nudity in preview images
Drops ≠ PPVMMs:
Drops are announced on the wall and redeemed via DM
PPVMMs are direct, unlockable messages sent to the fan inbox
Do not open chat messages in FM — this risks exposing sensitive data

Approval Required: All scheduled PPVMMs must be reviewed before publishing

Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PST)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PST
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PST
 
IMPORTANT NOTES

Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
 
 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 4: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

title: Vault Maintenance
description:
Vault Maintenance SOP
Recurring Frequency
 Weekly or as needed when new content is uploaded
Deadline
 No fixed deadline unless assigned as part of a time-sensitive content update
🎯 Overview
This task ensures the OF vault is properly maintained so all content is organized, searchable, correctly priced, and placed in the right folders. Vault maintenance includes sorting new content, updating old content, checking price folders, applying descriptive categories, and cleaning up unnecessary or duplicate folders. New content uploaded into OF first lands in All Media and must then be sorted into the correct folder system. 
When there is no new content, vault maintenance still continues as a review and cleanup process by checking whether all existing content has the correct pricing, descriptive categories, and quarterly folder placement. 
✅ Task
Maintain Emily’s OF vault by:
 sorting newly uploaded content into the proper folders 
 assigning the correct price folder 
 applying descriptive category tags 
 moving content based on age 
 checking old content for missing or incorrect folder placement 
 cleaning up unnecessary or duplicate folders to keep the vault organized   
🛠 Tools Required
 OnlyFans Vault 
 All Media section in OF 
 Model Info Sheet 
 ClickUp 
 Slack vault maintenance thread 
 Google Drive, if new content is first stored there before being uploaded to OF  
📋 Step-by-Step Process
1️⃣ Open the Vault and Check All Media
Go to Emily’s OF Vault and open All Media.
All newly uploaded or newly dropped content appears in All Media first. This is the starting point for vault maintenance. Any new content found here must be sorted into the proper folders. 
2️⃣ Sort New Content Into the Correct Folder Set
If the content is newly uploaded for the week, it must be added to all applicable folders:
New Content
 the correct Quarterly Folder
 the correct descriptive category folder
Use the circle selector on the media item, then click the folder icon to assign the content to the proper categories. New weekly content should always be placed in all required folders, not left only in All Media. 
3️⃣ Create the Correct Quarterly Folder if Missing
Check whether the correct quarterly folder already exists.
If a new quarter has started and the folder does not yet exist, create a new quarterly folder using the proper naming structure. Example: if the current quarter is April to June 2026, create the corresponding quarterly folder before sorting content into it. 
4️⃣ Apply the Correct Price Folder
After sorting the content into New Content and the correct Quarterly Folder, assign the proper price folder.
Current process requires that even newly uploaded content must already be assigned to a price folder. Pricing must not be guessed. Always cross-check against the Model Info Sheet first before applying the correct vault price. 
5️⃣ Check the Model Info Sheet for Original Pricing
Open the Model Info Sheet and identify:
 content type 
 content duration, if video 
 applicable base/original price 
Use the Model Info Sheet as the source of truth for original pricing. Vault pricing is then applied based on the current pricing rule, content type, and age of the content. 
6️⃣ Price Videos Based on Type, Duration, and Age
For videos, determine:
 the content type 
 the content duration 
 the original price from the Model Info Sheet 
Vault pricing is based on the generic lowest applicable tier. If the content is already 6 months old, apply the 6–6 rule and reduce the original price by 50%. Example: if the original low-tier price is $50, the updated vault price becomes $25 once the content is 6 months old. 
For older video content, the price shown in the vault should reflect the updated discounted folder, not the original full price. 
7️⃣ Price Photos Using the Standard Folder Guide
For older photo content, use the following standard folder guide:
 boob only or butt only = $5
 boob and butt visible = $10
 pussy visible only = $10
 full nude with pussy visible = $15
Also assess image quality:
 If the content is very old or pixelated, lower the price when appropriate. 
 If the content quality is especially strong, the folder price may be justified at a higher tier within the existing rule set.  
8️⃣ Apply Descriptive Category Tags
Add the content to the proper descriptive category folders based on what appears in the content.
A single piece of content may have multiple descriptive tags if applicable. For example, if a video includes more than one content element, it may be tagged in more than one descriptive category. However, it must only have one final price folder and remain properly sorted by date. 
9️⃣ Move Content Based on Age
Content must be moved through the temporary folders based on age:
Week 1: place in New Content
After 1 week: move to Last Week New Content
After 2 weeks: remove from Last Week New Content
 after that, keep it in its proper Quarterly Folder only  
This keeps the “new” folders accurate and prevents old content from staying in short-term folders too long.
🔟 Maintain the Vault Even When There Is No New Content
If there is no new content uploaded, continue vault maintenance by auditing older content.
Check that all existing content has:
 a price folder 
 descriptive category tags 
 correct quarterly placement  
This applies especially to older videos, since videos usually require closer review to confirm category and pricing. 
1️⃣1️⃣ Clean Up Unnecessary or Incorrect Categories
Part of vault maintenance is cleanup.
If a category is unnecessary, one-off, duplicated, or no longer useful:
 rename it if needed 
 move content into the proper permanent folder 
 delete the extra category if no longer needed 
This prevents the vault from becoming too cluttered and makes it easier for chatters to find content. 
1️⃣2️⃣ Update Internal Notes or Task Records if Needed
If there are major changes made during vault maintenance, update the relevant SOP, ClickUp task, or internal tracking notes as needed so the folder logic and pricing rules remain clear for the team. 
⚠️ Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
1. Never guess pricing
Always use the Model Info Sheet first, especially for videos. Pricing must be based on the documented pricing structure, then adjusted according to current vault rules. 
2. Use the generic lowest pricing tier for vault pricing
Vault pricing should be based on the lowest applicable tier for the generic vault system. Do not apply different vault prices based on individual fan spender tiers. 
3. Multiple descriptive tags are allowed, but only one price folder
A content item can belong to multiple descriptive folders, but it must not be assigned to multiple price folders. 
4. Videos require more review than photos
Videos may need to be watched or reviewed more carefully to determine correct duration, category, and pricing. 
5. Quality affects photo pricing
For photos, use the standard folder rules, but consider whether the content is old, pixelated, or especially high quality before finalizing the folder price. 
6. Vault maintenance still applies even without new content
If no new content has been uploaded, the task becomes a maintenance audit of existing content rather than a new-content sorting task. 
7. Keep the vault clean and easy to use
Too many unnecessary folders make content harder to manage and sell. Regular cleanup is part of the task.

Match timesheet entries with actual timestamps
Adjust for:
Early outs
Missed shifts
No logout reports
 
STEP 3: Check for Shift Coverage
If a chatter covered another shift, ensure it’s reflected both in their sheet and in Slack
Log any missing notes accordingly
 
STEP 4: Follow the Weekly Cut-Off
Work week is Thursday to Wednesday (PST)
Complete validation by Wednesday night PST
 
STEP 5: Update the YUM Hours Sheet
Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift
 
STEP 6: Double Check Everything
Ensure hours match verified Slack logs
Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly
 
STEP 7: Submit by Deadline
Finalize the YUM Hours sheet by Thursday, 7:00 AM PST
 
IMPORTANT NOTES
Slack is the main source of truth — always verify against it
Some sheets may show default entries (e.g., 84 hrs); don’t rely on these
Only add the meeting +1 hour if confirmed via Fathom or meeting log
Double check chatters with perfect sheets (e.g., Jay, Ian) for consistency
Keep coverage shifts updated in the shared schedule
Expect high standards from Irwin (OM) and audits if errors occur
Do not share access to the YUM Hours sheet with chatters
 
 
TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.
TASK
To review and validate each conversion or resubmission logged by chatters, ensuring accuracy and legitimacy before confirming bonus eligibility.
PREREQUISITE
Google Sheets
Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)
FansMetric (FM) – For verifying chatter conversations and fan movement
INSTRUCTIONS
STEP 1: Open the Transfer/Resub Logging Sheet
Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 4: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

PPVMM for VIP Account - Daily at 5AM PHT, priced between $40-$55, Sent to: Fans, Excluded: Muted, Tagged, Exclude from PPVMM, Whales

For videos, pair with a preview photo if the clip is short.
For photosets, group related images (e.g. 3–4 pics as a bundle).
1.3. Use ChatGPT or former captions n the PPVMM Tracker for reference.
Captions should be seductive, enticing, and not robotic.
Focus on teasing, sensory cues, emotional pull and make it all about the fan.
Highlight power/tease words and ensure to have CTA phrases.

Paste Caption
Include Price ($40-$55)

Leave a space for # of Purchases (to update daily)

Send to Fans, then exclude:
Muted
Tagged
Whales
Exclude from PPVMM

Use heatmap from FM analytics (PH timezone) to pick peak hour

$25–$35 for premium videos or larger photo bundles

Open the YUM Hours master sheet
For each chatter:
Copy validated total hours
Add +1 hour for Monday night meeting attendance if:
They attended and were not on shift during the meeting
Skip the +1 if:
They were absent
They were already on shift

Confirm all formulas and summaries are calculating properly

TRANSFER/RESUB VALIDATION OVERVIEW
Chatters are eligible for a $40 bonus if they achieve 10 successful conversions (Free to VIP transfers, or Resubscriptions) within a single day. This SOP ensures each claimed transfer or resub is properly validated before bonuses are granted.

Google Sheets

Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > Model's Info Sheet (Fans Transfer & Resub tab)

Locate the entries submitted by chatters for the specific day being validated.
 
STEP 2: Access FansMetric (FM)
Log in and navigate to the chatter's message history for the fan listed in the log.
 
STEP 3: Verify the Conversion or Resub
Confirm that:
The chatter engaged in conversation with the fan.
There was resubscription spiel and should not be longer than a week before the resub date.
The fan either subscribed or resubscribed on that day (based on system tag or subscription change).

Things to consider: 
a. FM is on PHT, but transfer must be counted in EST 
b. Cross reference the time fan resubscribe/transfer and the chatter's schedule in EST (For example: Welcome message is 1PM Sep 8 in FM, falls within the chatter's schedule of Sep 7 6AM - 2PM then it will be counted to Sep 7) 
c. If cannot identify the exact time, you can count it on the original message chatter sent 
d. If off, then add it to the previous shift

STEP 4: Mark as Validated
Once confirmed, indicate the entry as validated in your personal notes. If invalid add it as a comment in the cell. 
STEP 4: Repeat for All Entries
Validate each of the claimed conversions/resubs until all are reviewed.
Important Notes, Tips, or Warnings
Only direct conversions/resubs should be counted—do not credit transfers that occurred without chatter involvement.
Be cautious of duplicates, missing account and automatic renewal that may disqualify the bonus.
Fans who subbed without prior engagement or due to automated messages should not be counted.
Maintain validation records to support bonus payouts and dispute resolutions if needed.
Consistency and fairness in validation are key to preserving motivation and trust among chatters.

Create and schedule one PPVMM & MMs for VIP and Free account using selected content from the FM vault. Write persuasive, on-brand captions, update the tracker in EST, and align the schedule with peak engagement hours based on Fansmetric heatmap data.
 
PPVMM for Free Account - Daily at 5AM PHT, priced between $5-15, Sent to: Fans, Excluded: Muted, Tagged, Exclude from PPVMM, Already on VIP
PPVMM for VIP Account - Daily at 5AM PHT, priced between $40-$55, Sent to: Fans, Excluded: Muted, Tagged, Exclude from PPVMM, Whales
MM for Free Account - Twice a week for current VIP promos (benefits) and discount link
 
PREREQUISITE
FansMetric (FM) – For scheduling, accessing the vault, and analytics
PPVMM Tracker (ClickUp Docs) – To log captions, dates, prices, purchase counts (in EST)
Info Chrome > YUM folder in Bookmarks > [NEW] PPVMM Tracker | PPV MM Results
Heatmap (FM > Analytics) – To determine peak times for scheduling
Vault Content Folders in FM – For selecting content ($5–$100 folders)
ChatGPT – For rewording or generating fresh captions
Slack / Thread Notification – To inform Divine/Marj that the tracker is ready for review
INSTRUCTIONS 
STEP 1: PREPARE CONTENT & CAPTIONS
1.1. Log in to FansMetric (FM) and go to the Vault.
1.2. Browse folders priced $5–$100, but select content for PPVMMs within the $15–$35 price range.
Prioritize older content first.
For videos, pair with a preview photo if the clip is short.
For photosets, group related images (e.g. 3–4 pics as a bundle).
1.3. Use ChatGPT or former captions n the PPVMM Tracker for reference.
Captions should be seductive, enticing, and not robotic.
Focus on teasing, sensory cues, emotional pull and make it all about the fan.
Highlight power/tease words and ensure to have CTA phrases. 
 
STEP 2: UPDATE TRACKER IN CLICKUP
 2.1 Access the PPVMM Tracker under the YUM workspace in ClickUp.
 2.2. For each PPVMM scheduled:
Add Date & Time (in EST)
Paste Caption
Include Price ($40-$55)
Add Vault folder name or screenshot of the original upload date (to prevent repeats)
Leave a space for # of Purchases (to update daily)
2.3. Notify in the PPVMM Setup thread once the tracker is ready for review and approval.
STEP 3: SCHEDULE IN FANSMETRIC (PH TIME)
 3.1. After approval, go to FM > Messages > Mass Message (+).
 3.2. Set recipient group:
Send to Fans, then exclude:
Muted
Tagged
Whales
Exclude from PPVMM
3.3. Schedule the post:
Use PH time (local system time) based on FM heatmap
Use heatmap from FM analytics (PH timezone) to pick peak hour
3.4. Upload Media: Select content from the vault
3.5. Set Price ($15–$35)
3.6. Paste Caption
3.7. Save the message. Confirm it appears in the Queue (orange color).
 



STEP 4: TRACK PERFORMANCE DAILY
 4.1. Once scheduled, return to the tracker and change status as “Scheduled”
 4.2. Every morning, check FM > Message Stats
Note number of Purchases per PPVMM
Update tracker accordingly (skip reach/view count)
Adjust future strategies based on performance
IMPORTANT NOTES
Vault Folder Selection: Always start with older content to avoid repetition
Pricing Strategy:
$15–$20 for short videos or small photo sets
$25–$35 for premium videos or larger photo bundles
PH Time for Scheduling: Always schedule based on your local PH time. Tracker must still log time in EST.
Heatmap Guidance: Blue zones in FM analytics show peak purchase windows
Content Preview Rules: Avoid showing full nudity in preview images
Drops ≠ PPVMMs:
Drops are announced on the wall and redeemed via DM
PPVMMs are direct, unlockable messages sent to the fan inbox
Do not open chat messages in FM — this risks exposing sensitive data
Caption Tone: Prioritize personality, flirtation, and sensory buildup. Avoid robotic or repetitive lines
Approval Required: All scheduled PPVMMs must be reviewed before publishing
PPVMM Limit: 1 per day (scheduled by you). Chatters may send their own separately — ignore these in your planning.
